attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; NAR; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration

attributes.name: lease_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to lease.agreement. Business justification: Lease underwriting and ASC 842 risk assessment require tracing the credit profile used to approve a specific lease. Asset managers and credit committees need this link for portfolio risk reporting and
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tenant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tenant whose credit and financial qualification is captured in this profile. Links the credit profile to the authoritative tenant master record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Tenant Master; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: adverse_action_date
attributes.description: Date on which the adverse action notice was sent to the tenant. Required for FCRA compliance tracking and regulatory audit purposes.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD

attributes.name: adverse_action_notice_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an adverse action notice was issued to the tenant following a declined or conditioned underwriting decision, as required by the Fair Credit Reporting Act. True = adverse action notice sent. Critical for FCRA compliance.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD; NAR

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tenant provided written authorization for the credit check. Establishes the legal basis for the credit inquiry under FCRA and GDPR consent requirements.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: authorization_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the signed credit check authorization document stored in DocuSign CLM or the document management system. Supports audit trail and FCRA/GDPR compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); GDPR Article 7; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: bankruptcy_chapter
attributes.description: Type of bankruptcy filing (e.g., Chapter 7 liquidation, Chapter 11 reorganization, Chapter 13 repayment plan). Relevant for commercial tenants where Chapter 11 reorganization may indicate ongoing business viability.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); SEC — REIT reporting; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: bankruptcy_discharge_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tenant's bankruptcy was discharged, if applicable. Used to assess the elapsed time since discharge and determine eligibility under leasing underwriting policies that impose waiting periods post-bankruptcy.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: bankruptcy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has a bankruptcy filing on record as reported by the credit bureau. True = bankruptcy history present. Used as a disqualifying or conditional factor in leasing underwriting decisions.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); FASB ASC 842; NAR

attributes.name: bureau_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party credit bureau that provided the credit report and score used for leasing underwriting. Supports multi-bureau comparison and audit traceability.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: bureau_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned reference number returned by the credit bureau (e.g., Equifax, Experian, TransUnion) for the credit inquiry. Used to trace the report back to the originating bureau pull for audit and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: collections_amount
attributes.description: Total outstanding balance across all accounts in collections as reported by the credit bureau. Provides a quantitative measure of the tenant's delinquent debt exposure for underwriting risk assessment.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); NAR; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: collections_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has one or more accounts in collections as reported by the credit bureau. True = active or recent collections present. Used as a risk factor in leasing underwriting.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); NAR

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the credit profile record was first created in the system. Establishes the audit trail start point for the credit qualification lifecycle.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: credit_authorization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has provided explicit written authorization for the credit bureau check to be performed. True = authorization obtained. Required for FCRA compliance before initiating any credit inquiry.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); GDPR Article 7; NAR

attributes.name: credit_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tenant authorized and the credit bureau check was performed. Establishes the temporal validity window of the credit report for leasing underwriting purposes.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); GDPR Article 7; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Numeric credit score returned by the credit bureau at the time of the credit check. Typically ranges from 300 to 850 for consumer (FICO/VantageScore) or equivalent commercial scoring range. Used as the primary quantitative input for leasing underwriting decisions.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: credit_score_model
attributes.description: Scoring model used by the credit bureau to generate the credit score (e.g., FICO 8, VantageScore 3.0). Required for accurate interpretation of the score range and underwriting thresholds.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: credit_tier
attributes.description: Internal credit tier assigned based on the credit score and underwriting criteria. Tier A represents the highest creditworthiness; Tier F represents the lowest. Used to determine lease approval conditions, security deposit multipliers, and guarantor requirements.
attributes.references: NAR; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; MRI Software — Residential Management

attributes.name: dti_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of the tenant's total monthly debt obligations to gross monthly income, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3500 = 35%). A key underwriting metric used to assess the tenant's ability to service rent obligations alongside existing debt. Aligns with DTI as defined in common real estate financial qualification standards.
attributes.references: HUD; FASB ASC 842; NAR; CFPB Ability-to-Repay standards

attributes.name: eviction_count
attributes.description: Total number of prior eviction records identified for the tenant during the screening process. Provides granularity beyond the binary eviction flag for risk tiering and underwriting policy application.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD; NAR

attributes.name: guarantor_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a personal or corporate guarantor is required as a condition of lease approval based on the tenant's credit profile assessment. True = guarantor required. Drives lease structuring and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; NAR; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration

attributes.name: income_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the tenant's income during the credit qualification process. Supports audit trail and underwriting documentation requirements.
attributes.references: HUD; FASB ASC 842; NAR; FCRA

attributes.name: income_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the income verification process for the tenant. 'verified' indicates income has been confirmed via pay stubs, tax returns, or bank statements; 'unverified' indicates income was self-reported without documentation; 'pending' indicates verification is in progress; 'waived' indicates verification was waived per leasing policy.
attributes.references: HUD; FASB ASC 842; NAR

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the credit profile record. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and audit trail requirements in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: monthly_gross_income
attributes.description: Tenant's verified gross monthly income in the operating currency, as submitted and validated during the credit qualification process. Used as the denominator in DTI calculation and the income-to-rent ratio assessment.
attributes.references: HUD; FASB ASC 842; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: outstanding_judgments_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has outstanding civil judgments (e.g., unpaid court-ordered debts) as identified in the credit or public records check. True = outstanding judgments present. A significant risk factor in leasing underwriting.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); NAR; HUD

attributes.name: prior_eviction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has a prior eviction record as identified through the credit check or tenant screening process. True = prior eviction on record. A critical risk indicator in residential and commercial leasing underwriting.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD; NAR; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the credit profile record. 'active' indicates the profile is valid for underwriting; 'expired' indicates the review expiry date has passed; 'pending' indicates the credit check is in progress; 'withdrawn' indicates the tenant withdrew consent; 'under_review' indicates a dispute or re-evaluation is in progress.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: recommended_max_rent
attributes.description: Maximum monthly rent amount recommended by the underwriting model based on the tenant's verified income and DTI ratio. Typically calculated as a percentage of gross monthly income (e.g., 30% rule). Used by leasing agents to qualify tenants for specific units.
attributes.references: HUD; NAR; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: review_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current credit profile assessment expires and a new credit check is required before lease execution or renewal. Typically set 30–90 days from the credit check date per leasing policy.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); FASB ASC 842; NAR

attributes.name: security_deposit_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the monthly rent amount to calculate the required security deposit based on the tenant's credit tier and risk profile (e.g., 1.00 = one month's rent, 2.00 = two months' rent). Drives lease financial structuring and AR setup in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; NAR; Yardi Voyager — Accounts Receivable; HUD

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this credit profile record was sourced or initiated (e.g., Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, Salesforce CRM). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); SOX

attributes.name: tenant_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tenant as residential (B2C individual occupant) or commercial/industrial/retail (B2B corporate entity). Determines the applicable underwriting criteria, scoring model, and regulatory framework for the credit assessment.
attributes.references: RESO; NAR; FASB ASC 842; MRI Software — Residential Management

attributes.name: underwriting_decision
attributes.description: Outcome of the leasing underwriting review based on the credit profile assessment. 'approved' = tenant qualifies unconditionally; 'approved_with_conditions' = tenant qualifies subject to guarantor, higher deposit, or other conditions; 'declined' = tenant does not meet minimum credit criteria; 'pending' = decision not yet rendered.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; NAR; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; Fair Housing Act

attributes.name: underwriting_decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the underwriting decision was rendered for this credit profile. Used for audit trail, compliance reporting, and tracking decision turnaround times.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; NAR; Fair Housing Act; SOX

attributes.name: underwriting_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the underwriter or leasing manager documenting the rationale for the underwriting decision, any conditions imposed, or exceptions granted. Supports audit trail and Fair Housing Act compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Fair Housing Act; FASB ASC 842; SOX; NAR

attributes.name: application_submitted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the prospect formally submitted a tenancy application. Marks the transition from prospect to applicant in the leasing lifecycle and triggers credit and background screening workflows.

attributes.name: background_check_status

attributes.name: budget_max_monthly
attributes.description: Prospect's maximum acceptable monthly rent budget in the portfolio's base currency. Defines the upper bound of the prospect's affordability range for residential unit matching and pricing negotiations.

attributes.name: budget_min_monthly
attributes.description: Prospect's minimum acceptable monthly rent budget in the portfolio's base currency. Used for unit matching and pricing strategy. Applicable primarily to residential prospects where monthly rent is the standard pricing unit.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: budget_psf
attributes.description: Prospect's target rent budget expressed as a Per Square Foot (PSF) rate. Primarily used for commercial leasing where rent is quoted on a PSF basis. Enables direct comparison against asking rents in the CoStar market data.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: conversion_probability_pct
attributes.description: Estimated probability (0.00–100.00%) that this prospect will convert to a signed lease. Assigned by the leasing agent or derived from CRM scoring models. Used for pipeline forecasting and leasing velocity reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Deal Pipeline; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tenant prospect record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements, pipeline velocity measurement, and SOX financial controls for publicly traded REITs.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: credit_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the credit screening process for the prospect. Tracks whether a credit check has been initiated, is pending results, has passed, failed, or been waived. Relevant after application submission stage.
attributes.references: HUD — Fair Housing; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: desired_lease_term_months
attributes.description: Prospect's preferred lease duration expressed in months. Used to assess fit with available lease structures and to inform Weighted Average Lease Term (WALT) projections for the portfolio.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: desired_move_in_date
attributes.description: Prospect's preferred or requested commencement date for occupancy. Used for unit availability matching, lease scheduling, and Weighted Average Lease Expiry (WALE) planning.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: desired_size_max_sqft
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable space size in square feet (SQF) as specified by the prospect. Used alongside desired_size_min_sqft to define the prospect's space requirement range for inventory matching.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: desired_size_min_sqft
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable space size in square feet (SQF) as specified by the prospect. Used for unit matching against available Gross Leasable Area (GLA) and Net Leasable Area (NLA) inventory.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: email

attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: expected_lease_value

attributes.name: follow_up_date

attributes.name: inquiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the prospect first made contact or submitted an inquiry for a property or unit. Marks the entry point into the leasing funnel and is used to measure pipeline velocity and lead response time.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: is_marketing_consent

attributes.name: lead_source_detail
attributes.description: Supplementary detail describing the specific lead source, such as the referring broker name, campaign name, listing platform URL, or event name. Provides granularity beyond the lead_source category for marketing attribution analysis.

attributes.name: lost_reason

Used for pipeline loss analysis and leasing strategy improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: price|location|size|competitor|financing|timing|no_response|credit_fail|withdrew|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Deal Pipeline; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the prospect. Used for leasing agent outreach, tour scheduling, and follow-up communications throughout the pipeline.

attributes.name: pipeline_notes

attributes.name: pipeline_stage

attributes.description: The date on which the tenant transitioned into holdover status, i.e., the day after the original lease or occupancy end date. Populated only when is_holdover is True. Used to calculate holdover duration and associated penalty rent periods.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration

attributes.name: is_holdover
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the tenant is currently in holdover status — continuing to occupy the premises after the lease expiry date without a new or renewed lease agreement. Triggers holdover rent calculations and legal notification workflows.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; National Association of Realtors (NAR); Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: is_sublease
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this occupancy record represents a sublease arrangement where the occupying tenant is not the primary leaseholder. Supports sublease tracking, consent management, and NNN (Triple Net Lease) obligation pass-through analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: key_handover_date
attributes.description: The date on which physical keys, access cards, or digital access credentials were formally handed over to the tenant at commencement, or returned by the tenant at vacation. Critical for establishing the precise moment of physical possession transfer.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Property Management; Building Engines

attributes.name: move_in_condition_rating
attributes.description: Standardised rating of the premises condition at the time of tenant move-in, as recorded during the move-in inspection. Establishes the baseline for dilapidations assessment at move-out and supports deposit reconciliation.
attributes.references: Building Engines — Inspections; Yardi Voyager — Property Management

attributes.name: move_in_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the pre-occupancy condition inspection of the premises was conducted. Establishes the baseline condition of the unit at the time of handover to the tenant, supporting deposit reconciliation and maintenance liability determination.
attributes.references: Building Engines — Inspections; Yardi Voyager — Property Management

attributes.name: move_out_condition_rating
attributes.description: Standardised rating of the premises condition at the time of tenant move-out, as recorded during the move-out inspection. Compared against move_in_condition_rating to determine dilapidations liability and deposit deduction amounts.
attributes.references: Building Engines — Inspections; Yardi Voyager — Property Management

attributes.name: move_out_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the post-occupancy condition inspection of the premises was conducted upon tenant vacation. Used to assess dilapidations, damage beyond fair wear and tear, and to support deposit deduction decisions.
attributes.references: Building Engines — Inspections; Yardi Voyager — Property Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special conditions, or contextual information related to this occupancy record that is not captured by structured fields. Used by property managers for reference checks, tenant lifecycle documentation, and re-leasing intelligence.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Property Management; Building Engines

attributes.name: num_occupants
attributes.description: The total number of individuals or employees physically occupying the premises. Used for density analysis, building services planning, HVAC (Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning) load calculations, and ESG (Environmental Social and Governance) reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA — Building Safety; LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design); Building Engines

attributes.name: occupancy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the occupancy record. 'active' indicates the tenant is in physical possession; 'vacated' indicates the tenant has surrendered possession; 'pending_handover' indicates keys have not yet been formally exchanged; 'holdover' indicates possession continues beyond the agreed end date; 'terminated' indicates the occupancy was ended early; 'scheduled' indicates a future occupancy not yet commenced.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Occupancy Administration; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: occupancy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of physical possession. 'primary' indicates the main lease-backed occupancy; 'sublease' indicates a sub-tenant arrangement; 'holdover' indicates continued possession after lease expiry without a new agreement; 'license' indicates a short-term or non-exclusive right to occupy; 'co_occupancy' indicates shared possession; 'temporary' indicates a short-term or interim arrangement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: occupied_area_sqf
attributes.description: The actual net leasable area (NLA) physically occupied by the tenant, measured in square feet (SQF). May differ from the leased area if partial occupation, expansion, or contraction has occurred. Used for PSF (Per Square Foot) analytics and portfolio occupancy rate calculations.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); BOMA International — Floor Measurement Standards

attributes.name: occupied_area_sqm
attributes.description: The actual net leasable area (NLA) physically occupied by the tenant, measured in square metres (SQM). Supports international portfolio reporting and compliance with IFRS 16 disclosures for non-US properties.
attributes.references: IFRS 16; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC); ISO 55000

attributes.name: parking_bays_allocated
attributes.description: The number of parking bays or spaces allocated to the tenant as part of the occupancy arrangement. Supports facility operations planning, parking revenue tracking, and tenant service management.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Property Management; Building Engines

attributes.name: portfolio_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this occupancy record relates to a commercial or residential property. Drives applicable regulatory frameworks (e.g., ASC 842 vs residential tenancy law), reporting structures, and tenant lifecycle management processes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; National Association of Realtors (NAR); HUD

attributes.name: premises_identifier
attributes.description: The human-readable identifier of the specific suite, unit, or premises being occupied (e.g., 'Suite 1201', 'Unit 4B', 'Bay 3'). Complements the unit_id system reference with the operational label used in correspondence and building directories.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Unit/Space Master; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: scheduled_vacate_date
attributes.description: The contractually agreed or operationally planned date by which the tenant is expected to vacate the premises. May differ from the actual end_date if the tenant vacates early or holds over. Used for re-leasing planning and portfolio vacancy forecasting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this occupancy record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements across the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX — Financial Controls; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this occupancy record in the originating operational system (e.g., Yardi Voyager occupancy ID, MRI occupancy code). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: SOX — Financial Controls; Yardi Voyager; MRI Software

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tenant took physical possession of the premises. This is the actual commencement of occupancy, which may differ from the lease commencement date due to fit-out periods, early access, or delayed handover.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration

attributes.name: ti_completed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether all agreed Tenant Improvement (TI) works were completed prior to or during the occupancy commencement. Supports CAPEX (Capital Expenditure) tracking, lease incentive accounting under ASC 842/IFRS 16, and handover readiness confirmation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Procore — Construction Management

attributes.name: ti_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which all Tenant Improvement (TI) works were formally completed and signed off. Used to reconcile TI allowance disbursements, confirm lease commencement triggers, and support CAPEX project close-out in Procore.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Procore — Construction Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this occupancy record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: vacate_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised code indicating the reason the tenant vacated the premises. Supports tenant lifecycle analytics, re-leasing strategy, and churn analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lease_expiry|early_termination|default|relocation|downsizing|upsizing|business_closure|eviction|mutual_agreement — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: vacate_reason_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the vacate reason beyond the standardised code. Captures qualitative intelligence for tenant relationship management and re-leasing decisions.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration; Salesforce CRM

products.name: guarantor
products.description: Guarantor record for tenants requiring a co-signer or financial guarantor on a lease — common in residential tenancies for students/first-time renters and for corporate tenants with insufficient credit history or foreign entities. Captures guarantor type (individual, corporate, institutional), legal name, tax ID, relationship to tenant, guaranteed amount or percentage of lease obligation, guarantee instrument type (personal guarantee, letter of credit, surety bond, cash deposit), guarantee effective and expiry dates, credit qualification status, and guarantor contact details. Supports lease underwriting, guarantee enforcement, and portfolio credit risk assessment.
products.reference: Yardi Voyager Guarantor / MRI Guarantor Record

attributes.name: guarantor_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the guarantor record. Primary key for the guarantor entity within the tenant domain.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: corporate_entity_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: Guarantor jurisdiction determines applicable guarantee law, KYC/AML requirements, and cross-border enforcement rules. Domain experts expect a proper country FK on guarantor records for legal and compl
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: currency_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency_code. Business justification: Guarantor financial fields (guaranteed_amount, net_worth, annual_income) are denominated in a specific currency, critical for credit review, guarantee enforcement, and cross-border guarantee valuation
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lease_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific lease instrument that this guarantor is co-signing or guaranteeing. Supports lease underwriting and guarantee enforcement workflows.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: tenant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tenant record for whom this guarantor is providing a guarantee. Links the guarantor to the primary lessee in the tenant domain.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the guarantor's legal mailing or registered address. Used for legal notices, guarantee enforcement correspondence, and identity verification.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; USPS Addressing Standards; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the guarantor's legal mailing or registered address (suite, unit, floor, or additional address detail). Optional field.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: annual_income
attributes.description: Declared or verified annual gross income of the guarantor. For individual guarantors, used to assess debt-to-income (DTI) ratio and ability to cover lease obligations. For corporate guarantors, represents annual revenue.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; HUD; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: cash_deposit_account
attributes.description: Reference to the escrow or trust account holding the cash deposit when guarantee_instrument_type is 'cash_deposit'. Used for deposit tracking, interest accrual, and return-of-deposit workflows.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; HUD; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the guarantor's legal mailing or registered address. Used for legal notices and jurisdictional compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the guarantor record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: credit_bureau
attributes.description: Name of the credit reporting agency or rating agency from which the guarantor's credit score or creditworthiness rating was obtained. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Equifax|Experian|TransUnion|Dun_and_Bradstreet|Moody|SP_Global|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: credit_qualification_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the credit underwriting review for this guarantor: approved (meets credit standards), conditionally_approved (approved with conditions), declined (does not meet standards), pending_review (under assessment), or expired (prior approval has lapsed and requires renewal).
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: credit_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent credit qualification review was completed for this guarantor. Used to determine whether the credit assessment is current and to schedule renewal reviews.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Numeric credit score obtained from a credit bureau for individual guarantors, or an equivalent creditworthiness rating for corporate guarantors. Used in lease underwriting and portfolio credit risk assessment. Typically FICO score range 300–850 for individuals.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); GDPR Article 22; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: document_ref_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the executed guarantee instrument document as recorded in DocuSign CLM or the contract lifecycle management system. Enables direct retrieval of the signed guarantee agreement.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: dti_ratio
attributes.description: Debt-to-Income (DTI) ratio calculated for individual guarantors, expressed as a percentage of monthly debt obligations to gross monthly income. Used in residential lease underwriting to assess guarantor's capacity to cover the guaranteed obligation.
attributes.references: HUD; Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guarantee instrument becomes legally binding and enforceable. Typically aligned with the lease commencement date or execution date of the guarantee agreement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guarantee instrument was formally signed and executed by the guarantor. Distinct from the effective date; used for document management and legal enforceability tracking in DocuSign CLM.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; FASB ASC 842; American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guarantee instrument expires and the guarantor's obligation terminates. Null for open-ended guarantees that run for the full lease term. Critical for guarantee renewal tracking and portfolio credit risk management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: guarantee_instrument_type
attributes.description: Type of financial instrument used to secure the guarantee obligation: personal guarantee (individual liability), letter of credit (bank-issued), surety bond (insurance-backed), cash deposit (held in escrow), or corporate guarantee (entity-level obligation).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: guarantee_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for underwriters and property managers to record special conditions, exceptions, or observations related to the guarantee instrument. Supports lease underwriting documentation and guarantee enforcement context.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: guarantee_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the guarantee instrument: active (in force), expired (past expiry date), released (landlord released guarantor), called (guarantee has been drawn upon), pending (awaiting execution), or cancelled.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: guaranteed_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary amount the guarantor is liable for under the guarantee instrument. Applicable when the guarantee is capped at a specific dollar value rather than a percentage of the total lease obligation. Used in portfolio credit risk assessment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; SEC — REIT Reporting

attributes.name: guaranteed_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total lease obligation covered by this guarantor's guarantee. Used when the guarantee is expressed as a proportion of total rent rather than a fixed amount. Supports partial guarantee structures common in commercial leases.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: guarantor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guarantor entity: individual (personal guarantor), corporate (company guarantor), institutional (bank or fund), government, or trust. Drives underwriting and credit qualification workflows.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: is_foreign_entity
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor is a foreign individual or entity (incorporated or domiciled outside the domestic jurisdiction). Foreign guarantors typically require enhanced underwriting, additional security instruments, and SNDA agreements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SEC — REIT Reporting; GDPR

attributes.name: lc_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the letter of credit as stated on the LC instrument. May differ from the guarantee expiry date if the LC has a shorter term and requires periodic renewal. Critical for proactive renewal management.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) UCP 600; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: lc_issuing_bank
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution that issued the letter of credit, when guarantee_instrument_type is 'letter_of_credit'. Required for LC verification, renewal tracking, and draw procedures.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) UCP 600; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: lc_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned by the issuing bank to the letter of credit instrument. Used for LC draw requests, renewals, and bank correspondence when guarantee_instrument_type is 'letter_of_credit'.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) UCP 600; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the guarantor as it appears on the guarantee instrument and identity documents. For individuals, this is the full given and family name; for entities, the registered legal entity name.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FASB ASC 842; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: net_worth
attributes.description: Declared or verified net worth of the guarantor at the time of credit qualification. Represents total assets minus total liabilities. Key underwriting metric for assessing guarantor financial strength relative to the guaranteed lease obligation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SEC — Accredited Investor Standards; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the guarantor's legal mailing or registered address.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the guarantor, used for legal notices, guarantee-related correspondence, and CRM communications in Salesforce. Required for digital execution workflows in DocuSign CLM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; DocuSign CLM; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the guarantor in E.164 international format. Used for lease underwriting communications and guarantee enforcement contact.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: relationship_to_tenant
attributes.description: Nature of the relationship between the guarantor and the primary tenant. Used in lease underwriting to assess the strength and reliability of the guarantee. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parent|spouse|sibling|employer|investor|parent_company|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the landlord formally released the guarantor from their obligation, prior to the natural expiry date. Populated only when guarantee_status is 'released'. Supports legal compliance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the guarantor's legal mailing or registered address. Used for jurisdictional determination of guarantee enforceability and applicable law.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the guarantor. For individuals, this is the Social Security Number (SSN) or Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN); for entities, the Employer Identification Number (EIN) or equivalent. Used for credit checks and IRS reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1635; GDPR Article 9; SOX

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

products.name: notice

Supports lease administration, statutory compliance with state/local notice period requirements, and litigation readiness.

attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Section 615; Federal Trade Commission (FTC)

attributes.name: adverse_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an adverse action notice is required to be issued to the applicant based on the screening result. Triggered when a consumer report (credit, criminal, eviction) contributed to a denial or conditional approval decision, as mandated by FCRA Section 615.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Section 615; Federal Trade Commission (FTC)

attributes.name: applicant_consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether written authorization was obtained from the applicant prior to initiating the background screening, as required by FCRA Section 604(b). A prerequisite for any consumer report pull.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Section 604(b); GDPR Article 6; California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)

attributes.name: applicant_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subject being screened. Distinguishes between individual residential applicants, corporate entities, guarantors, and co-applicants, each of which may require different check types and criteria.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD Fair Housing Guidelines

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which all screening checks were completed and the final composite result was returned by the vendor. Used to measure vendor turnaround time and determine report validity window.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the applicant provided written authorization for the background screening. Required for FCRA compliance documentation and GDPR lawful basis records.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Section 604(b); GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the screening record was first created in the system. Establishes the audit trail start point and supports data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: credit_check_result
attributes.description: Result of the credit bureau check component of the screening. Reflects whether the applicant's credit profile meets the property's minimum credit qualification criteria. Note: detailed credit data is stored in tenant.credit_profile.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); FCRA Section 604; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: credit_score_at_screening
attributes.description: Credit score returned by the screening vendor at the time of this specific screening event. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot for audit and adverse action documentation purposes, independent of the ongoing credit profile record.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); FCRA Section 609; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: criminal_check_result
attributes.description: Result of the criminal background check component of the screening. A review_required result indicates records were found that require individualized assessment per HUD guidance before an adverse action decision is made.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD Criminal History Guidance (2016); Fair Housing Act

attributes.name: criminal_check_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the criminal background check performed. Indicates whether the search covered county, state, national, or international criminal records databases, which affects the comprehensiveness of the result.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: criteria_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the standardized screening criteria policy applied to this screening event. Ensures consistent, documented criteria enforcement across all applications and supports fair housing audit trails.
attributes.references: HUD Fair Housing Act; Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: employment_verification_result
attributes.description: Result of the employment verification check confirming the applicant's current employer, employment status, and income. Supports income-to-rent ratio qualification and FCRA-compliant underwriting.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: eviction_check_result
attributes.description: Result of the eviction history database search. Captures whether prior eviction filings or judgments were found. A fail or review_required result is a key risk indicator in the underwriting decision.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: fair_housing_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this screening result was flagged for individualized fair housing review, typically triggered when criminal history or other protected-class-adjacent findings require case-by-case assessment per HUD guidance before an adverse action decision.
attributes.references: HUD Fair Housing Act; HUD Criminal History Guidance (2016); Fair Housing Amendments Act

attributes.name: fcra_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all FCRA procedural requirements were met for this screening event, including permissible purpose documentation, applicant disclosure, authorization, and adverse action notice (if applicable). Critical for regulatory audit and litigation defense.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Federal Trade Commission (FTC); Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB)

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount charged to the applicant or property for the screening services. Tracked for accounts receivable reconciliation and to ensure compliance with state-level limits on application/screening fees.
attributes.references: State Tenant Protection Laws; Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: identity_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the applicant's identity during the screening process. Captures whether SSN, ITIN, government-issued ID, or passport was used, supporting FCRA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: identity_verification_result
attributes.description: Result of the identity verification check, including SSN/ITIN validation and government-issued ID confirmation. A fail or unable-to-verify result typically blocks lease approval and may trigger adverse action.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); USA PATRIOT Act; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: income_to_rent_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of the applicant's verified gross monthly income to the proposed monthly rent, calculated at the time of screening. Typically a minimum of 2.5x–3x is required. Used as a primary qualification criterion.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD Fair Housing Guidelines; Company Underwriting Policy

attributes.name: individualized_assessment_conducted
attributes.description: Indicates whether an individualized assessment was performed for this applicant prior to an adverse action based on criminal history, as required by HUD guidance to avoid disparate impact under the Fair Housing Act.
attributes.references: HUD Fair Housing Act; HUD Criminal History Guidance (2016); Fair Housing Amendments Act

attributes.name: landlord_reference_count
attributes.description: Number of prior landlord references contacted and verified during the screening process. Supports audit documentation of reference check thoroughness.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Company Screening Policy

attributes.name: landlord_reference_result
attributes.description: Result of the prior landlord reference check, verifying rental payment history, lease compliance, and tenancy conduct with previous landlords. A key qualitative input to the overall screening determination.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the reviewer to document observations, exceptions, individualized assessment findings, or other context relevant to the screening determination. Supports audit trail and fair housing compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD Fair Housing Guidelines

attributes.name: overall_result
attributes.description: Composite pass/fail determination across all screening check types performed. A conditional pass may indicate approval subject to additional conditions such as a co-signer or increased security deposit. Drives the underwriting decision in the application workflow.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); HUD Fair Housing Guidelines; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: portfolio_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the screening was conducted for a residential (B2C) or commercial (B2B) tenancy application. Determines applicable screening criteria, fair housing rules, and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: HUD Fair Housing Act; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this screening order, typically issued by the screening vendor (e.g., RentPrep, TransUnion SmartMove) upon order submission. Used for vendor reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: report_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the screening report is considered stale and a new screening must be ordered before a lease can be executed. Typically 30–90 days from completion date per company policy and FCRA guidelines.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Company Screening Policy

attributes.name: report_url
attributes.description: Secure URL or storage reference to the full screening report document returned by the vendor. Access is restricted to authorized personnel. Supports document retrieval for adverse action, audit, and underwriting review.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); GDPR Article 5; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the screening order was submitted to the vendor. Establishes the start of the screening timeline and is used to calculate turnaround time and report expiry.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the authorized reviewer completed their assessment of the screening results and recorded the qualification determination. Part of the audit trail for the application decision.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: screening_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the screening order. Tracks progression from initial request through vendor processing to final determination. Drives workflow routing in the application qualification process.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: sex_offender_check_result
attributes.description: Result of the national sex offender registry (NSOPW) check. A fail result requires individualized assessment and documented adverse action notice per FCRA and HUD fair housing guidance before denial.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); National Sex Offender Public Website (NSOPW); HUD Fair Housing Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the screening record. Tracks changes to screening status, results, or compliance flags throughout the screening lifecycle.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: vendor
attributes.description: Name of the third-party background screening service provider used to conduct the checks (e.g., RentPrep, TransUnion SmartMove, Experian RentBureau, CoreLogic SafeRent). Required for FCRA adverse action notices and vendor audit trails.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Section 607; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: vendor_order_code
attributes.description: Unique order or transaction identifier assigned by the screening vendor system for this specific screening request. Used for vendor portal reconciliation, dispute resolution, and FCRA reinvestigation requests.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Section 611

domains.name: lease
domains.description: Governs the full lifecycle of lease agreements — LOIs, executed leases, amendments, renewals, and terminations. Owns lease terms (NNN, gross, modified gross), TI allowances, CAM schedules, rent escalation clauses, WALT/WALE metrics, SNDA agreements, and renewal options. Authoritative source for ASC 842 / IFRS 16 lease accounting data including lease classification, measurement, and disclosure.
domains.references: FASB ASC 842, IFRS 16, RESO Data Dictionary

products.name: lease_agreement
products.description: Master record for every executed lease agreement across commercial and residential portfolios. Captures lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross, full-service, ground), commencement and expiration dates, base rent, rent escalation structure, security deposit terms, TI allowance, CAM obligations, permitted use, holdover provisions, and key lease abstract data (critical dates, exclusivity, co-tenancy, assignment/subletting rights, insurance requirements). Stores WALT/WALE metrics, ASC 842/IFRS 16 classification (operating vs. finance), right-of-use asset value, lease liability, and discount rate. Authoritative SSOT for all lease terms. Sourced from Yardi Voyager Lease Administration and MRI Lease Management modules. Links to property, tenant, and owner domains via FK.

attributes.name: tenant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tenant party who is the lessee under this agreement. Links to the tenant domain master record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; MRI Lease Management

attributes.name: assignment_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant is contractually permitted to assign the lease to a third party, subject to landlord consent conditions. Relevant for M&A transactions and corporate restructurings.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: base_rent_monthly
attributes.description: The contractual monthly base rent amount payable by the tenant, expressed in the agreement currency. Excludes CAM charges, taxes, and insurance. Core input for NOI and EGI calculations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: base_rent_psf_annual
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annual Base Rent Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Annual base rent expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) basis. Industry-standard metric used for market comparisons, CMA analysis, and CoStar benchmarking.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: cam_annual_budget
attributes.description: The annual budgeted Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charge allocated to this lease. Used for NNN and modified gross leases to estimate tenant's pro-rata share of operating expenses.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: cam_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The annual date on which CAM charges are reconciled against actual operating expenses and adjustments are billed or credited to the tenant.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: co_tenancy_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contains a co-tenancy clause allowing the tenant to reduce rent or terminate the lease if anchor tenants or a minimum occupancy threshold at the property is not maintained.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: commencement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the lease term begins and the tenant's right to use the premises commences. Used as the ASC 842 / IFRS 16 lease commencement date for right-of-use asset and lease liability measurement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the lease agreement record was first created in the source system (Yardi Voyager or MRI). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The interest rate used to discount future lease payments to present value for ASC 842 / IFRS 16 measurement. Typically the implicit rate in the lease or the lessee's incremental borrowing rate (IBR), expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.045000 = 4.5%).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: exclusivity_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contains an exclusivity clause restricting the landlord from leasing space to competing tenants within the same property. Common in retail leases.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which all parties signed and the lease agreement became legally binding. Sourced from DocuSign CLM execution records.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The contractual date on which the lease term ends. Used for WALT/WALE calculations, renewal option tracking, and ASC 842 lease term determination. Null for month-to-month leases.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: free_rent_months
attributes.description: The number of months of rent abatement (free rent) granted to the tenant at lease commencement or during the lease term. Recognized as a lease incentive under ASC 842 and amortized over the lease term.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: holdover_rent_multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier applied to the base rent if the tenant remains in occupancy beyond the lease expiration date without executing a renewal (holdover tenancy). Typically 1.25 to 1.50 (125%–150% of base rent).
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: insurance_required_amount
attributes.description: The minimum general liability insurance coverage amount the tenant is contractually required to maintain and name the landlord as an additional insured, as specified in the lease abstract.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; OSHA; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the lease agreement record was most recently updated in the source system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change data capture in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: lease_classification
attributes.description: ASC 842 / IFRS 16 accounting classification of the lease as either an operating lease or a finance lease (capital lease). Determines balance sheet treatment, amortization method, and income statement presentation for the lessee.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; SEC

attributes.name: lease_liability
attributes.description: The present value of future lease payments recognized as a liability on the balance sheet at lease commencement under ASC 842 / IFRS 16. Decreases as lease payments are made over the lease term.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; SEC

attributes.name: lease_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the lease agreement, as recorded in Yardi Voyager or MRI. Used for cross-system reference and tenant-facing communications.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; MRI Lease Management

attributes.name: lease_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the lease agreement. Drives ASC 842 / IFRS 16 recognition, billing activation, and portfolio reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|executed|active|expired|terminated|holdover — promote to reference product if additional states are required]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: lease_term_months
attributes.description: The total contractual lease term expressed in months from commencement to expiration. Used for WALT/WALE calculations, Argus Enterprise cash flow modeling, and portfolio duration analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Argus Enterprise; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: leased_area_sqft
attributes.description: The net leasable area (NLA) in square feet covered by this lease agreement. Used for PSF rent calculations, CAM pro-rata share computation, and GLA occupancy reporting.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); BOMA International

attributes.name: loi_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Letter of Intent (LOI) was signed by the prospective tenant, marking the formal start of lease negotiation. Sourced from Salesforce CRM deal pipeline records.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: permitted_use
attributes.description: The contractually defined purpose for which the tenant is permitted to use the leased premises (e.g., 'retail clothing store', 'general office use', 'restaurant and bar'). Restricts tenant operations and is a key lease abstract field.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: portfolio_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease agreement belongs to the commercial or residential portfolio, driving applicable regulatory frameworks (ASC 842 vs. residential tenancy law) and reporting hierarchies.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; HUD

attributes.name: pro_rata_share
attributes.description: The tenant's proportionate share of the building's total rentable area, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.125000 = 12.5%). Used to allocate CAM, tax, and insurance charges in NNN and modified gross leases.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; BOMA International

attributes.name: renewal_option_count
attributes.description: The number of renewal options available to the tenant under the lease agreement. Each option typically specifies a term length and rent determination method.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: renewal_option_exercised
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has formally exercised a renewal option under this lease agreement. True when the renewal notice has been received and acknowledged by the landlord.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: renewal_option_term_months
attributes.description: The duration in months of each renewal option period available to the tenant. Used in ASC 842 lease term assessment to determine if renewal options are reasonably certain to be exercised.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: rent_commencement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tenant's obligation to pay base rent begins. May differ from the lease commencement date due to free-rent periods or tenant improvement construction periods.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: rent_escalation_rate
attributes.description: The percentage or fixed amount by which base rent escalates per the rent_escalation_type. Expressed as a decimal for percentage types (e.g., 0.0300 = 3%). Null when escalation type is none or CPI-linked.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: rent_escalation_type
attributes.description: Method by which base rent increases over the lease term. Fixed percent applies a set annual percentage increase. CPI ties escalation to the Consumer Price Index. Fixed amount adds a set dollar increment. None indicates flat rent for the full term.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: rou_asset_value
attributes.description: The initial measurement of the right-of-use (ROU) asset recognized on the balance sheet at lease commencement under ASC 842 / IFRS 16. Equals the present value of future lease payments plus initial direct costs and prepaid rent.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; SEC

attributes.name: security_deposit_amount
attributes.description: The total security deposit held by the landlord as collateral against tenant default or damage. Tracked for AR reconciliation and return obligations upon lease expiration.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: snda_executed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Subordination Non-Disturbance and Attornment (SNDA) Agreement Executed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Subordination, Non-Disturbance, and Attornment (SNDA) agreement has been executed between the tenant, landlord, and lender. Required by most commercial mortgage lenders to protect tenant occupancy rights in foreclosure.
attributes.references: ALTA; DocuSign CLM; CMBS standards

attributes.name: subletting_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant is contractually permitted to sublet all or part of the leased premises to a subtenant, subject to landlord consent conditions specified in the lease.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: termination_option_date
attributes.description: The contractual date on or before which the tenant may exercise an early termination option, if such a right exists in the lease. Null if no early termination option is granted.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: termination_penalty_amount
attributes.description: The contractual fee or penalty payable by the tenant upon exercising an early termination option. Factored into ASC 842 lease term assessment and lease liability measurement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: ti_allowance_amount
attributes.description: The total Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance granted by the landlord to fund tenant fit-out or renovation of the leased premises. Capitalized under FASB ASC 842 lease incentive accounting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets; Procore

products.name: amendment
products.description: Records all executed amendments to a base lease agreement, including expansion options exercised, contraction events, rent modifications, term extensions, TI re-allowances, and permitted use changes. Tracks amendment number, effective date, amendment type, changed clauses with before/after values, revised rent, revised GLA/NLA, and DocuSign execution metadata. Each amendment is a distinct legal instrument modifying the parent agreement and triggers ASC 842 lease modification assessment. Sourced from Yardi Voyager and DocuSign CLM.

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the lease amendment record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: area_uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.uom. Business justification: Amendments track prior_gla_sqft and revised_gla_sqft area measurements. International portfolios require a formal UOM reference (sqft vs sqm) for remeasurement events, ASC 842 modification assessments
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property associated with the amended lease, enabling property-level amendment reporting and portfolio analytics.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: brokerage_deal_id

attributes.name: base_rent_amount

attributes.name: cpi_base_value
attributes.description: The baseline CPI index value at the commencement of the lease or the start of the CPI measurement period. Used to calculate the percentage change for CPI-linked rent escalation. Null for non-CPI escalation types.
