attributes.name: cpi_cap_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Price Index (CPI) Escalation Cap Rate
attributes.description: The maximum annual CPI escalation rate permitted under the lease terms, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5.00% cap). Protects the tenant from excessive CPI-driven rent increases. Null for uncapped CPI or non-CPI escalation types.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: cpi_floor_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Price Index (CPI) Escalation Floor Rate
attributes.description: The minimum annual CPI escalation rate guaranteed under the lease terms, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0200 = 2.00% floor). Protects the landlord from zero or negative CPI adjustments. Null for non-CPI escalation types.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: cpi_index_name
attributes.description: The name of the CPI index used for rent escalation when escalation_type is 'cpi' (e.g., 'US CPI-U All Items', 'UK RPI'). Null for non-CPI escalation types.
attributes.references: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics; IFRS 16; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rent schedule record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance controls.
attributes.references: SOX; FASB ASC 842; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount rate used to calculate the present value of lease payments for this rent step under ASC 842 / IFRS 16. Typically the implicit rate in the lease or the lessee's incremental borrowing rate (IBR). Expressed as a decimal annual rate (e.g., 0.0450 = 4.50%).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-30-3; IFRS 16.26; FASB

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The last date on which this rent step period is in effect. The next step's effective_start_date should immediately follow. Null for open-ended final steps.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rent step period begins and the corresponding base rent amount becomes billable to the tenant. Aligns with the lease commencement or escalation trigger date.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: escalation_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar increment added to the prior step's base rent to arrive at this step's base rent. Used when escalation_type is 'fixed_step' with a dollar-denominated increase rather than a percentage. Null for percentage or CPI escalations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: escalation_rate
attributes.description: The escalation rate applied to derive this step's rent from the prior step. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.0300 = 3.00%). Applicable when escalation_type is 'fixed_step' (percentage) or 'cpi'. Null for fixed-dollar steps or percentage-of-sales.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: escalation_type
attributes.description: The mechanism by which rent increases from one step to the next. 'fixed_step' = predetermined dollar or percentage increase; 'cpi' = Consumer Price Index-linked; 'percentage_of_sales' = percentage rent tied to tenant gross sales; 'market_review' = reset to fair market value; 'none' = flat rent with no escalation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: free_rent_months
attributes.description: The number of months of rent abatement granted to the tenant within this step period. Used to quantify the total concession value for ASC 842 straight-line rent amortization and Argus Enterprise cash flow modeling.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days after the payment due date before a late fee is assessed. Defined in the lease agreement and used by Yardi Voyager to trigger arrears events and late charge calculations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: is_free_rent_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rent step period is a free-rent (rent abatement) period during which no base rent is payable by the tenant. True = free-rent period; False = normal rent-paying period. Critical for ASC 842 straight-line rent calculation over the full lease term.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: late_fee_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to the overdue rent balance to calculate the late payment fee after the grace period expires. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5.00%). Null if a flat late fee amount applies instead.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; State Landlord-Tenant Law

attributes.name: lease_classification
attributes.description: The accounting classification of the lease under ASC 842 (lessee perspective) or IFRS 16. 'operating' = operating lease with straight-line expense recognition; 'finance' = finance/capital lease with front-loaded expense recognition. Drives balance sheet treatment and disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20; IFRS 16.62; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: lease_liability_amount
attributes.description: The present value of remaining lease payments attributable to this rent step period under ASC 842 / IFRS 16. Represents the lessee's financial obligation for this step. Required for balance sheet disclosure and debt covenant compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-30; IFRS 16.26; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: leased_area_sqft
attributes.description: The net leasable area (NLA) in square feet covered by this rent schedule step. Used to derive rent_psf and to validate rent amounts against market benchmarks in CoStar Suite.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; BOMA International; CoStar Suite

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for lease administrators to record contextual notes about this rent step, such as negotiated concession rationale, amendment history, or special billing instructions not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; MRI Software Lease Management

attributes.name: payment_due_day
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rent Payment Due Day of Month
attributes.description: The day of the month on which rent payment is due (e.g., 1 = first of the month). Used to generate AR billing schedules in Yardi Voyager and to calculate late payment penalties.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which base rent payments are due from the tenant under this rent step. Drives accounts receivable billing cycle in Yardi Voyager and cash flow timing in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: percentage_rent_breakpoint
attributes.description: The gross sales threshold above which percentage rent becomes payable by the tenant. Applicable when escalation_type is 'percentage_of_sales'. Typically calculated as base_rent_amount divided by the percentage rent rate. Null for non-percentage-of-sales leases.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; ICSC; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: percentage_rent_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of tenant gross sales above the breakpoint that is payable as additional rent. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0600 = 6.00%). Common in retail leases. Null for non-percentage-of-sales leases.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; ICSC; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: rent_psf
attributes.description: Base rent expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) annual basis for this rent step period. Calculated as annual_rent_amount divided by the leased area in square feet. Standard CRE benchmarking metric used in CoStar comparable analysis.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; CoStar Suite; NAR

attributes.name: rou_asset_amount
attributes.description: The right-of-use (ROU) asset value attributable to this rent step period under ASC 842 / IFRS 16 lessee accounting. Represents the present value of lease payments allocated to this step. Required for balance sheet disclosure and fixed asset register in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-30; IFRS 16.22; SAP S/4HANA Fixed Assets

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this rent schedule row, as assigned in the source system (e.g., Yardi Voyager or MRI Software). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit tracing.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; MRI Software Lease Management

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this rent schedule row. 'active' indicates the current billing period; 'future' indicates an upcoming step; 'expired' indicates a past step; 'superseded' indicates replaced by an amendment; 'cancelled' indicates voided.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this rent schedule row was sourced. 'yardi' = Yardi Voyager; 'mri' = MRI Software; 'argus' = Argus Enterprise; 'manual' = manually entered in the data platform.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager; MRI Software; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier for this rent schedule row in the originating source system (e.g., Yardi charge code + period key). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and incremental load deduplication in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager; MRI Software; Databricks Lakehouse

attributes.name: step_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential integer ordering this rent step within the lease agreement's full escalation schedule. Step 1 is the initial rent period; subsequent steps represent each escalation event.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: straight_line_rent_adjustment
attributes.description: The difference between the straight-line rent amount and the cash base rent amount for this step period. A positive value indicates deferred rent (cash < straight-line); a negative value indicates prepaid rent. Required for ASC 842 deferred rent liability/asset tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; IFRS 16; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: straight_line_rent_amount
attributes.description: The ASC 842 / IFRS 16 straight-line rent amount for this step period, representing the equal monthly recognition amount calculated by spreading total lease payments evenly over the lease term. Used for GAAP/IFRS income statement recognition, distinct from cash rent.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; IFRS 16.36; Yardi Voyager General Ledger

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rent schedule record was most recently modified in the data platform. Used for incremental processing, change data capture, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX; FASB ASC 842; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

products.name: cam_schedule
products.description: Annual CAM (Common Area Maintenance) reconciliation record comparing estimated CAM charges billed to tenants against actual operating expenses incurred. Captures reconciliation year, estimated CAM per lease, actual CAM allocated, gross-up factor, tenant pro-rata share, reconciliation variance, credit or additional charge due, and reconciliation status. Sourced from Yardi Voyager CAM module. Critical for NNN and modified gross lease portfolios.

attributes.name: actual_cam_gross
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Gross Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Operating Expense
attributes.description: Total actual gross operating expenses incurred at the property level for the reconciliation period, before application of the gross-up factor or tenant pro-rata share. Sourced from the property general ledger via Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager General Ledger; RESO

attributes.name: actual_cam_grossed_up
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Grossed-Up Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Expense
attributes.description: Actual CAM operating expenses after application of the gross-up factor. Represents the normalized total expense pool used as the basis for tenant pro-rata share allocation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager CAM Module; RESO

attributes.name: actual_cam_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Actual CAM charge allocated to the tenant expressed on a per-square-foot basis (PSF). Calculated as tenant_cam_allocated divided by tenant_nla_sqft. Key metric for portfolio benchmarking and market comparisons.
attributes.references: RESO; CoStar Suite; Yardi Voyager CAM Module

attributes.name: admin_fee_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Administration Fee Amount
attributes.description: Calculated dollar amount of the landlord's administrative fee included in the tenant's CAM allocation for the reconciliation period. Derived from admin_fee_rate applied to the eligible CAM expense pool.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: admin_fee_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Administration Fee Rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate charged by the landlord as an administrative or management fee on top of actual CAM expenses, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.15 = 15%). Permitted under many NNN leases. Null if no admin fee applies.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; RESO; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: audit_right_exercised
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant CAM Audit Right Exercised Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has exercised their contractual right to audit the landlord's CAM expense records for the reconciliation period. True if an audit has been formally requested or conducted.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842; SOX

attributes.name: building_gla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Building Gross Leasable Area (GLA) in Square Feet (SQF)
attributes.description: Total Gross Leasable Area of the building in square feet used as the denominator for pro-rata share calculation. May differ from total building area if certain areas are excluded per lease terms.
attributes.references: RESO; BOMA International; Yardi Voyager Property Management

attributes.name: cam_cap_applied
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Cap Applied Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CAM increase cap was triggered and applied during this reconciliation period. True if the calculated CAM increase exceeded the cap and was limited accordingly.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: cam_cap_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Annual Increase Cap Rate
attributes.description: Maximum annual percentage increase in CAM charges permitted under the lease, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 = 5% cap). Limits the tenant's CAM exposure year-over-year. Null if no cap applies.
attributes.references: RESO; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: cam_cap_savings
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Cap Savings Amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount by which the tenant's CAM charge was reduced due to the application of the CAM cap. Represents the difference between the uncapped allocated amount and the capped amount billed. Zero if cap was not applied.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: cam_cap_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the CAM increase cap is cumulative (unused cap carries forward to future years) or non-cumulative (cap resets each year). Determines how the cap is applied in multi-year reconciliations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; RESO; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: cam_exclusions_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar value of operating expense line items excluded from the CAM pool per lease terms (e.g., capital expenditures, management fees above a threshold, leasing commissions). Reduces the gross CAM expense pool before tenant allocation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842; RESO

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CAM reconciliation record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements under SOX and FASB ASC 842.
attributes.references: SOX; FASB ASC 842; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: credit_or_charge_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: CAM Credit or Additional Charge Amount
attributes.description: Net monetary amount due to or from the tenant as a result of the CAM reconciliation. A positive value represents an additional charge invoiced to the tenant; a negative value represents a credit applied to the tenant's account. Drives the AR billing or credit memo in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; SOX

attributes.name: credit_or_charge_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reconciliation outcome results in an additional charge to the tenant, a credit to the tenant, or a zero-balance settlement. Drives downstream AR and billing workflow routing in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenant has formally disputed the CAM reconciliation statement. True if a dispute has been raised; False if no dispute exists. Triggers dispute management workflow.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the tenant's stated reason for disputing the CAM reconciliation, as recorded by the property manager. Populated only when dispute_flag is True.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: dispute_resolved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CAM reconciliation dispute was formally resolved between landlord and tenant. Null if no dispute exists or dispute is still open.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: estimated_cam_annual
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Annual Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Charge
attributes.description: Total estimated CAM charges billed to the tenant over the reconciliation year, based on the budgeted CAM rate established at lease commencement or annual budget cycle. Represents the sum of monthly estimated CAM payments collected from the tenant.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager CAM Module; RESO

attributes.name: estimated_cam_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Estimated annual CAM charge expressed on a per-square-foot basis (PSF). Calculated as estimated_cam_annual divided by tenant_nla_sqft. Used for benchmarking and lease comparison analytics.
attributes.references: RESO; CoStar Suite; Yardi Voyager CAM Module

attributes.name: grossup_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to actual CAM expenses to normalize costs to a fully occupied building (typically to 90–100% occupancy). Ensures tenants pay their fair share of variable operating costs regardless of actual vacancy. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.05 for a 5% gross-up).
attributes.references: RESO; NAR; Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for property manager or asset manager annotations regarding the CAM reconciliation, including explanations of unusual variances, exclusion justifications, or tenant communication summaries.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the additional CAM charge (if any) must be paid by the tenant, or by which the landlord must issue a credit. Drives AR billing and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tenant's additional CAM payment was received and applied in Yardi Voyager. Null if no additional charge was due or payment has not yet been received.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: prior_year_estimated_cam
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Year Estimated Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Charge
attributes.description: Total estimated CAM charges billed to the tenant in the immediately preceding reconciliation year. Used for year-over-year variance analysis and CAM cap calculations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: reconciliation_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this CAM reconciliation record as assigned by Yardi Voyager (e.g., CAMREC-2024-00123). Used in tenant correspondence, audit trails, and billing statements.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_end
attributes.description: Last day of the CAM reconciliation period. Defines the boundary of actual operating expenses included in the reconciliation calculation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager CAM Module

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_start
attributes.description: First day of the CAM reconciliation period. May differ from the calendar year start for leases with non-standard fiscal periods or mid-year commencement dates.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager CAM Module

attributes.name: reconciliation_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CAM reconciliation statement was formally delivered to the tenant. Triggers the tenant's review and dispute window as defined in the lease.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the CAM reconciliation record. Tracks progression from initial draft through tenant review, finalization, dispute resolution, and settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|finalized|disputed|settled|voided — promote to reference product if additional states are required]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842; SOX

attributes.name: reconciliation_variance
attributes.description: Difference between the tenant's allocated actual CAM charge and the estimated CAM billed during the reconciliation period (tenant_cam_allocated minus estimated_cam_annual). A positive value indicates an underpayment (additional charge due from tenant); a negative value indicates an overpayment (credit due to tenant).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager CAM Module; SOX; RESO

attributes.name: reconciliation_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal year (four-digit integer, e.g., 2024) for which actual CAM operating expenses are being reconciled against estimated billings. Defines the reconciliation period.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager CAM Module

attributes.name: tenant_cam_allocated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Allocated Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Charge
attributes.description: Actual CAM expense allocated to this specific tenant, calculated as the grossed-up actual CAM multiplied by the tenant's pro-rata share. This is the amount the tenant is contractually obligated to pay for the reconciliation period.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager CAM Module; RESO

attributes.name: tenant_nla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Net Leasable Area (NLA) in Square Feet (SQF)
attributes.description: The tenant's Net Leasable Area in square feet as defined in the lease and used for pro-rata share calculation. Captures the measurement basis for CAM allocation at the time of reconciliation.
attributes.references: RESO; BOMA International; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: tenant_prorata_share
attributes.description: The tenant's proportionate share of total building CAM expenses, expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.12500 = 12.5%). Typically calculated as the tenant's Net Leasable Area (NLA) divided by the total building NLA or Gross Leasable Area (GLA), as defined in the lease.
attributes.references: RESO; FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: tenant_response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the tenant must respond to or dispute the CAM reconciliation statement, as stipulated in the lease agreement. Typically 30–90 days after the reconciliation statement is sent.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; FASB ASC 842; RESO

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CAM reconciliation record was most recently modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Tracks the latest state change for audit and change-data-capture purposes.
attributes.references: SOX; FASB ASC 842; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: yardi_cam_batch_code
attributes.description: Source system batch identifier assigned by Yardi Voyager when the CAM reconciliation was processed or posted. Supports data lineage tracing back to the originating system batch run.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Module; SOX

attributes.name: amount_due
attributes.description: The gross amount billed to the tenant for the charge type and applied period as stated on the AR invoice. Represents the contractual obligation before any payments, credits, or adjustments are applied.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: amount_paid
attributes.description: The actual monetary amount received from the tenant in this payment transaction. May be less than amount_due (partial payment) or equal to it (full payment). Core monetary fact for cash collection reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: applied_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the billing period to which this payment is applied (e.g., 2024-01-31 for January rent). Together with applied_period_start_date defines the exact coverage window for the payment.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: applied_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the billing period to which this payment is applied (e.g., 2024-01-01 for January rent). Used for period-level cash collection analysis and ASC 842 / IFRS 16 lease liability amortization reconciliation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the revenue or charge category this payment satisfies. 'base_rent' = contractual base rent; 'cam' = Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges; 'security_deposit' = security deposit receipt; 'late_fee' = penalty for late payment; 'ti_reimbursement' = Tenant Improvement (TI) cost reimbursement; 'percentage_rent' = overage rent based on tenant sales. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base_rent|cam|security_deposit|late_fee|ti_reimbursement|percentage_rent|parking|utility_reimbursement|insurance_reimbursement|tax_reimbursement|holdover_rent|termination_fee — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; NAR

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: The check number printed on the tenant's paper check, as captured during lockbox or manual receipt processing. Populated only when payment_method is 'check'. Used for bank reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payment record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Represents the audit trail creation event for data lineage and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: The number of calendar days between the due_date and the payment_date. A positive value indicates late payment; zero or negative indicates on-time or early payment. Drives delinquency classification, late fee triggers, and tenant credit scoring.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; NAR

attributes.name: deposit_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment funds were deposited into the property's bank account. May differ from payment_date (receipt date) for checks held before deposit or lockbox processing delays. Used for bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SOX

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which the tenant was required to remit payment per the lease agreement. Used to calculate days-past-due, trigger late fee assessment, and drive delinquency reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the payment amount to the functional reporting currency at the time of receipt. Applicable for multi-currency portfolios. 1.0 for payments already in the functional currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 16; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: is_delinquent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment was received after the contractual due date (True) or on time (False). Set to True when days_past_due > 0 at the time of receipt. Used for tenant delinquency reporting, arrears event triggering, and portfolio risk dashboards.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; NAR

attributes.name: is_partial_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amount_paid is less than the amount_due for the associated charge (True = partial payment; False = full payment). Partial payments trigger outstanding_balance tracking and may initiate default cure period monitoring.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: late_fee_assessed
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the late fee charged to the tenant as a result of this payment being received after the due date. Calculated per the late fee schedule in the lease agreement. Zero if payment was on time.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: late_fee_waived
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessed late fee was waived by the property manager or asset manager (True = waived; False = not waived). Supports exception tracking and tenant relationship management reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the property manager or AR administrator regarding this payment (e.g., tenant dispute context, special arrangement details, partial payment agreement). Supports operational context for collections staff.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: nsf_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment was returned by the bank due to Non-Sufficient Funds (NSF) or a similar bank return reason (True = NSF/returned; False = cleared). NSF events trigger reversal of the posted payment and may initiate default proceedings.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: nsf_return_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bank returned the payment due to NSF or other bank return reason. Populated only when nsf_flag is True. Used to calculate the effective delinquency period and trigger corrective AR actions.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: The remaining unpaid balance on the charge after this payment is applied (amount_due minus amount_applied). A non-zero value indicates a partial payment or delinquency. Used for AR aging and tenant arrears reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the payment was received from the tenant (receipt date). This is the principal real-world business event date used for delinquency calculation, aging analysis, and cash flow reporting. Distinct from the posting date.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used by the tenant to remit payment. 'ach' = Automated Clearing House electronic transfer; 'wire' = bank wire transfer; 'check' = paper check; 'credit_card' = card payment; 'lockbox' = bank lockbox processing; 'cash' = physical currency.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; PCI DSS

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment record within the AR workflow. 'posted' = applied to ledger; 'pending' = received but not yet applied; 'reversed' = corrected/reversed entry; 'voided' = cancelled before posting; 'returned' = NSF or bank return; 'on_hold' = held pending dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the payment was posted to the General Ledger (GL) period. May differ from payment_date due to cut-off timing, bank processing delays, or period-end adjustments. Used for period-close reconciliation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL Module; FASB ASC 842; SOX

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable payment reference number assigned by Yardi Voyager AR at the time of receipt posting. Used for tenant remittance matching, bank reconciliation, and audit trail. Corresponds to the Yardi receipt number.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: remittance_reference
attributes.description: The tenant-provided reference or memo field included with the payment remittance (e.g., wire transfer memo, ACH addenda, check memo line). Used to match incoming payments to open AR charges when the reference number is not automatically matched.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment reversal or void was processed in Yardi Voyager AR. Populated only when payment_status is 'reversed' or 'voided'. Used for AR aging recalculation and delinquency reassessment.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SOX

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why a posted payment was reversed or voided. Populated only when payment_status is 'reversed' or 'voided'. Supports audit trail and exception reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module; SOX

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: The portion of amount_paid that has been received but not yet applied to a specific charge or invoice. Held in a suspense or prepayment account until the property manager allocates it. Relevant for tenant overpayment and prepaid rent scenarios.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payment record was last modified in the Silver layer data product (e.g., status change, reversal, correction). Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: yardi_batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or deposit batch number in Yardi Voyager under which this payment was grouped for posting. Supports batch-level reconciliation between Yardi AR and bank deposit records.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: yardi_receipt_code
attributes.description: The native receipt or transaction identifier assigned by Yardi Voyager AR at the time of payment posting. Used for source system traceability, reconciliation between the Silver layer and the operational system, and audit trail.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AR Module

attributes.name: loc_issuer_name

attributes.name: lease_liability_remeasurement
attributes.description: Adjustment to the lease liability resulting from a lease modification, change in lease term, change in variable payments indexed to a rate, or reassessment of a purchase/extension option. Positive = increase; negative = decrease.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35-4; IFRS 16 paragraph 45

attributes.name: maturity_after_year5_payments
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lease Maturity Analysis — After Year 5 Undiscounted Payments
attributes.description: Undiscounted future lease payments due more than 5 years from the balance sheet date, completing the maturity analysis disclosure schedule under ASC 842-20-50-6 and IFRS 16 paragraph 58.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-50-6; IFRS 16 paragraph 58

attributes.name: maturity_year1_payments
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lease Maturity Analysis — Year 1 Undiscounted Payments
attributes.description: Undiscounted future lease payments due within 12 months of the balance sheet date, as required for the lease liability maturity analysis disclosure under ASC 842-20-50-6 and IFRS 16 paragraph 58.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-50-6; IFRS 16 paragraph 58

attributes.name: maturity_year2_to5_payments
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lease Maturity Analysis — Years 2–5 Undiscounted Payments
attributes.description: Undiscounted future lease payments due between 1 and 5 years from the balance sheet date, forming part of the maturity analysis disclosure schedule under ASC 842-20-50-6 and IFRS 16 paragraph 58.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-50-6; IFRS 16 paragraph 58

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which the ROU asset and lease liability were measured or remeasured, which may differ from the accounting period date in the case of mid-period modifications or reassessments.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35-4; IFRS 16 paragraph 45

attributes.name: modification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accounting entry was triggered by a lease modification event (e.g., extension, scope change, rent renegotiation) requiring remeasurement of the ROU asset and lease liability.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35-3; IFRS 16 paragraph 44

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this accounting entry was posted to the General Ledger, representing the principal business event timestamp for the transaction lifecycle.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: practical_expedient_applied
attributes.description: Indicates which ASC 842 / IFRS 16 practical expedient, if any, has been elected for this lease: 'short_term' = ≤12-month exemption; 'low_value' = IFRS 16 low-value asset exemption; 'portfolio' = portfolio-level application; 'hindsight' = hindsight expedient on transition; 'none' = no expedient applied.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-15-3; IFRS 16 paragraphs 5, 15

attributes.name: principal_repayment
attributes.description: Cash payment applied to reduce the lease liability principal during the period, representing the financing portion of the lease payment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35-5; IFRS 16 paragraph 26

attributes.name: rou_asset_additions
attributes.description: Increases to the ROU asset during the period from new lease commencements, lease modifications that increase scope, or remeasurements that increase the lease liability.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35; IFRS 16 paragraph 39

attributes.name: rou_asset_amortisation
attributes.description: Current-period amortisation charge applied to the ROU asset. For finance leases, amortised on a straight-line basis over the shorter of the lease term or useful life; for operating leases, the plug to achieve straight-line rent expense.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35-6; IFRS 16 paragraph 31

attributes.name: rou_asset_closing_balance
attributes.description: Net carrying value of the ROU asset at the end of the accounting period after amortisation and any impairment, as reported on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-50; IFRS 16 paragraph 53

attributes.name: rou_asset_impairment
attributes.description: Impairment loss recognised against the ROU asset during the period under ASC 360 / IAS 36, reducing the carrying value below the amortised cost.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IAS 36; IFRS 16 paragraph 33

attributes.name: rou_asset_opening_balance
attributes.description: Carrying value of the Right-of-Use (ROU) asset at the beginning of the accounting period before current-period amortisation, as required for ASC 842 / IFRS 16 roll-forward disclosure.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-50; IFRS 16 paragraph 53

attributes.name: short_term_lease_cost
attributes.description: Lease expense recognised for leases with a term of 12 months or less where the short-term practical expedient has been elected, excluded from ROU asset and lease liability recognition. Required disclosure under ASC 842-20-50-4.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-50-4; IFRS 16 paragraph 53(c)

attributes.name: straight_line_rent_expense
attributes.description: Total operating lease cost recognised on a straight-line basis over the lease term for operating leases under ASC 842, combining the amortisation of the ROU asset and the unwinding of the lease liability discount.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25-6; IFRS 16 paragraph 49

attributes.name: sublease_income
attributes.description: Income received or receivable from subleasing the right-of-use asset to a third party during the period. Required as a separate disclosure line under ASC 842-20-50-4 and IFRS 16 paragraph 53(b).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-50-4; IFRS 16 paragraph 53(b)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to this lease accounting entry record, supporting change tracking and incremental load processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: variable_lease_cost
attributes.description: Lease payments not included in the lease liability measurement that vary based on an index, rate, or usage (e.g., CPI-linked rent escalations above the initial index, percentage rent, CAM true-ups). Required disclosure under ASC 842-20-50 and IFRS 16 paragraph 53.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-50-4; IFRS 16 paragraph 53(a)

attributes.name: weighted_avg_discount_rate
attributes.description: Weighted average incremental borrowing rate or implicit rate applied across the lease portfolio as of period-end, required for ASC 842-20-50-6 and IFRS 16 paragraph 58 disclosure. Stored as a decimal (e.g., 0.048500 = 4.85%).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-50-6; IFRS 16 paragraph 58

attributes.name: weighted_avg_remaining_term_years
attributes.business_glossary_term: Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term (WALT) in Years
attributes.description: Weighted Average Lease Term (WALT) remaining as of the period-end date, expressed in years. Populated on disclosure_summary entry types for aggregated portfolio-level ASC 842 / IFRS 16 footnote disclosure.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-50-6; IFRS 16 paragraph 58

products.name: sublease
products.description: Records sublease arrangements where a primary tenant sublets all or part of their demised premises to a subtenant. Captures sublease commencement, expiration, sublet area SQF, sublease rent, subtenant identity, landlord consent date and status, sublease type (full assignment, partial sublease), profit/loss on sublease relative to head lease rent, and ASC 842 sublease classification (operating vs. finance for lessor accounting). Sourced from Yardi Voyager and DocuSign CLM. Distinct from the head lease agreement; linked to parent agreement via FK.

attributes.name: sublease_subtenant_profile_tenant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subtenant entity occupying the subleased premises. The subtenant has a direct contractual relationship with the sublessor, not the landlord.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: sublease_tenant_id
attributes.description: FK to tenant.tenant

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific leasable unit or suite being sublet. May represent a partial unit if only a portion of the demised premises is subleased.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: abstracted_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the lease abstraction analyst or team who extracted and entered the sublease terms into the system. Supports data quality auditing and abstraction accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: abstracted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sublease terms were abstracted and entered into the system. Used for data quality tracking and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: asc842_sublease_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the sublease under FASB ASC 842 from the sublessor's perspective as an intermediate lessor. 'operating' means the sublessor recognizes lease income on a straight-line basis; 'finance' means the sublessor derecognizes the underlying asset and recognizes a net investment in the sublease.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35-14; FASB ASC 842-30

attributes.name: cam_amount_annual
attributes.description: Estimated annual Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges payable by the subtenant. Relevant for NNN and modified gross sublease structures. Used for total occupancy cost analysis.
attributes.references: NAR; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CAM standard

attributes.name: cam_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges are applicable to the subtenant under the sublease terms. When true, CAM reconciliation obligations flow through from the head lease.
attributes.references: NAR; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CAM standard

attributes.name: commencement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sublease term begins and the subtenant takes possession of the subleased premises. Used as the effective start date for ASC 842 / IFRS 16 lessor accounting measurement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; IFRS 16.87

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the sublease record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: discount_rate_percent
attributes.description: The interest rate used to discount future sublease payments for ASC 842 / IFRS 16 net investment measurement. Typically the rate implicit in the sublease or the sublessor's incremental borrowing rate.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; IFRS 16.63

attributes.name: docusign_envelope_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the DocuSign CLM envelope containing the executed sublease agreement and all associated documents. Enables direct retrieval of the signed sublease document from the contract management system.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: early_termination_option
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sublease contains an early termination clause allowing either party to terminate the sublease before the scheduled expiration date. Affects ASC 842 lease term determination and WALE calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-55; IFRS 16; NAR

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sublease agreement was fully executed (signed by all parties) via DocuSign CLM or physical signature. Marks the legally binding commencement of the sublease contract.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; NAR; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which the sublease term ends. Must not extend beyond the head lease expiration date. Critical for WALT/WALE calculations and portfolio expiry scheduling.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; IFRS 16.87; WALE metric

attributes.name: free_rent_months
attributes.description: Number of months of rent abatement granted to the subtenant at the commencement of the sublease. Affects straight-line rent recognition under ASC 842 operating sublease accounting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: governing_law_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (or equivalent jurisdiction) whose laws govern the sublease agreement. Relevant for dispute resolution, regulatory compliance, and legal enforceability analysis.
attributes.references: NAR; HUD; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: head_lease_rent_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Head Lease Rent Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: The sublessor's rent obligation under the head lease expressed on a PSF basis for the subleased area. Used to calculate profit or loss on sublease relative to the head lease rent obligation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35; NOI metric; PSF metric

attributes.name: ifrs16_sublease_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the sublease under IFRS 16 from the intermediate lessor's perspective. Classification is based on the right-of-use (ROU) asset arising from the head lease, not the underlying asset. 'finance' requires recognition of a net investment in the sublease.
attributes.references: IFRS 16.87; IASB IFRS 16 Leases

attributes.name: landlord_consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the landlord formally granted written consent to the sublease arrangement. Required for sublease validity where landlord consent is mandated by the head lease.
attributes.references: NAR; DocuSign CLM; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: landlord_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the head lease requires the landlord's written consent before the sublease can be executed. Derived from the head lease assignment and subletting clause.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; NAR; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: landlord_consent_status
attributes.description: Current status of the landlord's consent process for the sublease. 'not_required' indicates the head lease permits subletting without consent; 'conditional' indicates consent granted subject to specific conditions.
attributes.references: NAR; DocuSign CLM; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: net_investment_in_sublease
attributes.description: Present value of future sublease payments plus any unguaranteed residual value, recognized on the balance sheet for finance subleases under ASC 842 / IFRS 16. Applicable only when asc842_sublease_classification or ifrs16_sublease_classification is 'finance'.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-30-30; IFRS 16.67

attributes.name: profit_loss_on_sublease
attributes.description: Net financial position of the sublease relative to the head lease rent obligation for the subleased area. Positive value indicates sublease rent exceeds head lease cost (profit); negative value indicates a loss position. Calculated as sublease rent minus allocated head lease rent for the sublet area.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35; IFRS 16.87; NOI metric

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the sublease agreement as recorded in Yardi Voyager or DocuSign CLM. Used for cross-system reconciliation and document retrieval.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: renewal_option_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sublease includes a renewal option allowing the subtenant to extend the sublease term. Relevant for WALT/WALE calculations and ASC 842 lease term reassessment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-55; IFRS 16; WALT/WALE metric

attributes.name: rent_annual
attributes.description: Total annual base rent payable by the subtenant to the sublessor under the sublease agreement. Used for NOI analysis, profit/loss on sublease calculations, and ASC 842 lessor income recognition.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35; IFRS 16.87; NOI metric

attributes.name: rent_escalation_rate
attributes.description: Annual percentage rate applied to base rent escalation where escalation type is 'fixed' or 'stepped'. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0300 = 3%). Used for cash flow modeling in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; Argus Enterprise; IFRS 16

attributes.name: rent_escalation_type
attributes.description: Method by which sublease base rent increases over the sublease term. 'fixed' applies a fixed percentage; 'cpi' ties escalation to the Consumer Price Index; 'fmv' resets to fair market value; 'stepped' uses pre-agreed step-up amounts; 'none' indicates flat rent.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; IFRS 16; NAR

attributes.name: rent_monthly
attributes.description: Monthly base rent payable by the subtenant. Derived from the annual rent schedule but stored explicitly for billing and cash flow forecasting in Yardi Voyager AR.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-35; Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: rent_psf
attributes.description: Annual base rent expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) basis for the subleased area. Key metric for market benchmarking against CoStar comparable lease data and head lease PSF comparison.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); PSF metric

attributes.name: rou_asset_allocated_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the head lease Right-of-Use (ROU) asset allocated to the subleased area for ASC 842 / IFRS 16 intermediate lessor accounting. Used to determine the carrying amount of the net investment in a finance sublease or the ROU asset derecognition amount.

attributes.name: sublease_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the sublease agreement. 'draft' indicates the sublease is being negotiated; 'pending_consent' indicates awaiting landlord approval; 'active' indicates the sublease is in force; 'expired' indicates the term has ended; 'terminated' indicates early termination; 'holdover' indicates the subtenant remains in possession beyond the sublease expiry.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: sublease_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sublease arrangement. 'full_assignment' transfers all rights and obligations of the head lease; 'partial_sublease' sublets only a portion of the demised premises; 'master_sublease' covers an entire building or multi-unit portfolio; 'short_term_sublease' is a temporary arrangement typically under 12 months.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20; IFRS 16.87; NAR

attributes.name: sublet_area_sqft
attributes.description: The net leasable area (NLA) in square feet being subleased to the subtenant. May be less than the total demised premises area under the head lease for partial subleases. Used for PSF rent calculations and GLA reporting.
attributes.references: BOMA International; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); NLA/GLA standards

attributes.name: term_months
attributes.description: Total duration of the sublease in months, calculated from commencement to expiration. Used for WALT/WALE analysis and ASC 842 lease term determination.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842-20-25; WALT/WALE metric; IFRS 16

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the sublease record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for change data capture, incremental processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: yardi_sublease_ref
attributes.description: Internal reference code assigned to the sublease record in Yardi Voyager Lease Administration. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Silver Layer lakehouse and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: abstracted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guaranty terms were abstracted from the executed document and entered into the data system. Used for data quality auditing and lease administration workflow tracking.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: amount_recovered
attributes.description: Total monetary amount actually recovered from the guarantor through enforcement, settlement, or voluntary payment. Used to calculate net credit loss on the lease.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: burn_down_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guaranty includes a contractual burn-down schedule under which the guaranteed amount reduces over time as the tenant demonstrates satisfactory lease performance.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: burn_down_interval_months
attributes.description: Frequency in months at which the guaranteed amount is reduced per the burn-down schedule (e.g., 12 for annual reductions). Null if burn-down is not applicable.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: burn_down_reduction_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount by which the guaranteed exposure is reduced at each burn-down interval. Used when the burn-down is amount-based rather than percentage-based.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: burn_down_reduction_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the original guaranteed amount by which exposure is reduced at each burn-down interval. Used when the burn-down is percentage-based rather than fixed-amount-based. Stored as a decimal (e.g., 0.25 = 25%).
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: burn_down_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guaranty burn-down schedule commences. Typically tied to a lease anniversary or a performance milestone such as rent payment history.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this guaranty record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: credit_risk_rating
attributes.description: Internal credit risk classification assigned to the guarantor based on financial statement review, credit bureau data, and underwriting analysis. Drives portfolio-level credit risk reporting and reserve calculations.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); SEC; SOX

attributes.name: current_guaranteed_amount
attributes.description: Present outstanding guaranteed amount after applying any burn-down reductions, partial releases, or enforcement recoveries. Reflects the landlord's current credit risk exposure under this guaranty.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: docusign_envelope_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the DocuSign CLM envelope containing the executed guaranty instrument. Enables direct retrieval of the signed document from the contract lifecycle management system.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the guaranty obligation becomes operative and enforceable. May differ from execution date if the guaranty contains a deferred commencement provision.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: enforcement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the landlord formally initiated enforcement action against the guarantor (e.g., date of demand letter or filing of legal claim).
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: enforcement_status
attributes.description: Current status of any enforcement action taken against the guarantor. 'demand_issued' indicates a formal demand letter has been sent; 'litigation' indicates legal proceedings are active; 'recovered' indicates full or partial recovery has been achieved.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guaranty instrument was fully executed (all parties signed). This is the principal business event date establishing the guaranty as legally binding.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guaranty obligation terminates by its own terms, independent of lease expiry. Null for guaranties that run co-terminus with the lease or until full performance.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: financial_covenant_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guaranty requires the guarantor to maintain specified financial covenants (e.g., minimum net worth, minimum liquidity ratio, maximum leverage). Critical for ongoing credit risk monitoring.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); SOX; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: financial_statement_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency at which the guarantor must deliver financial statements to the landlord for covenant compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); SOX

attributes.name: good_guy_notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days of advance written notice the tenant must provide to the landlord to trigger the good-guy guaranty release clause. Applicable only when guaranty_type is 'good_guy'.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: good_guy_vacate_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the tenant vacated the premises and surrendered possession, triggering the good-guy guaranty release. Populated upon confirmed surrender.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: governing_law_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (or equivalent jurisdiction code) specifying the governing law under which the guaranty instrument is interpreted and enforced. Critical for legal enforcement strategy.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); ALTA

attributes.name: guaranteed_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary exposure covered by the guaranty at inception. For full guaranties, this equals the total lease obligation value; for limited guaranties, this is the capped dollar amount. Expressed in the lease currency.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: guaranteed_months
attributes.description: Number of months of lease obligations covered by the guaranty. Used for limited and rolling guaranty types where exposure is defined by a time window rather than a fixed dollar amount.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: guarantor_legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the guarantor as stated in the executed guaranty instrument. For corporate guarantors, this is the registered entity name; for individuals, the full legal name as on government-issued ID.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; GDPR Article 4; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: guarantor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guarantor entity. 'individual' is a natural person; 'corporate_parent' is the tenant's parent company; 'affiliate' is a related entity; 'third_party_entity' is an unrelated corporate guarantor; 'personal' is a principal/owner of the tenant entity providing a personal guarantee.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: guaranty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the guaranty obligation. 'active' indicates the guaranty is in force; 'burned_down' indicates the guaranteed amount has been reduced per schedule; 'enforced' indicates a claim has been made against the guarantor; 'released' indicates the landlord has formally discharged the guarantor.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: guaranty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guaranty structure. 'full' covers all lease obligations for the full term; 'limited' caps exposure by amount or period; 'good_guy' releases guarantor upon tenant vacating and providing notice; 'rolling' covers a fixed rolling window of rent; 'springing' activates only upon a defined trigger event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: full|limited|good_guy|rolling|springing|burn_down|completion — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: last_financial_statement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recently received guarantor financial statement. Used to track compliance with financial reporting covenants and assess current creditworthiness.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; SOX

attributes.name: min_net_worth_covenant
attributes.description: Minimum net worth the guarantor must maintain throughout the guaranty term as a financial covenant condition. Breach of this threshold may constitute a guaranty default or trigger a springing guaranty.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); SOX; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, enforcement history narrative, or legal counsel observations regarding this guaranty that do not fit structured fields.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: personal_guarantee_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this guaranty is a personal guarantee provided by an individual (principal, officer, or owner of the tenant entity) as opposed to a corporate or entity guarantee. Drives different enforcement and credit risk treatment.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the guaranty instrument, typically assigned by DocuSign CLM or Yardi Voyager at execution. Used for cross-system reconciliation and legal document referencing.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the landlord formally released the guarantor from all obligations under the guaranty instrument. Populated when guaranty_status transitions to 'released'.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: release_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for the formal release of the guarantor. Tracks whether release was triggered by lease expiry, early termination, good-guy clause activation, full burn-down, landlord waiver, or lease assignment to a creditworthy assignee.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: springing_trigger_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the condition(s) that activate a springing guaranty (e.g., tenant credit rating downgrade below investment grade, tenant default on another obligation, change of control). Applicable only when guaranty_type is 'springing'.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this guaranty record in the Silver layer. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000

attributes.name: yardi_guaranty_ref
attributes.description: Source system reference identifier for this guaranty record in Yardi Voyager. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

domains.name: transaction
domains.description: Records all property acquisition, disposition, and sale events — purchase agreements, closing statements, title transfers (ALTA), REO transactions, 1031 exchanges, and financing transactions. Tracks deal economics including PSF pricing, LTV ratios, earnest money, cash flows, and settlement details. Integrates with MLS and CoStar comparable sales data.

products.name: property_sale
products.description: Core master record for every property sale or disposition transaction — acquisition, disposition, REO sale, short sale, portfolio trade, or sale-leaseback — capturing executed purchase price, PSF pricing, earnest money terms, closing date, deal type classification, transaction status, and key deal economics (price, PSF, cap rate). Serves as the SSOT hub to which all transaction detail entities (PSA, closing statement, title, deed, financing, escrow, due diligence, parties, offers, documents) are linked via FK. Sourced from Yardi Voyager and CoStar comparable sales data.

attributes.name: buyer_name

attributes.name: cap_rate

attributes.name: closing_date

attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; IFRS 15; ALTA (American Land Title Association)

attributes.name: contingency_removed
attributes.description: Indicates whether all contractual contingencies have been formally waived or satisfied, making the transaction firm and non-refundable. True = all contingencies removed; False = contingencies still active.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: contingency_type
attributes.description: Primary contingency type governing the buyer's right to terminate the purchase agreement without penalty. Common types include financing, inspection, appraisal, title, and environmental contingencies.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: contract_date
attributes.description: Date on which the purchase and sale agreement (PSA) was fully executed by all parties. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the transaction lifecycle.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: costar_comp_code
attributes.description: CoStar Suite comparable sale identifier linking this transaction to the CoStar market database for benchmarking, comparable sales analysis, and market research.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the property sale record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking per SOX Section 404 controls.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: deed_recorded_date
attributes.description: Date on which the deed was officially recorded with the county recorder or registrar of deeds, establishing the public record of title transfer.
attributes.references: ALTA; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: deed_type
attributes.description: Type of deed instrument used to convey title from seller to buyer. Determines the scope of title warranties provided. Common types include warranty, special warranty, quitclaim, grant, and bargain and sale deeds.
attributes.references: ALTA; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: due_diligence_end_date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the buyer must complete all due diligence inspections, reviews, and investigations and either proceed with or terminate the transaction.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 805

attributes.name: earnest_money_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of earnest money deposit submitted by the buyer upon execution of the purchase and sale agreement (PSA), held in escrow pending closing.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); ALTA

attributes.name: earnest_money_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the earnest money deposit must be received and confirmed in escrow per the terms of the purchase and sale agreement.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); ALTA

attributes.name: earnest_money_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the earnest money deposit has been received and confirmed in escrow. True = received; False = not yet received.

attributes.name: escrow_company
attributes.description: Name of the escrow company or closing agent holding funds and documents in trust during the transaction period between contract execution and closing.
attributes.references: ALTA; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: exchange_deadline_date
attributes.description: Statutory deadline by which the replacement property must be identified and acquired to qualify for 1031 like-kind exchange tax deferral treatment. Applicable only when is_1031_exchange is True.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: expected_closing_date
attributes.description: Projected date on which the transaction is anticipated to close, as tracked in the deal pipeline. Used for cash flow forecasting and portfolio planning in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: financing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the financing structure used to fund the acquisition. Includes all-cash, conventional, Adjustable Rate Mortgage (ARM), Fixed Rate Mortgage (FRM), Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities (CMBS), seller financing, loan assumption, or bridge financing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all_cash|conventional|arm|frm|cmbs|seller_financing|assumption|bridge — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; CMBS/RMBS standards; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.description: Gross Leasable Area (GLA) of the property in square feet (SQF) at the time of sale, used as the denominator for PSF pricing calculations and CoStar comparable benchmarking.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite; BOMA International

attributes.name: is_1031_exchange
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction is structured as a 1031 like-kind exchange under IRS Section 1031, deferring capital gains tax recognition. True = 1031 exchange; False = standard sale.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; FASB ASC 740; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: loan_amount
attributes.description: Total debt financing amount secured for the property acquisition. Used in conjunction with LTV ratio and DSCR calculations for investment underwriting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio at the time of sale, calculated as the total debt financing divided by the purchase price. Key underwriting metric for lenders and investment committees.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; SEC Regulation S-X; CMBS/RMBS underwriting standards

attributes.name: net_sale_price
attributes.description: Net proceeds from the property sale after deducting seller concessions, credits, prorations, and closing cost adjustments from the gross purchase price.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: noi_at_sale
attributes.description: Net Operating Income (NOI) of the property at the time of sale, used to derive the implied CAP Rate and support investment return analysis in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: price_psf
attributes.description: Executed sale price expressed on a Per Square Foot (PSF) basis, calculated as purchase price divided by the property's gross leasable area. Key benchmarking metric for CoStar comparable sales analysis.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite

attributes.name: purchase_price
attributes.description: Gross executed purchase price of the property as agreed in the purchase and sale agreement (PSA). Represents the total consideration paid before adjustments, credits, or prorations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 805; IFRS 3; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: recording_number
attributes.description: Official document recording number assigned by the county recorder upon deed recordation, serving as the public record reference for the title transfer.
attributes.references: ALTA; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: seller_concessions_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar value of concessions granted by the seller to the buyer, including closing cost credits, repair allowances, and price reductions negotiated post-inspection.

attributes.name: title_company
attributes.description: Name of the title insurance company responsible for conducting the title search, issuing the ALTA title commitment, and facilitating the closing and deed recordation.
attributes.references: ALTA (American Land Title Association); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: transaction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing material deal notes, special conditions, negotiation context, or other qualitative information relevant to the property sale transaction.
