attributes.references: CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deed transfer record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: deed_type
attributes.description: Classification of the deed instrument conveying ownership. Warranty deeds provide full title guarantees; quitclaim deeds convey only the grantor's interest without warranty; trustee deeds arise from foreclosure or trust sales; special warranty deeds limit the grantor's warranty to the period of their ownership. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: warranty|special_warranty|quitclaim|trustee|grant|bargain_and_sale|sheriff|tax — promote to reference product if additional types required]
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Uniform Commercial Code (UCC); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Official document number assigned by the county recorder or registrar of deeds upon recording. Used as the primary external reference for title searches and ALTA title commitments.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: earnest_money_amount
attributes.description: Amount of earnest money deposit paid by the buyer (grantee) at the time of the purchase agreement execution, applied toward the consideration at closing. Tracked for deal economics reconciliation and escrow management.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: exchange_1031_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deed transfer is part of a tax-deferred like-kind exchange under IRC Section 1031. When true, the transaction is subject to strict identification and exchange period deadlines and requires qualified intermediary documentation.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) — IRC Section 1031; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the grantor signed and executed the deed instrument, which may precede the recording date. Relevant for determining the effective date of conveyance and for 1031 exchange identification period calculations.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) — IRC Section 1031; American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: foreclosure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deed transfer resulted from a foreclosure proceeding (e.g., sheriff's deed, trustee's deed upon sale). Distinct from REO flag — foreclosure flag marks the transfer event itself, while REO flag marks lender-owned status.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: grantor_entity_type
attributes.description: Legal entity classification of the grantor. Determines applicable transfer tax exemptions, 1031 exchange eligibility, and FIRPTA withholding requirements for foreign sellers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|corporation|llc|trust|partnership|government|reit|estate|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) — FIRPTA; IRC Section 1031; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: instrument_number
attributes.description: Sequential instrument or reception number assigned by the recorder's office at the time of recording, distinct from the document number in jurisdictions that use both. Provides an alternative lookup key for title searches.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: legal_description
attributes.description: Full legal description of the real property as it appears on the recorded deed, including metes and bounds, lot and block, or government survey description. Defines the exact parcel boundaries conveyed and is required for ALTA title insurance commitments.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio at the time of the deed transfer, calculated as the mortgage loan amount divided by the consideration amount. Key underwriting metric for CMBS, RMBS, and lender risk assessment. Stored as a decimal (e.g., 0.75 = 75%).
attributes.references: Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA); CMBS/RMBS Underwriting Standards; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: mls_transaction_code
attributes.description: Transaction identifier from the Multiple Listing Service (MLS) system associated with this deed transfer. Enables cross-referencing with MLS comparable sales data and CoStar Suite for market analytics and CMA reporting.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR) — MLS Policy

attributes.name: mortgage_amount
attributes.description: Principal amount of the mortgage or deed of trust loan recorded concurrently with the deed transfer. Used for LTV calculation, DSCR analysis, and CMBS/RMBS portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA); FASB ASC 310; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: notary_commission_expiry
attributes.description: Expiration date of the notary public's commission at the time of deed execution. Validates that the notarization was performed by a duly commissioned notary, which is required for deed recordability.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); State Notary Statutes

attributes.name: notary_name
attributes.description: Name of the notary public who acknowledged the grantor's signature on the deed instrument. Required for deed validity in most US jurisdictions and referenced in ALTA title review.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); State Notary Statutes

attributes.name: page_number
attributes.description: Page number within the deed book where the recorded deed instrument begins. Together with book number, provides the complete recorder's reference citation for chain-of-title research.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: price_per_sqf
attributes.description: Sale price expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) basis, calculated as consideration amount divided by the property's gross leasable area (GLA) or building area. Key metric for comparable sales analysis (CMA), CoStar benchmarking, and investment underwriting.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deed was officially recorded with the county recorder or registrar of deeds. This date establishes constructive notice of the ownership transfer and is the legally operative date for title chain-of-title purposes.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: recording_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee paid to the county recorder or registrar of deeds for the official recording of the deed instrument. Included in closing cost reconciliation and CAPEX tracking for acquisition cost basis.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 805 Business Combinations

attributes.name: reo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deed transfer involves a Real Estate Owned (REO) property — real property acquired by a lender through foreclosure. REO transactions require special handling for CMBS reporting and distressed asset analytics.
attributes.references: Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this deed transfer record was ingested (e.g., Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, Argus Enterprise, CoStar Suite, or manual entry). Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Data Lineage; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state (or equivalent jurisdiction) code where the property is located and the deed was recorded. Used for state-level transfer tax calculation, regulatory compliance, and geographic portfolio segmentation.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: title_company_name
attributes.description: Name of the title insurance company or title agency that conducted the closing, issued the ALTA title commitment, and facilitated the deed recording. Used for vendor management and title claim tracking.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the deed transfer. Pending indicates the deed has been executed but not yet submitted for recording; Recorded confirms the county recorder has accepted and stamped the instrument; Rejected indicates the recorder returned the deed for correction; Voided indicates the transfer was rescinded prior to recording.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: transfer_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total real estate transfer tax (also known as deed tax, documentary stamp tax, or conveyance tax) paid at closing, as recorded on the deed or closing statement. Calculated based on consideration amount and applicable state/county tax rates. Required for SOX financial controls and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); State Revenue Authorities; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the ownership transfer. Sale indicates a market-rate conveyance; Gift and Inheritance indicate non-monetary transfers; Exchange covers 1031 like-kind exchanges; Intra-entity covers transfers between related legal entities; Court Order covers judicial transfers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sale|gift|inheritance|foreclosure|exchange|intra_entity|court_order|partition — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deed transfer record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports incremental data processing, change data capture, and audit trail requirements under SOX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: vesting_type
attributes.description: Form of title vesting under which the grantee takes ownership (e.g., sole ownership, joint tenancy with right of survivorship, tenancy in common, community property, trust, or entity ownership). Determines ownership rights, survivorship, and disposition requirements.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: escrow_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender requires the borrower to maintain an escrow account for property taxes, insurance, and/or capital reserves as a condition of the loan.

attributes.name: escrow_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Total amount held in escrow reserve accounts (taxes, insurance, capital reserves) as required by the lender at the time of reporting.

attributes.name: extension_option_count
attributes.description: Number of extension options available to the borrower to extend the loan maturity beyond the initial term, subject to conditions. Common in bridge and construction loans.

attributes.name: extension_period_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of each extension option available to the borrower. Multiplied by extension_option_count to determine maximum extended loan term.

attributes.name: financing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the financing arrangement. Tracks progression from initial commitment through funding, assumption of existing debt, full payoff, or cancellation.

attributes.name: first_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the first scheduled debt service payment (principal and/or interest) is due under the loan agreement.

attributes.name: funding_date
attributes.description: Date on which loan proceeds were disbursed to the borrower or escrow at closing. May differ from origination date for construction loans with draw schedules.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; ALTA; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: index_rate_type

attributes.name: interest_only_period_months

attributes.name: interest_rate

attributes.description: Indicates whether this financing record represents the assumption of existing seller debt rather than new origination. True when the buyer assumes the seller's existing loan at closing.

attributes.name: lien_position
attributes.description: Priority position of the lender's lien on the collateral property. First lien has senior claim; mezzanine and subordinate positions carry higher risk and typically higher rates.
attributes.references: ALTA; FASB ASC 310; CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: loan_amount
attributes.description: Original principal amount of the loan at origination or assumption, expressed in the transaction currency. Used in LTV, DSCR, and debt service calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; IVSC; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: loan_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned loan reference number issued by the lender or servicer, used for cross-referencing with lender systems and CMBS/RMBS reporting.

attributes.name: loan_term_months

attributes.name: origination_date

attributes.name: origination_fee_amount

attributes.name: origination_fee_pct

attributes.name: boot_amount
attributes.description: Total boot received in the exchange — any non-like-kind property or cash received that does not qualify for tax deferral. Includes cash boot (net cash received) and mortgage boot (net debt relief). Boot triggers immediate taxable gain recognition.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(b); IRS Form 8824 Part III; Treasury Regulation 1.1031(b)-1

attributes.name: boot_type
attributes.description: Classification of boot received in the exchange: none (fully deferred), cash (net cash received), mortgage_relief (net debt reduction), or mixed (combination of cash and mortgage relief). Determines the nature of taxable gain recognition.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(b); Treasury Regulation 1.1031(b)-1; IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this 1031 exchange record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 842; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: deferred_gain
attributes.description: The portion of realized gain deferred for tax purposes under IRS Section 1031 — calculated as realized gain minus recognized gain. This deferred gain reduces the tax basis of the replacement property and is recognized upon future disposition.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(d); IRS Form 8824 Part III; IRC Section 1245/1250 recapture

attributes.name: exchange_agreement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal exchange agreement was executed between the taxpayer and the Qualified Intermediary (QI). Must be entered into before the taxpayer transfers the relinquished property to qualify as a valid delayed exchange.
attributes.references: Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(g)(4); IRS Form 8824; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: exchange_closing_deadline
attributes.description: The IRS-mandated deadline by which the taxpayer must close on the replacement property — exactly 180 calendar days from the relinquished property closing date (or the due date of the tax return, whichever is earlier). Failure disqualifies the exchange.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(a)(3)(B); Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(c)

attributes.name: exchange_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the 1031 exchange transaction, typically assigned by the Qualified Intermediary (QI) or internal deal tracking system. Used for cross-referencing with QI documentation and IRS Form 8824 filings.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; IRS Form 8824; Yardi Voyager Transaction Module

attributes.name: exchange_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the 1031 exchange transaction. Tracks progression from initiation through identification period, replacement property acquisition, and final IRS compliance determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initiated|identification_period|replacement_pending|completed|failed|cancelled — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: exchange_type
attributes.description: Classification of the 1031 exchange structure: simultaneous (same-day swap), delayed (Starker exchange with QI), reverse (replacement acquired before relinquishment), or improvement/construction (build-to-suit exchange). Determines applicable IRS deadlines and QI escrow requirements.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; IRS Revenue Procedure 2000-37 (reverse exchanges); IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: form_8824_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS Form 8824 (Like-Kind Exchanges) has been filed with the IRS for this exchange transaction. Required for all 1031 exchanges in the tax year of the relinquished property transfer.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824; IRS Section 1031; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: form_8824_filed_date
attributes.description: The date on which IRS Form 8824 was filed with the IRS for this exchange. Used for compliance tracking and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824; IRS Section 1031

attributes.name: identification_deadline
attributes.description: The IRS-mandated deadline by which the taxpayer must identify potential replacement properties — exactly 45 calendar days from the relinquished property closing date. Failure to meet this deadline disqualifies the exchange.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(a)(3)(A); Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(b)

attributes.name: identification_rule
attributes.description: The IRS identification rule elected by the taxpayer for designating replacement properties: three_property (up to 3 properties regardless of value), two_hundred_percent (any number of properties with combined FMV ≤ 200% of relinquished FMV), or ninety_five_percent (any number if 95% of total FMV is actually acquired).
attributes.references: Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(c)(4); IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: The date on which the 1031 exchange was formally initiated, typically the closing date of the relinquished property sale. This date anchors the 45-day identification deadline and 180-day closing deadline under IRS rules.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; IRS Form 8824; Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1

attributes.name: irs_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current IRS compliance determination for the 1031 exchange: pending (exchange in progress), compliant (all IRS requirements met), non_compliant (deadline missed or disqualifying event), or under_review (IRS audit or inquiry in progress).
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; IRS Form 8824; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: like_kind_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether both the relinquished and replacement properties have been confirmed as qualifying like-kind real property under IRS Section 1031. Must be True for the exchange to qualify for tax deferral.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(a)(1); Treasury Regulation 1.1031(a)-1; IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special circumstances, legal counsel notes, or operational remarks related to the 1031 exchange. Examples include reverse exchange parking arrangements, improvement exchange construction details, or IRS correspondence notes.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Transaction Module; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: qi_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account or escrow account number held by the Qualified Intermediary (QI) where exchange proceeds from the relinquished property sale are deposited and held pending acquisition of the replacement property.
attributes.references: Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(g)(4); IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: qi_fund_balance
attributes.description: Current balance of exchange proceeds held by the Qualified Intermediary (QI) in escrow. Tracks available funds for replacement property acquisition. Decreases as replacement property closings occur.
attributes.references: Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(g)(4); Yardi Voyager GL Module

attributes.name: qi_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the Qualified Intermediary (QI) — the independent third party that holds exchange proceeds and facilitates the transfer to prevent constructive receipt by the taxpayer. Required for delayed, reverse, and improvement exchanges.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(g)(4); IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: realized_gain
attributes.description: Total economic gain realized on the relinquished property sale, calculated as the amount realized (sale price minus selling expenses) less the adjusted tax basis. Represents the total gain before deferral. Reported on IRS Form 8824 Part III.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part III; IRC Section 1001; IRS Publication 544

attributes.name: recognized_gain
attributes.description: Portion of the realized gain that is taxable in the current tax year — equal to the lesser of the realized gain or the boot received. If no boot is received, recognized gain is zero. Reported on IRS Form 8824 Part III.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(b); IRS Form 8824 Part III; IRC Section 1001

attributes.name: relinquished_adjusted_basis
attributes.description: The taxpayer's adjusted cost basis in the relinquished property at the time of exchange, accounting for original acquisition cost, capital improvements, and accumulated depreciation. Critical input for deferred gain calculation on IRS Form 8824.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part III; IRS Publication 544; IRC Section 1012

attributes.name: relinquished_closing_date
attributes.description: The actual closing/settlement date on which the relinquished property was transferred to the buyer. This is the trigger date for the 45-day and 180-day IRS exchange deadlines.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; IRS Form 8824 Part I; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: relinquished_mortgage_balance
attributes.description: Outstanding mortgage or debt balance on the relinquished property at the time of closing. Mortgage relief received by the taxpayer is treated as boot received and may trigger taxable gain recognition.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part III; Treasury Regulation 1.1031(b)-1(c)

attributes.name: relinquished_property_address
attributes.description: Full street address of the relinquished (down-leg) property being exchanged. Captured directly on the exchange record for IRS Form 8824 reporting and audit trail purposes, independent of the property master record.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part I; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: relinquished_sale_price
attributes.description: Gross sale price received for the relinquished property at closing, as reported on the settlement statement. Used as the basis for deferred gain calculation and boot determination on IRS Form 8824.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part III; FASB ASC 840/842; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: replacement_basis
attributes.description: The carryover tax basis assigned to the replacement property after the exchange, calculated as the replacement property's cost minus the deferred gain. This basis is used for future depreciation calculations and gain recognition upon eventual sale.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(d); IRS Form 8824 Part III; IRS Publication 544

attributes.name: replacement_closing_date
attributes.description: The actual closing/settlement date on which the replacement property was acquired. Must occur on or before the 180-day exchange closing deadline to qualify for tax deferral.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031(a)(3)(B); IRS Form 8824 Part II; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: replacement_mortgage_balance
attributes.description: New mortgage or debt assumed on the replacement property at acquisition. Mortgage assumed by the taxpayer offsets boot received from mortgage relief on the relinquished property in the net boot calculation.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part III; Treasury Regulation 1.1031(b)-1(c)

attributes.name: replacement_property_address
attributes.description: Full street address of the primary replacement (up-leg) property acquired in the exchange. Captured directly on the exchange record for IRS Form 8824 reporting and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part II; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: replacement_property_count
attributes.description: Number of replacement properties formally identified within the 45-day identification period. Must comply with the elected identification rule (e.g., maximum 3 under the three-property rule). Used for IRS compliance validation.
attributes.references: Treasury Regulation 1.1031(k)-1(c); IRS Form 8824

attributes.name: replacement_purchase_price
attributes.description: Gross purchase price paid for the replacement property at closing. Must equal or exceed the relinquished property sale price for full gain deferral. Used in boot calculation and IRS Form 8824 Part III reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part III; ALTA Settlement Statement

attributes.name: selling_expenses
attributes.description: Total transaction costs incurred in selling the relinquished property, including brokerage commissions, title fees, legal fees, and transfer taxes. Reduces the amount realized for gain calculation purposes on IRS Form 8824.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824 Part III; ALTA Settlement Statement; IRS Publication 544

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The IRS tax year in which the 1031 exchange is reported on Form 8824. Typically the year in which the relinquished property was transferred. Used for tax filing and financial period alignment.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824; IRS Publication 544; FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: taxpayer_ein
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number (TIN) of the entity executing the exchange. Required for IRS Form 8824 filing and tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8824; IRS Section 6109; GDPR Article 4 (for EU entities)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this 1031 exchange record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data synchronization with source systems (Yardi Voyager, MRI Software).
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Transaction Module

attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC)

attributes.name: buyer_agent_license_number
attributes.description: The state-issued real estate license number of the buyer's agent. Required for regulatory compliance and commission disbursement verification.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Commission Regulations

attributes.name: buyer_agent_name
attributes.description: The name of the licensed real estate agent or broker representing the buyer in this transaction. Used for commission split calculations and co-broker agreement tracking.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: competing_offer_count
attributes.description: The number of competing offers disclosed by the seller or known to the listing agent at the time this offer was submitted. Used in multi-offer analytics and negotiation strategy reporting.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Salesforce CRM — Deal Pipeline

attributes.name: competing_offer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the seller has disclosed the existence of one or more competing offers on the same property at the time this offer was submitted. Supports multi-offer scenario management and deal pipeline analytics.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR) — Code of Ethics; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: counter_offer_number
attributes.description: Sequential counter indicating which round of negotiation this offer record represents (1 = original offer, 2 = first counter, 3 = second counter, etc.). Supports negotiation history tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Deal Pipeline; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this offer record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: docusign_envelope_code
attributes.description: The unique envelope identifier from DocuSign CLM for the digitally executed offer document. Enables traceability between the offer record and the executed contract lifecycle management system.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Contract Lifecycle Management; ESIGN Act; UETA

attributes.name: due_diligence_period_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days requested by the buyer for due diligence activities including title review, environmental assessment, financial analysis, and physical inspection. Particularly relevant for commercial real estate (CRE) transactions.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); ALTA — American Land Title Association; EPA Environmental Compliance

attributes.name: earnest_money_amount
attributes.description: The good-faith deposit amount offered by the buyer to demonstrate commitment to the transaction. Held in escrow pending closing or offer disposition.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: earnest_money_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the buyer must deliver the earnest money deposit to the escrow or title company.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: escalation_ceiling_price
attributes.description: The maximum purchase price the buyer is willing to pay under the escalation clause. The offer will not escalate beyond this ceiling regardless of competing offers.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: escalation_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the offer contains an escalation clause that automatically increases the offer price above competing offers up to a defined ceiling. Critical for multi-offer scenario management.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: escalation_increment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount by which the offer price will automatically escalate above a competing offer when an escalation clause is active. Null when escalation_clause_flag is false.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date and time by which the seller must respond to the offer before it automatically expires. Critical for multi-offer scenario management.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: financing_contingency_amount
attributes.description: The maximum loan amount the buyer is seeking to finance. If the buyer cannot secure financing up to this amount, the contingency allows withdrawal without forfeiting earnest money. Supports LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio analysis.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: financing_type
attributes.description: The type of financing the buyer intends to use to fund the purchase. Distinguishes all-cash offers from financed offers and identifies loan program type (e.g., FHA, VA, ARM — Adjustable Rate Mortgage, Conventional).
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: inspection_contingency_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days from offer acceptance during which the buyer has the right to conduct property inspections and withdraw without penalty if findings are unsatisfactory.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: inspection_contingency_end_date
attributes.description: The absolute calendar date on which the inspection contingency period expires. Derived from offer acceptance date plus inspection_contingency_days; stored explicitly for operational tracking.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: is_1031_exchange
attributes.description: Indicates whether the buyer intends to use this acquisition as part of a 1031 like-kind exchange to defer capital gains taxes. Affects transaction timeline and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031 Like-Kind Exchange; SEC — for publicly traded REITs

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: The Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio expressed as a percentage, derived from the financing contingency amount relative to the offer price. Key underwriting metric used in investment analysis and lender qualification.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310 Receivables; SEC Regulation S-X for REITs

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing additional terms, special conditions, personal property inclusions/exclusions, or negotiation notes associated with this offer that are not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: offer_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the buyer formally submitted the purchase offer. Principal business event date for the offer lifecycle.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: offer_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for the offer, used in correspondence, Salesforce CRM deal tracking, and closing documentation. Format: OFF-YYYYMMDD-NNNN.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Deal Pipeline; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: offer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the purchase offer. Tracks progression from initial submission through counter, acceptance, rejection, or buyer withdrawal. Drives deal pipeline reporting in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Deal Pipeline; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: pre_approval_amount
attributes.description: The maximum loan amount for which the buyer has received a lender pre-approval letter. Validates the buyer's financial capacity relative to the offer price.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: The gross purchase price proposed by the buyer in the offer. Base monetary amount before any concessions or adjustments. Used in PSF (Per Square Foot) pricing analytics and comparable sales benchmarking via CoStar.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement

attributes.name: price_psf
attributes.description: The offered purchase price expressed on a Per Square Foot (PSF) basis, calculated from offer_price divided by the property's GLA or NLA. Enables direct comparison against CoStar comparable sales benchmarks and market PSF rates.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite — Comparable Sales Data; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: proof_of_funds_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the buyer has provided and the listing agent has verified proof of funds or mortgage pre-approval sufficient to support the offer price. Critical qualifier for offer strength assessment.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: proposed_closing_date
attributes.description: The target closing date proposed by the buyer in the offer. Used for deal timeline planning and pipeline forecasting in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for offer rejection or withdrawal. Used in deal pipeline analytics and negotiation strategy reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: price_too_low|competing_offer_accepted|contingencies|financing_concerns|buyer_withdrew|other — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Deal Pipeline; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: sale_contingency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the offer is contingent on the buyer successfully selling their existing property before closing. A key risk factor in multi-offer scenario evaluation.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: salesforce_opportunity_code
attributes.description: The Salesforce CRM Opportunity record ID linked to this offer, enabling bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the CRM deal pipeline.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Deal Pipeline; Brokerage Activity Tracking

attributes.name: seller_concessions_amount
attributes.description: The dollar value of concessions requested from the seller in this offer, such as closing cost credits, repair allowances, or Tenant Improvement (TI) contributions. Reduces the net effective purchase price.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this offer record was last modified. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer pipeline and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

products.name: escrow_account
products.description: Manages escrow accounts and the complete ledger of fund movements for property transactions — earnest money deposits, impound holds, disbursements (commissions, title fees, transfer taxes, loan payoffs, net proceeds), and releases. Captures escrow account number, escrow holder, escrow type (purchase, impound, reserve), opening balance, current balance, and account status. Each fund event records date, payee/payor, amount, payment method, reference number, authorization status, and release conditions. Provides a complete audit trail from account opening through final disbursement. Integrates with Yardi Voyager AP/AR for trust account reconciliation.

attributes.name: actual_closing_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the escrow account was closed and all funds were fully disbursed. Null until closure is complete.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Total brokerage commission amount to be disbursed from escrow at closing, covering both listing and buyer's agent sides as specified in the commission instructions.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this escrow account record was first created in the system, providing the audit trail start point for SOX compliance and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The current fund balance in the escrow account reflecting all deposits received and disbursements made to date. Reconciled against Yardi Voyager trust account ledger.

attributes.name: earnest_money_amount
attributes.description: The amount of earnest money deposited by the buyer into escrow as a good-faith deposit per the purchase agreement. Tracked separately for contingency release and forfeiture analysis.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: earnest_money_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the earnest money deposit was received and confirmed in the escrow account.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: earnest_money_status
attributes.description: Current disposition status of the earnest money deposit: pending (not yet received), received (in escrow), applied (credited toward purchase price at closing), refunded (returned to buyer), or forfeited (retained by seller upon buyer default).
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: escrow_holder_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the escrow holder entity (title company, escrow company, or attorney) responsible for managing and disbursing funds. Corresponds to the escrow_company field in property_sale.
attributes.references: ALTA (American Land Title Association); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: escrow_officer_email
attributes.description: Email address of the escrow officer for communication and document delivery purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ALTA (American Land Title Association)

attributes.name: escrow_officer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual escrow officer or closing agent at the escrow holder entity who is responsible for managing this account.
attributes.references: ALTA (American Land Title Association)

attributes.name: escrow_officer_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number of the escrow officer for transaction coordination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ALTA (American Land Title Association)

attributes.name: exchange_deadline_date
attributes.description: The IRS-mandated deadline by which replacement property must be identified (45-day rule) or acquired (180-day rule) for a 1031 exchange. Null for non-exchange accounts.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031

attributes.name: expected_closing_date
attributes.description: The anticipated date on which all escrow conditions will be satisfied and final disbursements will be made. Used for pipeline tracking and settlement scheduling.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: impound_insurance_amount
attributes.description: Amount held in impound/reserve within the escrow account for property insurance premium obligations. Applicable for impound-type escrow accounts.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: impound_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount held in impound/reserve within the escrow account for property tax obligations. Applicable for impound-type escrow accounts associated with mortgage servicing.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: is_1031_exchange
attributes.description: Indicates whether this escrow account is associated with an IRS Section 1031 tax-deferred exchange transaction, requiring a qualified intermediary and strict timeline compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; SEC regulatory reporting for REITs

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date

attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager AP/AR

attributes.name: loan_payoff_amount
attributes.description: The total amount required to satisfy and discharge the seller's existing mortgage or deed of trust from escrow proceeds at closing.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; ALTA (American Land Title Association); CMBS (Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities) standards

attributes.name: net_proceeds_amount
attributes.description: The net amount to be disbursed to the seller after deducting loan payoffs, commissions, title fees, transfer taxes, and other closing costs from the purchase price.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; ALTA (American Land Title Association); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for escrow officer or transaction coordinator notes regarding special instructions, exceptions, amendments, or conditions not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: opening_balance
attributes.description: The initial fund balance at the time the escrow account was opened, typically representing the earnest money deposit or initial impound amount.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager AP/AR Trust Account

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: The date on which the escrow account was formally opened and became active for receiving funds. Marks the start of the escrow lifecycle.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: purchase_price
attributes.description: The agreed-upon contract purchase price for the property transaction that this escrow account supports. Used to validate that total funds received are sufficient for closing.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: qualified_intermediary_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the qualified intermediary holding exchange proceeds for a 1031 exchange escrow. Required by IRS regulations to maintain tax-deferred status.
attributes.references: IRS Section 1031; SEC regulatory reporting

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current reconciliation status of the escrow account against the trust account ledger: reconciled (balances match), unreconciled (discrepancy identified), in_progress (reconciliation underway), or exception (requires manual resolution).
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager AP/AR

attributes.name: release_authorization_status
attributes.description: Current authorization status for fund release from escrow: pending (awaiting authorization), authorized (all parties have approved disbursement), partially_authorized (some disbursements approved), or rejected (authorization denied).
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FASB ASC 842; ALTA (American Land Title Association)

attributes.name: release_conditions

attributes.name: title_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total title insurance premium and title-related fees (search, examination, endorsements) to be disbursed from escrow at closing per the ALTA settlement statement.

attributes.name: total_deposits

attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager AP/AR; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: total_disbursements
attributes.description: Cumulative sum of all funds disbursed from the escrow account since opening, including commissions, title fees, transfer taxes, loan payoffs, and net proceeds to seller.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager AP/AR; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: transfer_tax_amount
attributes.description: State and local real estate transfer tax amount to be collected and remitted from escrow at closing. Varies by jurisdiction.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); FASB ASC 842; SEC regulatory reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status indicating whether the disbursement has been authorized by the required approving parties (e.g., escrow officer, title company, lender). Supports dual-control authorization requirements and SOX financial controls.

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the disbursement was formally authorized by the approving party. Provides a precise audit trail event for SOX compliance and escrow reconciliation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ALTA; RESPA

attributes.name: bank_account_number_masked
attributes.description: Masked bank account number of the payee's receiving account, showing only the last four digits (e.g., ****1234). Stored for reconciliation and audit purposes without exposing full PCI-sensitive account data.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 25

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing transit number of the payee's receiving financial institution. Required for ACH and wire transfer processing. Nine-digit numeric code identifying the destination bank.
attributes.references: ABA Routing Number Standard; NACHA ACH Rules; RESPA

attributes.name: commission_basis_amount
attributes.description: The gross sale price or transaction value upon which the commission rate is applied to calculate the commission disbursement amount. Applicable when disbursement_type is 'commission'. Supports commission audit and RESPA Section 8 compliance.
attributes.references: NAR; RESPA Section 8; Brokerage Agreement

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Brokerage commission rate expressed as a decimal percentage of the sale price (e.g., 0.0300 = 3.00%). Applicable only when disbursement_type is 'commission'. Used for commission reconciliation and broker reporting.
attributes.references: NAR Commission Standards; Brokerage Agreement; RESPA Section 8

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this escrow disbursement record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX record retention requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 30; ISO 55000

attributes.name: disbursement_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount released from escrow to the payee in this disbursement event. Represents the base amount before any withholding or adjustments. Expressed in the transaction currency.
attributes.references: ALTA Settlement Statement; FASB ASC 842; RESPA

attributes.name: disbursement_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which funds were released from the escrow account to the payee. Represents the principal real-world event date for this disbursement. Aligns with closing date or post-closing settlement schedule.
attributes.references: ALTA Settlement Statement; FASB ASC 842; RESPA

attributes.name: disbursement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for escrow officer or closing agent notes regarding special circumstances, conditions, or instructions associated with this disbursement. May include holdback conditions, lender instructions, or dispute notations.
attributes.references: ALTA; RESPA; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: disbursement_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible alphanumeric reference number assigned to this disbursement by the escrow company or title company. Used for reconciliation with closing statements and Yardi Voyager AR/AP records.
attributes.references: ALTA Settlement Statement; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: disbursement_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the disbursement. Tracks progression from pending authorization through final release or voiding. Supports audit trail and reconciliation reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: disbursement_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the nature of the disbursement. Identifies whether funds represent a brokerage commission, title/settlement fee, transfer tax, mortgage loan payoff, net sale proceeds to seller, recording fee, prorated property taxes, Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance, or other closing cost. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commission|title_fee|transfer_tax|loan_payoff|net_proceeds|recording_fee|prorated_taxes|tenant_improvement|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ALTA Settlement Statement; HUD-1; RESPA; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: escrow_officer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the licensed escrow officer or closing agent responsible for processing and releasing this disbursement. Required for audit trail, regulatory compliance, and ALTA closing disclosure documentation.
attributes.references: ALTA; RESPA; State Escrow Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: holdback_release_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disbursement represents the release of a previously held-back escrow amount (True). Holdbacks are common in commercial transactions for repair escrows, environmental remediation reserves, or tenant improvement allowances.
attributes.references: ALTA; FASB ASC 842; Commercial Real Estate (CRE) industry practice

attributes.name: is_1031_exchange_proceeds
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disbursement represents proceeds being directed to a Qualified Intermediary (QI) as part of an IRS Section 1031 like-kind exchange. When True, funds must be held by the QI and not constructively received by the seller.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1031; IRS Revenue Procedure 2000-37; ALTA

attributes.name: is_post_closing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disbursement was made after the official closing date (True) or at closing (False). Post-closing disbursements may include holdback releases, prorated adjustments, or deferred commission payments.
attributes.references: ALTA Settlement Statement; FASB ASC 842; RESPA

attributes.name: loan_payoff_reference
attributes.description: Lender-assigned loan number or payoff statement reference for the mortgage being satisfied by this disbursement. Used to confirm lien release and coordinate with title company for deed recording.
attributes.references: ALTA; RESPA; SNDA Agreement

attributes.name: net_disbursement_amount
attributes.description: Net amount actually paid to the payee after deducting any withholding amounts from the gross disbursement amount. Represents the actual funds transferred. Calculated as disbursement_amount minus withholding_amount.
attributes.references: ALTA Settlement Statement; IRS FIRPTA; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: payee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual, company, or institution receiving the disbursed funds. May be a broker, title company, lender, seller, buyer, government entity, or service provider. Required for closing statement reconciliation and 1099 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-S; RESPA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: payee_tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number (TIN), Employer Identification Number (EIN), or Social Security Number (SSN) of the payee. Required for IRS 1099-S real estate proceeds reporting and backup withholding compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-S; IRS Publication 515; RESPA

attributes.name: payee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payee entity receiving the disbursement. Distinguishes between brokers (commission recipients), lenders (loan payoff), sellers (net proceeds), buyers (refunds), title companies, government agencies (transfer tax), and other service providers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broker|lender|seller|buyer|title_company|government|service_provider|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ALTA Settlement Statement; IRS Form 1099-S; RESPA

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument or mechanism used to transfer the disbursed funds to the payee. Common methods include wire transfer, ACH electronic transfer, cashier's check, or certified check. Critical for bank reconciliation and fraud prevention controls.
attributes.references: ALTA Settlement Statement; SOX Section 302; RESPA

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Bank-assigned or system-generated reference number for the payment instrument used (e.g., wire confirmation number, ACH trace number, check number). Used for bank reconciliation and payment tracing.
attributes.references: ALTA Settlement Statement; SOX Section 302; RESPA

attributes.name: qualified_intermediary_name
attributes.description: Name of the Qualified Intermediary (QI) entity receiving 1031 exchange proceeds on behalf of the seller. Applicable when is_1031_exchange_proceeds is True. Required for IRS Section 1031 compliance documentation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1031; IRS Revenue Procedure 2000-37

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: Date on which a disbursed amount was returned to the escrow account due to a failed payment, rejected wire, or stale check. Populated only when disbursement_status is 'returned'. Triggers re-disbursement workflow.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Return Rules; ALTA; RESPA

attributes.name: title_company_name
attributes.description: Name of the title company or settlement agent managing the escrow account from which this disbursement is made. Provides institutional context for the disbursement and links to ALTA title policy records.
attributes.references: ALTA; RESPA; State Title Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: transfer_tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Name of the governmental jurisdiction (state, county, or municipality) to which transfer tax disbursements are remitted. Applicable when disbursement_type is 'transfer_tax'. Required for tax compliance and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: State and Local Transfer Tax Regulations; ALTA; HUD-1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this escrow disbursement record was last modified. Tracks status changes, authorization updates, and corrections. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 30; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why a disbursement was voided or cancelled. Populated only when disbursement_status is 'voided'. Required for audit trail integrity and SOX internal control documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ALTA; RESPA

attributes.name: withholding_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from the gross disbursement for tax withholding obligations, such as FIRPTA (Foreign Investment in Real Property Tax Act) withholding on foreign sellers or backup withholding. Reduces the net amount actually paid to the payee.
attributes.references: IRS FIRPTA (IRC Section 1445); IRS Publication 515; RESPA

attributes.name: yardi_disbursement_ref
attributes.description: Source system reference identifier from Yardi Voyager Accounts Payable or Accounts Receivable module corresponding to this disbursement record. Enables bi-directional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP/AR Module; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: fatca_status

attributes.description: FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act) classification of the owner entity. Drives IRS Form W-8/W-9 requirements.

attributes.name: kyc_status

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the KYC verification was last successfully completed and approved for this owner entity. Used to track compliance currency and trigger periodic re-verification workflows.
attributes.references: FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule (31 CFR 1010.230); USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the owner or investor entity as registered with the relevant government authority. For individuals, this is the full legal name; for entities, this is the registered corporate or trust name. Used as the authoritative identity label across all portfolio records.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FASB ASC 842; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: lei_code
attributes.description: 20-character alphanumeric Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) code assigned by a GLEIF-accredited Local Operating Unit. Required for institutional investors and publicly traded REITs for regulatory reporting and counterparty identification in financial transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 17442; GLEIF (Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation); SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: mailing_address_city
attributes.description: City component of the owner entity's primary mailing address. Used in conjunction with state and postal code for address validation and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: mailing_address_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the owner entity's primary mailing address. Determines applicable postal regulations, cross-border tax withholding, and FATCA/CRS reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the owner entity's primary mailing address, including street number and street name. Used for legal notices, distribution checks, K-1 tax forms, and investor correspondence.

attributes.name: offboarding_date

attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); SOX Section 802

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the owner entity was formally onboarded and activated in the platform, completing all KYC, AML, and documentation requirements. Marks the start of the active relationship lifecycle.
attributes.references: FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule; GDPR Article 5; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: onboarding_status

Pending = KYC in progress; Active = fully onboarded; Suspended = compliance hold; Inactive = no current holdings; Terminated = relationship ended.

attributes.name: owner_class

attributes.name: politically_exposed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the owner entity or its beneficial owners are classified as Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) — individuals who hold or have held prominent public positions. True = PEP identified; False = no PEP association. Triggers enhanced due diligence (EDD) requirements under AML regulations.

attributes.name: preferred_asset_classes
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of real estate asset classes preferred by the owner for investment (e.g., office, retail, multifamily, industrial, hospitality, mixed-use). attributes.name: preferred_hold_period_years
attributes.description: Owner's stated preferred investment hold period in years. Used for portfolio strategy alignment, DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) modeling in Argus Enterprise, and WALT (Weighted Average Lease Term) matching during acquisition underwriting.

attributes.name: primary_email

attributes.name: primary_phone

attributes.name: qualified_purchaser_flag

attributes.name: registration_number

attributes.name: risk_tolerance
attributes.description: Owner's stated investment risk tolerance profile, aligned with standard CRE (Commercial Real Estate) investment strategy classifications. attributes.name: sanctions_screened_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the owner entity has been screened against OFAC SDN (Specially Designated Nationals) list, EU sanctions lists, and other applicable sanctions databases. True = screening completed with no match; False = not yet screened or match found requiring review.

attributes.name: target_cap_rate_pct
attributes.description: Owner's stated target Capitalization Rate (CAP Rate) for property acquisitions, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.50 = 5.5%). Used for deal screening and investment underwriting in Argus Enterprise. CAP Rate = NOI / Property Value.

attributes.name: target_irr_pct

attributes.description: Owner's stated minimum target Internal Rate of Return (IRR) hurdle rate for investment decisions, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 12.00 = 12%). Used in Argus Enterprise for deal screening, investment committee approvals, and portfolio performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the owner entity holds tax-exempt status (e.g., pension funds, endowments, sovereign wealth funds, charitable organizations). True = tax-exempt; False = taxable entity. Affects UBTI (Unrelated Business Taxable Income) calculations and withholding tax obligations.

attributes.name: tax_id_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of tax identification number stored in tax_id. Determines applicable IRS reporting forms and withholding rules. EIN = Employer Identification Number; SSN = Social Security Number; TIN = Tax Identification Number (generic); ITIN = Individual Taxpayer Identification Number.

attributes.name: tax_identifier

attributes.name: trading_name

attributes.description: The date from which this ownership interest record version is legally and operationally effective. Supports bi-temporal modeling and ownership history reconstruction for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: effective_until

attributes.name: encumbrance_type
attributes.description: The type of encumbrance or lien affecting this ownership interest, if any. None indicates a clear title. Mortgage, lien, easement, covenant, and pledge represent common encumbrance categories affecting transferability and value. Used for title due diligence and DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio) analysis.
attributes.references: ALTA (American Land Title Association); FASB ASC 470 Debt; CMBS (Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities) reporting

attributes.name: equity_value_amount
attributes.description: The current estimated equity value of the ownership interest, representing the owner's proportional share of the property's NAV (Net Asset Value) net of encumbrances. Updated upon revaluation events. Used for investor reporting, LTV (Loan-to-Value Ratio) calculations, and portfolio NAV reporting.

attributes.name: interest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal form of ownership interest held. attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; SEC — REIT reporting; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: The current Know Your Customer (KYC) onboarding verification status for the owner associated with this interest. Required for AML (Anti-Money Laundering) compliance and investor onboarding. Sourced from the investor onboarding workflow in Salesforce CRM or MRI Software.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FinCEN AML regulations; SEC — investor onboarding; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the KYC verification for the owner was last approved or renewed. Used to track KYC expiry and trigger re-verification workflows in compliance with AML regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FinCEN AML regulations; SEC — investor onboarding

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, legal annotations, or operational remarks related to this ownership interest record. Used by asset managers and legal teams to document nuances not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: owner_ownership_interest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ownership interest record. Pending: interest recorded but not yet legally effective. Active: interest is legally valid and in force. Encumbered: interest is subject to a lien, mortgage, or other encumbrance. Disputed: interest is subject to legal challenge. Transferred: interest has been conveyed to another party. Terminated: interest has been extinguished.
attributes.references: ALTA (American Land Title Association); FASB ASC 810; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage equity stake held by the owner in the subject property or investment vehicle, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 25.0000 = 25%). Must sum to 100% across all active co-owners of the same property. Critical for NOI (Net Operating Income) distribution, capital call allocation, and investor reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; SEC Regulation S-X; IVSC International Valuation Standards

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The status of the ownership interest immediately prior to the most recent status transition. Supports full status transition history and audit trail requirements without requiring a separate history table for the latest transition.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FASB ASC 810; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this ownership interest record was originated or last updated (e.g., YARDI for Yardi Voyager, MRI for MRI Software, ARGUS for Argus Enterprise). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code

attributes.name: managing_member_name
attributes.description: The name of the designated managing member, general partner, or trustee responsible for day-to-day decisions and fiduciary obligations of the ownership structure. Critical for governance, legal notices, and investor communications.

attributes.name: target_irr

attributes.name: total_contributed_capital

attributes.name: total_equity_interests

products.name: owner_distribution
products.description: SSOT for income and capital distributions made to owners from property operations, including disbursement banking instructions. This is the owner-perspective distribution record, distinct from finance domain GL entries which record the accounting impact. Captures distribution type (NOI, FFO/AFFO, capital gain, return of capital, preferred return), calculation period, gross amount, withholding tax, net disbursement amount, distribution date, payment method, and Yardi GL cross-reference. Also stores owner bank account and disbursement details: bank name, account type, routing number (masked/tokenized), SWIFT/IBAN for international owners, preferred disbursement method, and account verification status. Supports investor reporting, tax K-1 preparation, and AP reconciliation.
