attributes.references: ILPA Capital Call Best Practices; FASB ASC 323; DocuSign CLM Contract Reference

attributes.name: contribution_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount of capital contributed by the owner or investor in the transaction currency. This is the base monetary amount before any adjustments, fees, or withholdings. Core component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this transaction.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; IFRS 9; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 6-04

attributes.name: contribution_amount_usd
attributes.description: Contribution amount converted to USD at the applicable exchange rate on the contribution date. Used for consolidated portfolio reporting, NAV calculations, and AUM tracking across multi-currency investment vehicles.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830 — Foreign Currency Matters; SEC Form 10-K

attributes.name: contribution_date
attributes.description: The actual business date on which the capital contribution was received and recorded, i.e., the value date of the equity funding event. Used for equity waterfall calculations and capital account balance updates.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; IFRS 9 — Financial Instruments

attributes.name: contribution_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number or code assigned to this capital contribution event, used for cross-referencing with investor notices, capital call letters, and wire instructions. Sourced from Yardi Voyager or MRI Software capital account module.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; Yardi Voyager Capital Account Module

attributes.name: contribution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capital contribution record. Pending indicates a capital call has been issued but funds not yet received; funded indicates wire confirmed; partially_funded indicates only a portion of the called amount was received; returned indicates capital was returned to investor; cancelled indicates the contribution was voided.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: contribution_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the capital contribution. Initial equity is the founding equity injection; capital_call is a drawdown against an unfunded commitment; preferred_equity is a senior equity tranche injection; co_invest is a co-investment alongside a primary fund; return_of_capital is a distribution classified as capital return; additional_equity is a supplemental equity injection post-initial close. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial_equity|capital_call|preferred_equity|co_invest|return_of_capital|additional_equity — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards; Argus Enterprise Investment Analysis

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this capital contribution record was first created in the data platform. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for audit trail and data lineage compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; ISO 8000 Data Quality; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: default_interest_amount
attributes.description: The default interest or penalty amount charged to the investor for late funding of a capital call, as specified in the partnership or JV agreement. Applicable only when is_late_funding is True.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; Partnership Agreement Default Interest Provisions; ILPA Best Practices

attributes.name: equity_tier
attributes.description: The equity tranche or tier classification of this capital contribution within the investment vehicle's capital stack. Determines priority in the equity waterfall distribution model (e.g., preferred equity receives distributions before common equity).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 480 — Distinguishing Liabilities from Equity; ULI Real Estate Finance Standards

attributes.name: funding_source_type
attributes.description: The mechanism or instrument used to fund the capital contribution. Wire transfer and ACH are cash funding methods; in_kind indicates a non-cash asset contribution; debt_conversion indicates conversion of a loan to equity; reinvestment indicates distribution proceeds reinvested as new capital.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; FASB ASC 470 — Debt; Yardi Voyager AP Module

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert the contribution amount from the transaction currency to USD on the contribution date. Sourced from the reference data FX rate table. A value of 1.0 indicates the contribution is already in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830 — Foreign Currency Matters; ISO 4217

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The GL account code in the chart of accounts to which this capital contribution is posted in the accounting system (Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA). Enables reconciliation between the owner domain capital account and the finance domain GL entries.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; SOX Section 404; Yardi Voyager GL Module; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: investor_entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investor or owner entity type making the contribution. Determines applicable regulatory reporting requirements, tax treatment, and KYC/AML obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|institutional|reit|jv_entity|partnership|fund|family_office|sovereign_wealth — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; FINRA KYC Rules; FASB ASC 946; FinCEN AML Requirements

attributes.name: is_late_funding
attributes.description: Indicates whether the capital contribution was received after the capital call due date. True if contribution_date is after capital_call_due_date. Used to trigger default interest calculations and investor compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ILPA Capital Call Best Practices; Partnership Agreement Default Provisions

attributes.name: kyc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contributing investor has completed KYC verification as required by AML regulations prior to this contribution being accepted. True indicates KYC is current and verified; False indicates KYC is pending or expired.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/KYC Requirements; GDPR Article 5; SEC Regulation S-ID; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: net_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The net amount of capital credited to the investor's capital account after deducting tax withholdings, default interest charges, or other adjustments from the gross contribution_amount. Represents the net total in the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; FIRPTA; Yardi Voyager Capital Account Module; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the asset manager or fund administrator regarding this capital contribution event. May include special conditions, investor instructions, or reconciliation remarks.
attributes.references: Internal Asset Management Operations; Yardi Voyager Notes Module

attributes.name: ownership_pct_after
attributes.description: The investor's pro-rata ownership percentage in the investment vehicle or property immediately after this capital contribution is applied. Reflects any dilution or accretion resulting from the contribution event.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; SEC Regulation S-X; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: ownership_pct_before
attributes.description: The investor's pro-rata ownership percentage in the investment vehicle or property immediately before this capital contribution. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.25 = 25%). Used to track dilution or accretion events.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; SEC Regulation S-X; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: preferred_return_accrual_method
attributes.description: The method by which the preferred return accrues on this capital contribution. Simple interest accrues on the original contribution only; compound accrues on the outstanding balance including accrued return; cumulative_non_compounding tracks unpaid preferred return without compounding.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; ULI Real Estate Finance Standards; Partnership Agreement Terms

attributes.name: preferred_return_rate
attributes.description: The annual preferred return rate (hurdle rate) applicable to this capital contribution, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.08 = 8%). Determines the minimum return threshold before promote/carried interest is earned in the equity waterfall.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; ULI Real Estate Finance Standards; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this capital contribution record was originated or ingested. Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8000 Data Quality; SOX Section 404 — Data Lineage and Audit Trail

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Yardi Voyager transaction ID, MRI Software capital account entry ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation back to the system of record.
attributes.references: ISO 8000 Data Quality; SOX Section 404 — Data Lineage; Yardi Voyager; MRI Software

attributes.name: tax_withholding_amount
attributes.description: The amount withheld from the capital contribution for tax purposes, applicable to foreign investors subject to FIRPTA withholding or other tax withholding obligations. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component.
attributes.references: FIRPTA — Foreign Investment in Real Property Tax Act; IRS Publication 515; FASB ASC 740 — Income Taxes

attributes.name: unfunded_commitment_after
attributes.description: The investor's remaining unfunded commitment balance immediately after this capital contribution event is applied. Calculated as unfunded_commitment_before minus contribution_amount. Stored for audit trail and point-in-time reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; ILPA Reporting Template; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: unfunded_commitment_before
attributes.description: The investor's remaining unfunded commitment balance immediately prior to this capital contribution event. Used to validate that the called amount does not exceed the outstanding commitment and to track drawdown progress.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323; ILPA Reporting Template; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this capital contribution record was last modified in the data platform. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for audit trail and change tracking compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; ISO 8000 Data Quality; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: use_of_proceeds
attributes.description: Narrative description of the intended use of the contributed capital, as specified in the capital call notice or investment agreement. Examples include property acquisition down payment, construction draw funding, debt paydown, or working capital reserve.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 504 — Use of Proceeds; FASB ASC 323; ILPA Reporting Template

attributes.name: wire_confirmation_ref
attributes.description: The bank wire confirmation number, ACH trace number, or payment reference provided by the investor's financial institution upon funding. Used for reconciliation against bank statements and to confirm receipt of funds.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 230 — Statement of Cash Flows; SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls

products.name: ownership_transfer
products.description: Records the transfer of ownership interests between parties — including equity stake transfers, JV buyouts, inheritance transfers, 1031 exchanges, and foreclosure/REO transfers. Captures transfer type, transferor (owner FK), transferee (owner FK), transfer date, consideration amount, transfer percentage, title instrument reference, ALTA settlement statement reference, recording jurisdiction, and tax implications. Distinct from the transaction domain which records full property acquisition/disposition events; this product tracks interest-level transfers within existing ownership structures.
products.reference: ALTA Title Transfer / Deed of Conveyance

attributes.name: ownership_transfer_id

attributes.name: assumed_debt_instrument_id

attributes.name: broker_id

Business justification: Recording jurisdiction determines applicable transfer taxes, deed recording fees, and title registration requirements. Compliance teams track which regulator

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.title_record. Business justification: Every ownership transfer produces a recorded deed captured in title_record. Linking ownership_transfer to title_record is essential for chain-of-title tracking, closing reconciliation, and title insur

attributes.name: transaction_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.transaction_type. Business justification: Ownership transfer transaction type (arm's length sale, 1031 exchange, gift, foreclosure, contribution) determines tax basis treatment, transfer tax applicability, SEC reportability, and title insuran

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: agreement_execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the purchase and sale agreement, assignment agreement, or other binding transfer instrument was signed by all parties. May precede the transfer_date (closing date) by days or weeks during the due diligence period.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; American Land Title Association (ALTA); FASB ASC 805

attributes.name: allocated_property_value
attributes.description: The total assessed or agreed fair market value of the underlying property at the time of transfer, used to compute the proportional value of the interest being transferred. Sourced from Argus Enterprise valuation models or appraisal reports.
attributes.references: International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC); Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 820 Fair Value

attributes.name: alta_settlement_statement_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Land Title Association (ALTA) Settlement Statement Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the ALTA Uniform Settlement Statement (HUD-1 or ALTA Settlement Statement) associated with this transfer. Documents all financial terms, prorations, and closing costs. Used for audit and tax basis calculations.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the ownership transfer was formally approved by the designated approval authority. Distinct from the agreement execution date and transfer date. Required for SOX controls and investment committee governance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_disclosed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ultimate beneficial owner(s) of the transferee entity have been disclosed and verified as part of the KYC/AML onboarding process. True when beneficial ownership disclosure is complete and on file. Required for FinCEN Geographic Targeting Orders and AML compliance.
attributes.references: FinCEN Beneficial Ownership Rule; GDPR Article 13; Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN)

attributes.name: capital_gains_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transfer is expected to generate a taxable capital gain or loss for the transferor. True when the consideration amount exceeds the transferor's adjusted tax basis in the interest. Drives tax provision calculations and investor reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Code; FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: consideration_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary consideration paid by the transferee to the transferor for the ownership interest. Represents the agreed purchase price or fair market value of the interest transferred. Used for stamp duty, transfer tax, and capital gains calculations. Null for gift or inheritance transfers.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 805; American Land Title Association (ALTA); SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ownership transfer record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail field for data governance and lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: due_diligence_end_date
attributes.description: The contractual deadline by which the transferee must complete all due diligence activities (title search, environmental review, financial audit) and either proceed with or cancel the transfer. Tracks deal timeline milestones.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); EPA Environmental Compliance; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: exchange_1031_case_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Code (IRC) Section 1031 Like-Kind Exchange Case Number
attributes.description: The qualified intermediary case or exchange reference number assigned when this transfer is part of a Section 1031 like-kind exchange. Null for non-exchange transfers. Required for IRS compliance documentation and deferred gain tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Code Section 1031; IRS Revenue Procedure 2000-37

attributes.name: kyc_verification_status
attributes.description: The current status of the Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) identity verification process for the transferee party. Required for regulatory compliance on all ownership transfers above reporting thresholds.
attributes.references: FinCEN Beneficial Ownership Rule; GDPR Article 5; Bank Secrecy Act; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ownership transfer record was most recently modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: loan_amount
attributes.description: The principal amount of the mortgage or acquisition loan obtained by the transferee to finance this ownership interest transfer. Used for Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio computation and debt covenant monitoring.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; CMBS regulatory framework; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of the acquisition loan amount to the allocated property value at the time of transfer, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 65.0000 = 65% LTV). Key underwriting metric for lenders and portfolio risk management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; CMBS/RMBS regulatory frameworks; Basel III

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, or qualifications related to the ownership transfer that are not captured in structured fields. Examples include right-of-first-refusal waivers, co-owner consent notes, or regulatory condition summaries.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: post_transfer_ownership_pct
attributes.description: The transferor's remaining ownership percentage in the property immediately after this transfer event. Computed as pre_transfer_ownership_pct minus transfer_percentage. Stored for audit trail and consolidation analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: pre_transfer_ownership_pct
attributes.description: The transferor's ownership percentage in the property immediately before this transfer event. Provides the baseline for computing post-transfer ownership stakes and validating that transfer_percentage does not exceed the transferor's held interest.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: recording_book_page
attributes.description: The official book and page number (or document number in electronic recording systems) assigned by the recording jurisdiction upon filing of the title instrument. Used for public records retrieval and chain-of-title verification.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: The date on which the title instrument was officially recorded with the relevant governmental authority (county recorder, land registry). May differ from the transfer_date; recording establishes constructive notice to third parties.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: snda_agreement_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Subordination Non-Disturbance and Attornment (SNDA) Agreement Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Subordination, Non-Disturbance and Attornment (SNDA) agreement executed in connection with this transfer, protecting existing tenant leases from disruption due to the ownership change. Sourced from DocuSign CLM.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; American Land Title Association (ALTA); FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this ownership transfer record originated. Enables data lineage tracking and reconciliation across Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, Argus Enterprise, and other integrated platforms.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Yardi Voyager ownership transfer ID, MRI Software transaction key). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: tax_basis_amount
attributes.description: The transferor's adjusted tax basis in the ownership interest at the time of transfer. Used to compute realized gain or loss for income tax purposes. For 1031 exchanges, the carryover basis is tracked here.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Code Section 1031; FASB ASC 740; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: title_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: The policy number of the title insurance policy issued to the transferee (owner's policy) or lender (lender's policy) in connection with this transfer. Provides protection against title defects and encumbrances not discovered during due diligence.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: transfer_costs_amount
attributes.description: Total transaction costs incurred in executing the ownership transfer, including legal fees, title search fees, recording fees, broker commissions, and due diligence costs. Capitalized as part of the cost basis per FASB ASC 805.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 805; SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: transfer_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world effective date on which the ownership interest legally transferred from transferor to transferee. This is the date of record for title and tax purposes, distinct from the agreement execution date.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA); FASB ASC 805; Internal Revenue Code Section 1031

attributes.name: transfer_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total ownership interest being transferred, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 25.0000 = 25%). Enables partial interest transfers within joint-venture and partnership structures. Must be between 0.0001 and 100.0000.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 810 Consolidation

attributes.name: transfer_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the ownership transfer event, used in correspondence, legal documents, and system cross-references. Sourced from Yardi Voyager or MRI Software ownership module.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the ownership transfer workflow. Tracks progression from initiation through legal completion. Values: pending (initiated, awaiting documentation), in_review (under legal/compliance review), approved (authorized for execution), completed (title recorded and transfer finalized), cancelled (transfer voided before completion), reversed (completed transfer subsequently unwound).
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); FASB ASC 805

attributes.name: transfer_tax_amount
attributes.description: The total real estate transfer tax, documentary stamp tax, or conveyance tax assessed on the ownership transfer by the applicable jurisdiction. Computed based on consideration amount and local tax rates. Required for tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 805; SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-X

products.name: tax_record
products.description: SSOT for owner-perspective tax records — property tax obligations by jurisdiction, tax identification numbers, withholding tax rates for foreign owners (FIRPTA), tax treaty elections, K-1 partnership income allocations, and annual tax reporting status. Distinct from finance domain tax accounting (GL tax entries) and compliance domain regulatory filings; this product captures the owner-specific tax profile and obligations. Captures tax year, jurisdiction, tax type, assessed amount, filing status, and SAP S/4HANA tax cross-reference. Supports SOX compliance and SEC reporting for publicly traded REITs.

attributes.name: tax_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each owner tax record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_invoice. Business justification: Property tax payments generate AP invoices. Linking tax_record to ap_invoice enables reconciliation between tax liability records and actual payment invoices, required for tax expense verification, au

MRICS is the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors designation. Required for USPAP and IVSC compliance.

attributes.description: State-issued appraiser license or certification number for the assigned appraiser. Required for regulatory compliance and lender review. Confidential business record used to verify appraiser eligibility on each engagement.

attributes.name: argus_model_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the Argus Enterprise cash flow model associated with this appraisal engagement. Enables direct traceability between the appraisal record and the underlying DCF model file for audit and replication purposes.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: cap_rate
attributes.description: The overall capitalization rate applied in the income capitalization approach, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0550 for 5.50%). Derived from market comparable sales and used to convert Net Operating Income (NOI) into an indicated value. Key input for Argus Enterprise DCF models.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; USPAP

attributes.name: client_reference
attributes.description: The client's internal reference number or loan number associated with this appraisal order. Used by lenders, investment managers, or asset managers to cross-reference the appraisal with their own systems (e.g., MRI Software investment records).
attributes.references: MRI Software; Yardi Voyager; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: concluded_market_value
attributes.description: The appraiser's final concluded value opinion for the subject property as of the effective value date, expressed in the engagement currency. This is the primary output of the appraisal engagement and feeds NAV/GAV calculations, LTV ratios, and DSCR analysis.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 104; FASB ASC 820; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the appraisal engagement record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX financial controls and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 820; ISO 55000

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The risk-adjusted discount rate applied to future cash flows in the DCF analysis, expressed as a decimal. Reflects the required rate of return for the asset class, location, and risk profile. Key Argus Enterprise model input.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: engagement_date
attributes.description: The date the appraisal was formally ordered and the engagement letter was executed. Marks the start of the appraisal lifecycle and the SLA turnaround clock.
attributes.references: USPAP Ethics Rule; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: engagement_fee
attributes.description: The agreed fee payable to the appraisal firm for the engagement, in the engagement currency. Recorded for accounts payable processing in Yardi Voyager and budget tracking against the valuation OPEX budget.
attributes.references: USPAP Ethics Rule; Yardi Voyager AP Module

attributes.name: engagement_letter_ref
attributes.description: Document reference number or DocuSign CLM contract ID for the executed engagement letter between the client and the appraisal firm. Provides legal traceability and supports contract lifecycle management.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; USPAP Ethics Rule; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: engagement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to the appraisal engagement at the time of ordering. Used for cross-referencing with the engagement letter, Argus Enterprise, and Yardi Voyager fixed asset records.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Standard 2

attributes.name: firm_name
attributes.description: The name of the external appraisal firm engaged to perform the appraisal. Supports vendor management, conflict-of-interest tracking, and appraiser rotation policies required by lenders and regulators.
attributes.references: USPAP Ethics Rule; Appraisal Institute; FIRREA Title XI

attributes.name: holding_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years in the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) analysis projection period. Typically 10 years for commercial real estate. Defines the time horizon over which cash flows are modeled in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The date the appraiser physically inspected the subject property. Required disclosure in USPAP-compliant reports. For desktop or drive-by appraisals, this field may be null or reflect the date of external observation.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 1-2; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: intended_user
attributes.description: The party or parties identified in the engagement letter as the intended user(s) of the appraisal report (e.g., lender name, investment committee, asset manager). USPAP requires explicit identification of intended users to define the scope of work.
attributes.references: USPAP Scope of Work Rule; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: irr
attributes.description: The discount rate at which the net present value of projected cash flows equals zero, as concluded in the DCF analysis. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0850 for 8.50%). Key output metric for investment decision-making and portfolio performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; CFA Institute

attributes.name: ivsc_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appraisal methodology and report comply with International Valuation Standards (IVS) as published by the IVSC. Required for cross-border investment reporting and IFRS-based financial statements.
attributes.references: IVSC International Valuation Standards; IFRS 13; IASB

attributes.name: methodology
attributes.description: The primary valuation methodology applied in the appraisal. Sales Comparison, Income Capitalization (direct CAP rate), Cost Approach, Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), Broker Price Opinion (BPO), or Comparative Market Analysis (CMA). USPAP and IVSC require disclosure of methodology in the report.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 105; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: noi
attributes.description: The stabilized Net Operating Income used as the primary income input in the income capitalization approach. Calculated as Effective Gross Income (EGI) less operating expenses, excluding debt service and capital expenditures. Sourced from Yardi Voyager or Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; NCREIF

attributes.name: npv
attributes.description: The net present value of projected future cash flows discounted at the required rate of return, as output from the DCF model. Positive NPV indicates value creation above the required return threshold. Sourced from Argus Enterprise DCF model.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: The intended use of the appraisal report as stated in the engagement letter. Drives the applicable standard of value and methodology selection. Common purposes include financing (LTV/DSCR support), disposition, insurance replacement cost, tax appeal, portfolio review (NAV/GAV), and litigation support.
attributes.references: USPAP Ethics Rule; IVSC IVS 101; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: report_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date the completed appraisal report was delivered to the client or intended user. Used to measure SLA turnaround compliance from engagement date to delivery.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Standard 2

attributes.name: report_document_ref
attributes.description: Document management system reference or DocuSign CLM document ID for the final appraisal report deliverable. Enables direct retrieval of the report PDF or narrative document from the document repository.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Appraisal Institute; USPAP Standard 2

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The format of the appraisal report deliverable. URAR (Uniform Residential Appraisal Report) is the standard Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac form for residential properties. Narrative reports provide full written analysis. Restricted and Summary reports are abbreviated formats per USPAP.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 2; Fannie Mae Form 1004; Freddie Mac Form 70

attributes.name: report_version
attributes.description: Indicates the hypothetical condition or premise of the concluded value. As-Is reflects current physical and economic condition. As-Stabilized assumes the property reaches stabilized occupancy. As-Complete assumes a development or renovation project is finished.
attributes.references: USPAP; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 101

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The date the appraisal review was completed by the review appraiser. Tracks the review stage of the appraisal lifecycle and supports SLA measurement for the review turnaround.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: review_outcome
attributes.description: The outcome of the internal or external appraisal review. Approved reports proceed to final use; rejected or revision-required reports are returned to the appraiser. Drives the status lifecycle transition.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 3; Appraisal Institute; Lender Review Guidelines

attributes.name: sla_turnaround_days
attributes.description: The contractually agreed maximum number of calendar days from engagement date to report delivery. Used to monitor appraiser performance and manage investment decision timelines.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: terminal_cap_rate
attributes.description: The reversion or terminal capitalization rate applied to the projected NOI at the end of the DCF holding period to estimate the residual/reversion value. Expressed as a decimal. Standard Argus Enterprise DCF model parameter.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the appraisal engagement record was last modified. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer and audit trail requirements under SOX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 55000

attributes.name: uspap_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appraisal was performed in compliance with the Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP) as promulgated by The Appraisal Foundation. Required for federally related transactions under FIRREA.
attributes.references: USPAP; The Appraisal Foundation; FIRREA Title XI

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date of the concluded value opinion, which may differ from the report delivery date. For retrospective appraisals, this is a historical date. Critical for FASB ASC 820 fair value measurement and IFRS 16 lease accounting purposes.
attributes.references: USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 101; FASB ASC 820; IFRS 16

attributes.name: value_range_high
attributes.description: The upper bound of the appraiser's value range opinion when a range rather than a point estimate is concluded. Used alongside value_range_low for sensitivity analysis and investment committee reporting.
attributes.references: USPAP; IVSC IVS 104; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: value_range_low
attributes.description: The lower bound of the appraiser's value range opinion when a range rather than a point estimate is concluded. Used in portfolio stress testing and sensitivity analysis in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: USPAP; IVSC IVS 104; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: value_type
attributes.description: The standard of value concluded in the appraisal report. Market Value is the most common; Investment Value reflects a specific investor's criteria; Liquidation Value assumes a forced sale; Insurable Value is used for insurance replacement cost; Assessed Value is used for property tax purposes.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 104; USPAP; FASB ASC 820

One appraisal engagement may produce one or more reports (e.g., as-is vs. as-stabilized).

attributes.name: appraisal_id

attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 101

attributes.name: as_is_value
attributes.description: The appraised value of the property in its current physical and economic condition as of the effective date, without consideration of any proposed improvements or stabilization. Commonly used alongside as-stabilized value for development and repositioning assets.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 400 Real Property Interests; USPAP

attributes.name: as_stabilized_value
attributes.description: The prospective appraised value of the property upon reaching stabilized occupancy and income levels, assuming completion of any proposed improvements. Used in development financing and investment underwriting.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 400; Argus Enterprise valuation modeling

attributes.name: cap_rate_applied
attributes.description: The overall capitalization rate (CAP rate) applied in the income capitalization approach, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0650 for 6.50%). Derived from comparable sales analysis and market data. Key input for NOI-based valuation.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; CoStar Suite market data

attributes.name: concluded_market_value
attributes.description: The appraiser's final concluded value opinion for the subject property as of the effective date, expressed in the report currency. This is the primary quantitative output of the appraisal engagement and is used for investment decisions, financial reporting, and loan underwriting.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 104; USPAP Standards Rule 2-2; FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; IASB IFRS 13

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this appraisal report record was first created in the Silver Layer data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 55000 Asset Management; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount rate applied in the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) analysis, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0800 for 8.00%). Reflects the required rate of return for the investment, incorporating risk and market conditions.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise DCF modeling

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the concluded value opinion is valid (also known as the value date). This is the principal real-world event date for the appraisal and may differ from the report date. Critical for investment decision-making and financial reporting under ASC 842 and IFRS 16.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 101; USPAP Standards Rule 2-2; FASB ASC 820; IASB IFRS 13

attributes.name: extraordinary_assumptions
attributes.description: Narrative description of any extraordinary assumptions made in the appraisal that, if found to be false, could alter the appraiser's opinions or conclusions. Required USPAP disclosure. Examples include assumed lease-up timelines or assumed environmental clearance.
attributes.references: USPAP Standards Rule 2-2; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 101

attributes.name: gross_building_area_sqf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Building Area (GBA) in Square Feet (SQF)
attributes.description: The total gross building area of the subject property in square feet (SQF) as measured or verified by the appraiser. Used to calculate per-square-foot (PSF) value indicators and compare to market comparables.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; BOMA International Building Measurement Standards; RESO

attributes.name: holding_period_years
attributes.description: The assumed investment holding period in years used in the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) analysis. Typically ranges from 5 to 15 years for commercial real estate. Drives the terminal value calculation.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: hypothetical_conditions
attributes.description: Narrative description of any hypothetical conditions applied in the appraisal that are contrary to known facts but assumed for the purpose of analysis (e.g., assuming a proposed building is complete as of the effective date). Required USPAP disclosure.
attributes.references: USPAP Standards Rule 2-2; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appraiser physically inspected the subject property. A desktop or drive-by appraisal may have no inspection date. Required for USPAP compliance certification.
attributes.references: USPAP Standards Rule 2-2; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: The stated purpose for which the appraisal report is intended to be used, as required by USPAP (e.g., mortgage financing, financial reporting, portfolio valuation, acquisition due diligence, estate planning, litigation support). Determines the scope of work and applicable standards.
attributes.references: USPAP Standards Rule 2-2; Appraisal Institute; FIRREA

attributes.name: intended_user
attributes.description: The party or parties identified by the appraiser as the intended user(s) of the appraisal report (e.g., lender name, client organization, REIT investment committee). Required USPAP disclosure. Restricts reliance on the report to named parties.
attributes.references: USPAP Standards Rule 2-2; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: irr
attributes.description: The Internal Rate of Return (IRR) output from the DCF analysis, expressed as a decimal. Represents the annualized rate of return that equates the present value of projected cash flows to the concluded value. Key metric for investment decision-making.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise; CFA Institute

attributes.name: limiting_conditions
attributes.description: Summary of the general and specific limiting conditions that govern the scope and reliance of the appraisal report. Standard USPAP certification element included in all appraisal reports.
attributes.references: USPAP Standards Rule 2-2; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: npv
attributes.description: The Net Present Value (NPV) output from the DCF analysis, representing the present value of projected future cash flows discounted at the applied discount rate. Supports investment advisory and portfolio management decisions.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise; CFA Institute

attributes.name: number_of_comparables
attributes.description: The count of comparable sales transactions analyzed and used in the sales comparison approach. Provides a quality indicator for the depth of market evidence supporting the concluded value.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Standards Rule 1-4; CoStar Suite comparable data

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appraisal report was signed and issued by the appraiser. May differ from the effective date of value, particularly for retrospective or prospective appraisals.
attributes.references: USPAP Standards Rule 2-2; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 101

attributes.name: report_format
attributes.description: The format type of the appraisal report as defined by USPAP and Fannie Mae guidelines. URAR (Uniform Residential Appraisal Report) is standard for residential; narrative and summary formats are common for commercial CRE engagements.
attributes.references: USPAP Standards Rule 2-2; Fannie Mae Form 1004; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the report by the appraisal firm or internal valuation team. Used for cross-referencing with Argus Enterprise and client deliverables.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; USPAP Standards Rule 2-2

attributes.name: report_scenario
attributes.description: The valuation scenario represented by this report. As-Is reflects current condition; As-Stabilized assumes full occupancy; As-Complete assumes construction completion; As-Dark assumes vacant/non-operating; Prospective reflects a future date. One engagement may produce multiple scenario reports.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 400; USPAP Advisory Opinion 17

attributes.name: report_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the appraisal report workflow. Tracks progression from initial draft through internal review, approval, client issuance, and potential supersession or withdrawal.
attributes.references: USPAP; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 101

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: The current status of the internal or external review process for this appraisal report. Tracks whether a supervisory or desk review has been initiated, completed, approved, or rejected per Appraisal Institute and USPAP Standards Rule 3.
attributes.references: USPAP Standards Rule 3; Appraisal Institute; OCC Interagency Appraisal Guidelines

attributes.name: reviewer_sign_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the designated reviewer completed and approved the review of this appraisal report. Null if review is not yet completed or not required.
attributes.references: USPAP Standards Rule 3; Appraisal Institute; OCC Interagency Appraisal Guidelines

attributes.name: scope_of_work
attributes.description: Description of the type and extent of research and analyses applied in the appraisal assignment, as required by USPAP Scope of Work Rule. Includes data sources consulted, inspection type, and approaches to value considered.
attributes.references: USPAP Scope of Work Rule; Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 101

attributes.name: terminal_cap_rate
attributes.description: The reversion or terminal CAP rate applied to the projected NOI at the end of the DCF holding period to estimate the terminal/residual value of the property. Used in Argus Enterprise DCF models.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this appraisal report record was last modified in the Silver Layer data platform. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and data freshness monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 55000 Asset Management; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: uspap_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the report was prepared in compliance with USPAP (Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice) as required by the Appraisal Institute and applicable US regulations.
attributes.references: USPAP; Appraisal Institute; Financial Institutions Reform Recovery and Enforcement Act (FIRREA)

attributes.name: valuation_approach
attributes.description: Primary valuation methodology applied in the report. Sales Comparison uses comparable transactions; Income Capitalization applies CAP rate to NOI; Cost approach estimates replacement cost less depreciation; DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) models future cash flows; Hybrid combines multiple approaches.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 Valuation Approaches; Appraisal Institute; USPAP Standards Rule 1-4

attributes.name: value_psf
attributes.description: The concluded market value expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) basis, calculated as concluded market value divided by gross building area. Key benchmarking metric for CRE investment analysis and market comparison.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; CoStar Suite; NCREIF

attributes.name: value_type
attributes.description: The basis of value concluded in the report. Market Value is the most common standard; Investment Value reflects a specific investor's criteria; Liquidation Value applies to distressed scenarios; Insurable Value is used for insurance purposes; Assessed Value is used for tax purposes.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 104 Bases of Value; Appraisal Institute; USPAP

Used for quick portfolio valuations, REO pricing, pre-listing assessments, and lender loss mitigation where a full USPAP appraisal is not required.

attributes.name: ordered_date

attributes.name: recommended_list_price

attributes.name: repair_cost_estimate

attributes.name: report_document_url

attributes.name: requester_reference
attributes.description: The requesting party's own internal reference or order number for this BPO engagement, used for cross-referencing and reconciliation with the client's systems.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: The quality review status of the completed BPO, indicating whether it has been approved by the requesting party's review team, rejected, or requires revision.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; Fannie Mae BPO Review Guidelines

attributes.name: reviewer_notes
attributes.description: Qualitative notes or feedback provided by the reviewing party upon quality review of the BPO, including reasons for rejection or required revisions.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: turnaround_sla_hours
attributes.description: The contractually agreed turnaround time in hours from order placement to BPO delivery, as specified in the engagement agreement with the requesting party.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the BPO record was last modified in the system, supporting audit trail, change tracking, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.references: USPAP Standards Rule 1-4; Appraisal Institute

Self-contained engagement record used primarily for listing price recommendations and seller consultations.

attributes.description: Number of currently active listing comparables included in the analysis. Active listings represent current competition and establish the upper bound of buyer expectations.

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Comparative Market Analysis was conducted and the market data was assembled. This is the effective date of the analysis, not the delivery date.

attributes.name: avg_days_on_market
attributes.description: Average number of days comparable sold properties were listed on the market before going under contract. Informs realistic time-to-sale expectations for the seller.

attributes.name: comparable_count
attributes.description: Total number of comparable properties (sold, active, and pending listings) used in the analysis. A higher count generally increases the reliability of the concluded value range.

attributes.name: comparable_lookback_months
attributes.description: The number of months of historical sales data reviewed when selecting comparable sold properties. Typically 3–12 months depending on market activity and data availability.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: comparable_search_radius_miles
attributes.description: The geographic radius in miles used to define the comparable property search area around the subject property. Smaller radii indicate tighter, more homogeneous market areas.

attributes.description: The upper bound of the analyst's concluded market value range for the subject property, expressed in USD. Together with concluded_value_low, defines the recommended pricing corridor.

attributes.name: concluded_value_low
attributes.description: The lower bound of the analyst's concluded market value range for the subject property, expressed in USD. Together with concluded_value_high, defines the recommended pricing corridor for seller consultations.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC)

attributes.description: The timestamp when this CMA record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting data governance and SOX compliance for financial reporting inputs.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The date the completed CMA report was delivered to the client or seller. May differ from analysis_date if preparation spans multiple days.

attributes.description: The business purpose or context for which this CMA was prepared. Drives the analytical focus and recommended pricing strategy. attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the CMA conclusions are considered stale and should not be relied upon for pricing decisions, typically 90–180 days from analysis date given market volatility.

CMAs are typically NOT USPAP-compliant (False) as they are broker-prepared market analyses, not certified appraisals. This flag distinguishes CMAs from formal appraisals for regulatory and disclosure purposes.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC); USPAP

attributes.name: list_to_sale_ratio
attributes.description: The average ratio of final sale price to original list price across comparable sold properties, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.97 = 97%). Indicates negotiation dynamics and pricing accuracy in the local market.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Multiple Listing Service (MLS)

attributes.name: market_condition
attributes.description: Classification of the current supply-demand balance in the subject property's local market. Sellers markets have low inventory and high demand; buyers markets have high inventory and low demand.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); CoStar Suite

attributes.name: market_trend
attributes.description: Analyst's assessment of the current directional trend in the subject property's local market. Influences pricing strategy recommendations — appreciating markets may support aggressive pricing; declining markets warrant conservative pricing.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); CoStar Suite

attributes.name: mls_area_code
attributes.description: The MLS-defined geographic area or submarket code within which the subject property and comparables are located. Ensures comparables are drawn from the same MLS market area.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Multiple Listing Service (MLS)

attributes.name: months_of_supply
attributes.description: Estimated number of months it would take to sell all current active listings at the current absorption rate. Less than 3 months indicates a sellers market; more than 6 months indicates a buyers market.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: pending_comparable_count
attributes.description: Number of pending (under contract) comparable listings included in the analysis. Pending comparables indicate near-term market clearing prices.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Multiple Listing Service (MLS)

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: The analyst's recommended pricing approach for the listing based on market conditions, seller objectives, and CMA findings. Aggressive pricing targets above-market value; below-market pricing aims for rapid sale.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: recommended_list_price
attributes.description: The specific listing price recommended by the analyst based on the CMA findings, market trend assessment, and pricing strategy. Falls within or near the concluded value range.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: report_document_url

attributes.references: DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: sold_comparable_count
attributes.description: Number of recently sold comparable properties included in the analysis. Sold comparables are the primary evidence of market value in a CMA.

attributes.description: The timestamp when this comparable sale record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Primary source from which the comparable sale data was obtained (e.g., CoStar Suite, MLS data feed, county deed/public record, appraiser files). Supports USPAP verification and data provenance requirements.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite

attributes.name: data_source_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this comparable sale record within the originating source system (e.g., CoStar property ID, MLS listing number, county assessor parcel number). Enables traceability back to the source system for verification.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; Multiple Listing Service (MLS); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: distressed_sale_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the comparable sale was a distressed transaction (True), such as a foreclosure, Real Estate Owned (REO) sale, short sale, or bankruptcy sale. Distressed sales may require exclusion or significant adjustment in USPAP-compliant appraisals.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: financing_type
attributes.description: Type of financing used in the comparable sale transaction (e.g., conventional mortgage, cash, seller financing, assumed mortgage, CMBS). Atypical financing may require a cash equivalency adjustment per USPAP.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 105; Fannie Mae Selling Guide

attributes.name: gla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Leasable Area in Square Feet (GLA SQF)
attributes.description: Total gross leasable area (GLA) of the comparable sale property measured in square feet (SQF). Primary size metric used to calculate price per square foot (PSF) and to assess comparability with the subject property.
attributes.references: Building Owners and Managers Association (BOMA) Measurement Standards; Appraisal Institute USPAP; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: location_adjustment_pct
attributes.description: Percentage adjustment applied to the comparable sale price to account for locational differences between the comparable property and the subject property (e.g., submarket quality, access, visibility, corner location). Positive values indicate the subject is superior; negative values indicate the comparable is superior.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 105 Valuation Approaches and Methods

attributes.name: lot_size_sqft
attributes.description: Total land area of the comparable sale property parcel measured in square feet. Critical for land valuation, FAR analysis, and comparability assessment for properties where land value is a significant component.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: nla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Leasable Area in Square Feet (NLA SQF)
attributes.description: Net leasable area (NLA) of the comparable sale property measured in square feet, excluding common areas. Used as an alternative unit of comparison for properties where NLA is the market-standard measurement basis.
attributes.references: Building Owners and Managers Association (BOMA) Measurement Standards; Appraisal Institute USPAP

attributes.name: noi_at_sale
attributes.description: The net operating income (NOI) of the comparable property at the time of sale, used to calculate the implied CAP rate and to support income approach cross-validation in the appraisal.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; Argus Enterprise; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: number_of_stories
attributes.description: Total number of above-grade floors or stories in the comparable sale property. Used as a physical characteristic for comparability assessment and adjustment.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; CoStar Suite

attributes.name: occupancy_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the comparable property that was occupied at the time of sale. Used to assess income-producing capacity and to determine whether occupancy-related adjustments are required.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; CoStar Suite

attributes.name: parking_spaces
attributes.description: Total number of parking spaces (surface, structured, or underground) associated with the comparable sale property. Used to assess parking ratio and determine parking-related adjustments.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; CoStar Suite

attributes.name: physical_adjustment_pct
attributes.description: Percentage adjustment applied to the comparable sale price to account for physical differences between the comparable and subject property (e.g., size, age, condition, quality, amenities). Positive values indicate the subject is superior.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code of the comparable sale property location. Used for submarket delineation, geographic clustering, and location adjustment analysis.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite

attributes.name: price_psf
attributes.description: Sale price divided by the gross leasable area or building area, expressed as price per square foot (PSF). A primary unit-of-comparison metric used in the sales comparison approach for commercial and residential appraisals.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: price_psm
attributes.description: Sale price divided by the building area expressed in square meters (SQM). Used for international valuations and IVSC-compliant reporting where metric units are required.
attributes.references: IVSC International Valuation Standards; ISO 80000-3 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: property_subtype
attributes.description: More granular classification of the comparable property within its property type (e.g., Class A Office, Strip Center, Bulk Warehouse, Garden Apartment). Supports refined comparability analysis.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: quality_rating
attributes.description: Rating of the construction quality and finish level of the comparable sale property. Used to assess quality-based adjustments in the sales comparison approach.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; Fannie Mae Uniform Appraisal Dataset (UAD) Quality Ratings

attributes.name: sale_date
attributes.description: The date on which the comparable property sale was recorded or closed, used as the principal business event date for time adjustment calculations in the sales comparison approach.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: sale_price
attributes.description: The gross transaction price at which the comparable property sold, expressed in the local currency. This is the unadjusted arm's-length sale price as recorded in deed or public record.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement

attributes.name: time_adjustment_pct
attributes.description: Percentage adjustment applied to the comparable sale price to account for market conditions changes between the comparable sale date and the effective appraisal date. Reflects market appreciation or depreciation over the intervening period.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this comparable sale record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail, data lineage, and change tracking requirements.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the comparable sale data was verified against the primary source. Supports USPAP compliance documentation and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the accuracy of the comparable sale data (e.g., public deed record, direct buyer/seller confirmation, broker confirmation, CoStar verification). Required by USPAP Standard 1 for sales comparison approach documentation.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current verification status of the comparable sale record indicating whether the sale data has been confirmed against primary sources (deed records, CoStar, MLS, or direct buyer/seller confirmation) per USPAP verification requirements.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: year_built
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the comparable sale property was originally constructed. Used to assess age-related physical depreciation and comparability with the subject property.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: comp_property_name

attributes.name: comp_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known identifier or deal reference number assigned to this comparable lease transaction, as sourced from CoStar, MLS, or direct broker confirmation. Serves as the business-facing unique code for the comp record.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: condition_adjustment_pct
attributes.description: Percentage adjustment applied to the comparable lease rent to account for differences in building condition, quality, or finish level between the comparable and subject properties.

attributes.name: costar_property_reference
attributes.description: CoStar Suite's unique property identifier for the comparable property. Enables direct cross-reference to CoStar market data for automated comp retrieval and market analytics.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Primary source from which the comparable lease transaction data was obtained (e.g., CoStar Suite, MLS, direct landlord/tenant confirmation, broker, public record). Determines the reliability tier of the comp in IVSC-compliant methodology documentation.
attributes.references: International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC) IVS 105; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: effective_rent_psf
attributes.description: Net effective rent per square foot after accounting for free rent periods, tenant improvement allowances, and other landlord concessions amortized over the lease term. Provides a true economic rent comparison across leases with varying concession packages.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC) IVS 105

attributes.name: expansion_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the comparable lease includes a tenant expansion option for additional space. Relevant for assessing tenant demand and flexibility provisions in market analysis.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: free_rent_months
attributes.description: Number of months of rent abatement (free rent) granted to the tenant at lease commencement. A landlord concession that reduces effective rent; used to normalize comparable leases to a common economic basis.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC) IVS 105

attributes.name: lease_commencement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the comparable lease term officially commenced and the tenant took occupancy or began paying rent. Used to determine the effective market date and calculate free rent periods.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: lease_execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the comparable lease agreement was fully executed (signed) by both landlord and tenant. Establishes the market date for the transaction, critical for time-adjustment analysis in income approach valuations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: lease_expiration_date
attributes.description: Scheduled expiration date of the comparable lease term. Used in conjunction with commencement date to validate the stated lease term in months.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16

attributes.name: lease_size_sqf
attributes.description: Total leased area of the comparable lease expressed in square feet (SQF). Used to assess scale comparability with the subject property and to weight rent conclusions in market analysis.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: lease_size_sqm
attributes.description: Total leased area of the comparable lease expressed in square meters (SQM). Used for international market comparisons and IVSC-compliant valuation reports.

attributes.name: lease_term_months
attributes.description: Total duration of the comparable lease expressed in months from commencement to expiration. A key comparability factor in market rent analysis; longer terms typically command lower effective rents.

attributes.name: location_adjustment_pct
attributes.description: Percentage adjustment applied to the comparable lease rent to account for locational differences between the comparable and subject properties. Part of the grid adjustment methodology in income approach valuations.

attributes.name: operating_expense_stop_psf

attributes.description: Base year operating expense stop per square foot above which the tenant is responsible for expense increases. Common in modified gross leases; used to normalize rent comparisons across different expense structures.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the comparable property location. Supports geographic clustering and submarket boundary analysis.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: rent_escalation_type

attributes.name: state_province

attributes.name: ti_allowance_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Improvement Allowance Per Square Foot (TI PSF)

attributes.name: time_adjustment_pct
attributes.description: Percentage adjustment applied to the comparable lease rent to account for market conditions between the lease execution date and the valuation date. Used in the sales comparison and income approaches to normalize historical comps to current market.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC) IVS 105

attributes.name: verification_date

After merge with cost_approach, this is the unified approach model for all valuation methodologies.
