attributes.name: approach_date
attributes.description: Effective date as of which the valuation approach analysis is performed. Represents the appraisal effective date for this specific methodology, which may differ from the report date.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 101 — Scope of Work; USPAP Standards Rule 1-2(b)

attributes.name: approach_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this valuation approach record within the appraisal workflow. Tracks progression from initial draft through peer review, approval, and potential supersession by a revised approach.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 101 — Scope of Work; Appraisal Institute USPAP

attributes.name: approach_type
attributes.description: Discriminator identifying the valuation methodology applied in this record. Supported types: direct_cap (Direct Capitalization), DCF (Discounted Cash Flow), cost (Cost Approach), sales_comparison (Sales Comparison Approach), GRM (Gross Rent Multiplier). Drives which set of methodology-specific fields are populated.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 — Valuation Approaches and Methods; Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this valuation approach was formally approved by the reviewing appraiser or valuation committee. Marks the transition from in_review to approved status in the approach lifecycle.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC IVS 101 — Scope of Work

attributes.name: argus_model_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path for the Argus Enterprise cash flow model associated with this DCF valuation approach. Enables traceability back to the source Argus model for audit, review, and replication purposes. Populated for DCF approach type.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; IVSC IVS 101 — Scope of Work

attributes.name: cap_rate
attributes.description: Overall capitalization rate (CAP rate) applied to stabilized NOI to derive the direct capitalization value. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0550 = 5.50%). Derived from market comparable sales analysis and reflects investor return expectations for the asset class and submarket.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute — The Appraisal of Real Estate, 15th Ed.; IVSC IVS 105; CoStar Market Analytics

attributes.name: comparable_count
attributes.description: Number of comparable sales or lease transactions used to support the approach inputs (e.g., CAP rate derivation for direct cap, market rent for income approaches, adjusted sales for sales comparison). Indicates the depth of market evidence supporting the concluded value.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1; IVSC IVS 105; CoStar Comparable Data

attributes.name: concluded_market_rent_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Concluded Market Rent Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Appraiser's concluded market rent per square foot (PSF) used as the basis for PGI estimation in income capitalization approaches. Derived from comparable lease analysis and market surveys. Expressed in the reporting currency per square foot per year.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute — The Appraisal of Real Estate, 15th Ed.; RESO Data Dictionary; CoStar Comparable Lease Data

attributes.name: concluded_value
attributes.description: The indicated market value produced by this specific valuation approach before reconciliation weighting. Represents the raw output of the methodology (e.g., direct capitalization value, DCF NPV, depreciated cost, or sales comparison adjusted value) in the reporting currency.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 820 — Fair Value Measurement

attributes.name: cost_index_source
attributes.description: Source of the construction cost index or cost manual used to estimate RCN in the cost approach. Common sources include Marshall & Swift Valuation Service and RSMeans Cost Data. Supports methodology transparency and IVSC IVS 105 compliance documentation.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 — Cost Approach; Marshall & Swift Valuation Service; RSMeans Cost Data

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp recording when this valuation approach record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls for valuation records used in financial reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; FASB ASC 820; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: depreciated_cost_of_improvements
attributes.description: Net value of the improvements after deducting total accrued depreciation (physical, functional, and external obsolescence) from RCN. Added to land value to derive the cost approach indicated value. Populated for cost approach type.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 — Cost Approach; Appraisal Institute USPAP

attributes.name: direct_cap_value
attributes.description: Indicated value derived by dividing stabilized NOI by the overall CAP rate (NOI / CAP Rate). Represents the concluded value under the direct capitalization method. Populated only when approach_type = direct_cap.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute — The Appraisal of Real Estate, 15th Ed.; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: Risk-adjusted discount rate (expressed as a decimal) used in the DCF analysis to convert projected future cash flows to present value. Reflects the required rate of return for the investment, incorporating market risk, asset type, and leverage. Populated for DCF approach type.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise DCF Methodology; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: economic_life_years
attributes.description: Total estimated economic life of the improvements in years — the period over which the building is expected to contribute positively to property value. Used with effective age to calculate the age-life depreciation ratio in the cost approach.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 — Cost Approach; Appraisal Institute — The Appraisal of Real Estate, 15th Ed.

attributes.name: effective_age_years
attributes.description: Appraiser's estimate of the effective age of the improvements in years, reflecting the actual condition and utility of the building relative to a new structure of similar type. May differ from chronological age due to renovations or deferred maintenance. Used in cost approach depreciation calculations.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 — Cost Approach; Appraisal Institute — The Appraisal of Real Estate, 15th Ed.

attributes.name: egi
attributes.description: Effective Gross Income — PGI adjusted for vacancy, credit loss, and other income (e.g., parking, ancillary revenue). Represents the realistic annual income the property is expected to generate. Populated for direct_cap and DCF approach types.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute — The Appraisal of Real Estate, 15th Ed.; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: external_obsolescence
attributes.description: Loss in value caused by factors external to the property, such as adverse market conditions, neighborhood decline, or proximity to negative influences. Also known as economic obsolescence. Deducted from RCN in the cost approach.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 — Cost Approach; Appraisal Institute — The Appraisal of Real Estate, 15th Ed.

attributes.name: functional_obsolescence
attributes.description: Loss in value resulting from deficiencies or superadequacies in the design, layout, or functionality of the improvements relative to current market standards (e.g., outdated floor plans, inadequate HVAC systems). Deducted from RCN in the cost approach.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 — Cost Approach; Appraisal Institute — The Appraisal of Real Estate, 15th Ed.

attributes.name: grm
attributes.description: Gross Rent Multiplier — the ratio of property value to gross annual (or monthly) rental income, derived from comparable sales. Applied to the subject property's gross rent to estimate value under the GRM approach. Populated when approach_type = GRM.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute — The Appraisal of Real Estate, 15th Ed.; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: hold_period_years
attributes.description: Projected investment hold period in years used in the DCF analysis. Defines the number of annual cash flow periods modeled before the terminal reversion value is calculated. Typically ranges from 5 to 15 years for commercial real estate. Populated for DCF approach type.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise DCF Methodology

attributes.name: irr
attributes.description: Internal Rate of Return — the discount rate at which the net present value of all projected cash flows (including acquisition cost and terminal reversion) equals zero. Key investment performance metric output from the DCF model. Populated for DCF approach type.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise; CFA Institute — Real Estate Valuation

attributes.name: ivsc_methodology_code
attributes.description: IVSC IVS 105 methodology classification code identifying the specific valuation technique applied (e.g., IVS105-IC for Income Capitalization, IVS105-CA for Cost Approach, IVS105-SC for Sales Comparison). Supports regulatory compliance documentation and cross-border reporting.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 — Valuation Approaches and Methods

attributes.name: land_value
attributes.description: Estimated market value of the land component as if vacant and available for its highest and best use. Used in the cost approach as the foundation to which depreciated cost of improvements is added. Populated for cost approach type.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 — Cost Approach; Appraisal Institute USPAP

attributes.name: methodology_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing appraiser commentary on the rationale, assumptions, limitations, and adjustments specific to this valuation approach. Supports IVSC IVS 105 compliance, USPAP disclosure requirements, and peer review documentation.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; Appraisal Institute USPAP Standards Rule 2-2; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: noi
attributes.description: Net Operating Income — EGI minus total OPEX. The primary income metric used in direct capitalization and DCF valuation. Represents the annual pre-debt, pre-tax cash flow generated by the property. Populated for direct_cap and DCF approach types.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute — The Appraisal of Real Estate, 15th Ed.; IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: npv
attributes.description: Net Present Value — the sum of all discounted future cash flows minus the initial investment cost, as output by the DCF model. A positive NPV indicates value creation above the required return. Populated for DCF approach type.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: pgi
attributes.description: Potential Gross Income — the maximum annual rental revenue the property could generate at 100% occupancy at market rent. Used as the starting point for income capitalization approaches (direct cap and DCF). Populated for direct_cap and DCF approach types.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute — The Appraisal of Real Estate, 15th Ed.; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: physical_depreciation
attributes.description: Loss in value attributable to physical deterioration of the improvements, including curable deferred maintenance and incurable structural wear. Deducted from RCN in the cost approach. Populated for cost approach type.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 — Cost Approach; Appraisal Institute — The Appraisal of Real Estate, 15th Ed.

attributes.name: rent_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which the concluded market rent is expressed. Indicates whether the rent is annual or monthly and the lease structure (NNN — Triple Net, gross, or modified gross) that underpins the income analysis.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; RESO Data Dictionary; NAR Lease Standards

attributes.name: replacement_cost_new
attributes.description: Replacement Cost New (RCN) — the estimated cost to construct a building of equivalent utility using current materials, standards, and design at current prices. Starting point for the cost approach before depreciation deductions. Populated for cost approach type.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 — Cost Approach; Marshall & Swift Valuation Service; RSMeans Cost Data

attributes.name: sensitivity_notes
attributes.description: Narrative description of key sensitivity scenarios tested for this approach, such as the impact of a 25 bps change in CAP rate or discount rate on concluded value. Supports investment decision-making and risk disclosure in appraisal reports.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise Sensitivity Analysis; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: terminal_cap_rate
attributes.description: Reversion or terminal CAP rate applied to the projected NOI in the final year of the hold period to estimate the property's residual (terminal) value in a DCF analysis. Typically higher than the going-in CAP rate to reflect future uncertainty. Populated for DCF approach type.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise DCF Methodology; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: total_opex
attributes.description: Total annual operating expenses (OPEX) for the subject property, including property taxes, insurance, management fees, maintenance, utilities, and reserves for replacement. Deducted from EGI to derive NOI. Populated for income capitalization approaches.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute — The Appraisal of Real Estate, 15th Ed.; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp recording the most recent modification to this valuation approach record. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; FASB ASC 820; ISO 55000 — Asset Management

attributes.name: vacancy_credit_loss_rate
attributes.description: Estimated rate (decimal fraction) applied to PGI to account for expected vacancy and uncollectible rent. For example, 0.05 represents a 5% vacancy and credit loss allowance. Used in income capitalization to derive EGI from PGI.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute — The Appraisal of Real Estate, 15th Ed.; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: weight_pct
attributes.description: Weighting factor (expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1) assigned to this approach in the final value reconciliation. For example, 0.60 indicates this approach contributes 60% to the concluded value. All approach weights for a given valuation should sum to 1.0.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105 §50 — Reconciliation; Appraisal Institute USPAP Standard 1

products.name: dcf_model
products.description: Discounted Cash Flow model record linked to an Argus Enterprise model file. Stores Argus model ID, model version, hold period start and end dates, annual cash flow projections (year 1–10+), reversion/terminal value, discount rate (IRR target), NPV at various discount rates, levered vs. unlevered IRR, equity multiple, DSCR per period, LTV at acquisition, and model assumptions narrative. Serves as the quantitative backbone for investment-grade valuations and acquisition underwriting.

attributes.name: acquisition_price
attributes.description: Total assumed purchase price of the property at the start of the hold period, used as the basis for LTV, equity multiple, and IRR calculations.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Acquisition Cost Input; IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 805

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this DCF model was formally approved by the designated reviewer or investment committee. Required for SOX audit trail and governance compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; IVSC IVS 101; Internal Valuation Governance

attributes.name: argus_model_reference
attributes.description: Native model identifier assigned by Argus Enterprise to the source cash flow model file. Used to trace back to the originating Argus Enterprise model for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling Module

attributes.name: argus_model_version
attributes.description: Version label of the Argus Enterprise model file (e.g., v1.0, v2.3-final) to distinguish iterative revisions of the same model.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling Module

attributes.name: avg_dscr
attributes.description: Average annual Debt Service Coverage Ratio across the hold period, calculated as NOI divided by annual debt service. Lenders typically require a minimum DSCR of 1.20x–1.25x.
attributes.references: CMBS Underwriting Standards; Argus Enterprise DSCR Output; Federal Reserve Regulation Y

attributes.name: capex_reserve_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) Reserve Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Annual capital expenditure reserve amount per square foot budgeted for building improvements, tenant improvements (TI), and leasing commissions over the hold period.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise CAPEX Reserve; NCREIF Capital Expenditure Standards; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DCF model record was first created in the lakehouse Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(e); Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: debt_amount
attributes.description: Total debt (mortgage or loan) assumed at acquisition used to finance the property purchase. Drives LTV and DSCR calculations within the model.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Financing Assumptions; FASB ASC 470; CMBS/RMBS underwriting standards

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The target Internal Rate of Return (IRR) used as the discount rate to compute Net Present Value (NPV) of projected cash flows. Reflects the required return on investment for this asset.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Discount Rate Input; IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: equity_investment
attributes.description: Total equity capital contributed at acquisition, representing the difference between acquisition price and debt financing. Used to compute levered IRR and equity multiple.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; ULI Real Estate Finance; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: equity_multiple
attributes.description: Total equity distributions (cash flows plus net reversion proceeds) divided by total equity invested. An equity multiple of 2.0x means the investor doubles their equity over the hold period.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; ULI Real Estate Finance; NCREIF Performance Measurement

attributes.name: expense_growth_rate
attributes.description: Assumed annual percentage increase in operating expenses (OPEX) applied across the projection period. Typically benchmarked to CPI or market inflation indices.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Expense Growth Input; BLS CPI; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: going_in_cap_rate
attributes.description: The capitalization rate implied by the acquisition price and Year 1 NOI. Used to benchmark the entry pricing against market comparables and assess acquisition risk.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; Appraisal Institute; CoStar Market Analytics; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: hold_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the modeled investment hold period ends, representing the assumed disposition or reversion date.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Hold Period Parameter; IVSC IVS 105; ULI Real Estate Finance

attributes.name: hold_period_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the modeled investment hold period commences, typically the assumed acquisition or ownership transfer date.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Hold Period Parameter; IVSC IVS 105; ULI Real Estate Finance

attributes.name: hold_period_years
attributes.description: Total duration of the modeled investment hold period expressed in whole years (e.g., 10 for a 10-year hold). Drives the number of annual cash flow projection periods.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; IVSC IVS 105; ULI Real Estate Finance

attributes.name: is_levered
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DCF model incorporates debt financing (levered analysis). True = levered model with debt service; False = unlevered all-equity model.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Financing Toggle; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: levered_irr
attributes.description: The Internal Rate of Return computed on levered (equity) cash flows after debt service. Reflects the actual return to equity investors accounting for financial leverage.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise IRR Output; IVSC IVS 105; CFA Institute Real Estate Valuation

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of the debt amount to the acquisition price at the time of underwriting, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.65 for 65% LTV). Key metric for lender and investor risk assessment.
attributes.references: CMBS/RMBS Underwriting Standards; FASB ASC 310; Federal Reserve Regulation Y

attributes.name: methodology_standard
attributes.description: The governing valuation methodology standard applied in constructing this DCF model. Ensures compliance with applicable appraisal and financial reporting frameworks.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; Appraisal Institute USPAP; RICS Red Book; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: min_dscr
attributes.description: The lowest annual DSCR observed across all projection periods in the hold period. Identifies the most stressed year for debt coverage, critical for lender covenant compliance.
attributes.references: CMBS Underwriting Standards; Argus Enterprise DSCR Output; Federal Reserve Regulation Y

attributes.name: model_assumptions_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the key assumptions, market conditions, data sources, and qualifications underlying this DCF model. Required for IVSC-compliant methodology disclosure and investment committee review.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 101 Clause 20.4; Appraisal Institute USPAP SR 2-2; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for this DCF model record, formatted as DCF-YYYY-NNNNNN. Used in investment committee presentations, audit trails, and cross-system references.
attributes.references: Internal Valuation Governance Standard; IVSC IVS 105

attributes.name: model_purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose for which this DCF model was constructed. Determines the applicable methodology standards and reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: acquisition_underwriting|disposition_analysis|refinancing|annual_valuation|portfolio_reporting|impairment_testing|loan_origination — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 820; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: model_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the DCF model record. Controls which version is authoritative for investment decisions and financial reporting.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 101; FASB ASC 820; Internal Valuation Governance

attributes.name: net_reversion_proceeds
attributes.description: Gross reversion value less estimated selling costs, representing the net cash inflow to the investor upon disposition at the end of the hold period.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; IVSC IVS 105; ULI Real Estate Finance

attributes.name: npv_at_discount_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Present Value (NPV) at Discount Rate
attributes.description: Net Present Value of all projected cash flows (including reversion) discounted at the model's target discount rate. Positive NPV indicates value creation above the required return threshold.
attributes.references: IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 820; Argus Enterprise NPV Output

attributes.name: rent_growth_rate
attributes.description: Assumed annual percentage increase in market rents applied across the projection period. Drives revenue escalation in the DCF cash flow schedule.

attributes.name: is_published
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NAV calculation has been formally published and communicated to investors or regulators (True) or remains an internal working estimate (False). Controls investor disclosure workflow.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this NAV calculation record. Supports change tracking, SOX audit trail, and incremental data processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Portfolio-level Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio, calculated as total debt outstanding divided by GAV. Key leverage metric monitored by lenders, investors, and rating agencies for CMBS and REIT credit analysis.

attributes.name: methodology_notes

attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; IVSC General Standards; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: nav_change
attributes.description: Absolute change in NAV from the prior period to the current calculation date (current NAV minus prior NAV). Supports period-over-period performance reporting to investors and the board.
attributes.references: NAREIT NAV Methodology; SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: nav_per_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Asset Value (NAV) Per Unit / Share
attributes.description: NAV divided by total units or shares outstanding, representing the per-unit intrinsic value of the fund or REIT. Key metric for investor reporting, unit pricing, and performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: NAREIT NAV Methodology; SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 820; IFRS 13

attributes.name: net_asset_value
attributes.description: Net Asset Value (NAV) of the portfolio or fund, calculated as GAV minus total debt outstanding minus other liabilities. The primary output metric used in REIT investor reporting, unit pricing, and SEC fair value disclosures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; NAREIT NAV Methodology; SEC Regulation S-X; IVSC General Standards

attributes.name: noi_total
attributes.description: Aggregate Net Operating Income (NOI) across all properties included in this NAV calculation, representing total effective gross income minus operating expenses before debt service. Primary input to direct capitalization and DCF valuation methodologies.
attributes.references: IVSC General Standards; Appraisal Institute USPAP; NAREIT FFO White Paper; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: prior_nav
attributes.description: NAV from the immediately preceding calculation period, used to compute period-over-period NAV change and growth rate for investor reporting and performance attribution.

attributes.name: property_count
attributes.description: Total count of properties included in this NAV/GAV calculation. Provides a completeness check and supports reconciliation against the portfolio property register in Argus Enterprise or MRI Software.

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: The date on which this NAV calculation was formally published and made available to investors or filed with regulators. Null if not yet published.

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: The financial reporting period this NAV calculation corresponds to (e.g., Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Annual, Monthly). Aligns the calculation with the fund's financial reporting calendar for investor and SEC reporting.

attributes.name: reporting_year
attributes.description: The fiscal or calendar year associated with this NAV calculation (e.g., 2024). Used in conjunction with reporting_period to uniquely identify the reporting cycle.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: straight_line_rent_adjustment
attributes.description: Non-cash straight-line rent adjustment applied to AFFO, representing the difference between contractual rent escalations recognized on a straight-line basis under ASC 842 and actual cash rent received. Standard REIT AFFO adjustment.

attributes.name: third_party_appraiser
attributes.description: Name of the external appraisal firm or certified appraiser (MAI designation, Appraisal Institute member) engaged to provide independent property valuations used in this NAV calculation. Required when valuation_methodology includes third-party appraisal.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC General Standards; FASB ASC 820 Level 3 documentation

attributes.name: total_debt_outstanding
attributes.description: Aggregate outstanding debt balance (mortgages, credit facilities, CMBS, and other borrowings) secured against or attributable to the portfolio as of the calculation date. Deducted from GAV to arrive at NAV.

attributes.name: units_outstanding
attributes.description: Total number of fund units or REIT shares outstanding as of the calculation date. Used as the denominator to compute NAV per unit/share for investor reporting and unit pricing.

attributes.name: valuation_methodology
attributes.description: The primary methodology used to determine property market values feeding into the GAV calculation. Options include direct capitalization (applying a CAP rate to NOI), Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), third-party appraisal, a blended approach, or a proprietary NAV model. Aligns with IVSC and FASB ASC 820 fair value hierarchy.
attributes.references: IVSC General Standards; FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; Appraisal Institute USPAP

attributes.name: weighted_avg_cap_rate
attributes.description: Portfolio-level weighted average CAP rate (Capitalization Rate) applied across all properties in the NAV calculation, weighted by property value. Used to validate the implied GAV against market benchmarks and support investor reporting.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute USPAP; IVSC General Standards; FASB ASC 820; CoStar Suite Market Analytics

products.name: nav_appraisal_input
products.description: This association product represents the formal input record (Contract/Schedule) between a NAV calculation and a constituent appraisal. It captures which appraisal values were used as inputs to a specific NAV/GAV calculation, at what proportional weight, and what dollar contribution each appraisal made to the total GAV. Each record links one nav_calculation to one appraisal and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this specific input relationship — the weight, contribution, effective date used, and coverage flag. This is the operational record that fund accountants and valuation teams manage to support REIT financial reporting, SEC disclosures, and ASC 820 fair value documentation.. Existence Justification: In real estate fund management, NAV calculations are formal periodic exercises (monthly, quarterly, annually) that aggregate appraised values across all portfolio properties — a single NAV calculation genuinely consumes many appraisals as inputs. Conversely, a single appraisal (e.g., a Q3 independent appraisal of a Class A office building) feeds into multiple NAV calculations over time: the current period's fund-level NAV, a prior-period restatement, and potentially multiple fund structures that hold the same asset. This is an operationally managed relationship — fund accountants and valuation teams actively track which appraisals were used in which NAV calculation, at what weight, and what value contribution each appraisal made.

Relevant for FASB ASC 820 Level 3 disclosure and investor transparency. [Moved from nav_calculation: This aggregate percentage on nav_calculation is DERIVED from the individual appraisal_coverage_flag values on each nav_appraisal_input record. It is a computed rollup of the association data, not an independently maintained attribute of the NAV calculation itself. It should be computed from the association table rather than stored redundantly on nav_calculation. Includes closeout lifecycle attributes: COO number and issuance date, as-built document delivery date, warranty registration, final retainage release date, O&M manual submission status, and closeout package completion. Also records Procore project ID for source-system traceability. SSOT for all development project identity and full lifecycle from inception through closeout and handoff to asset management.

attributes.references: Procore Construction Budget; Yardi Voyager Accounts Payable; SAP S/4HANA AP

attributes.name: hard_cost_budget_usd

attributes.references: Procore Construction Budget; FASB ASC 360

products.name: entitlement
products.description: Tracks all entitlement activities and FAR compliance calculations for a development project — zoning approvals, variances, conditional use permits, environmental impact reviews, and planning commission decisions. Captures entitlement type, jurisdiction, application date, approval date, conditions of approval, and entitlement status. Includes FAR compliance detail: zoning district, base FAR allowance, bonus FAR mechanisms (affordable housing, open space, transit), total allowable FAR, proposed gross floor area, proposed FAR, as-built FAR, and FAR compliance status. Also records density limits, height restrictions, and the governing regulatory authority. Links to the parent dev_project. SSOT for all entitlement and zoning compliance data within the development domain.

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: hearing_date

attributes.name: max_building_height_ft
attributes.description: Maximum permitted building height in feet as established by the applicable zoning ordinance or as approved through the entitlement process. A key development constraint tracked for compliance.

attributes.name: max_density_units
attributes.description: Maximum number of residential dwelling units permitted on the subject parcel under the applicable zoning ordinance or as approved through the entitlement. Applicable to residential and mixed-use developments.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, internal commentary, or supplementary information related to the entitlement that does not fit into structured fields. Used by project managers and entitlement teams for operational notes.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: proposed_building_height_ft
attributes.description: Proposed building height in feet as submitted in the entitlement application. Must not exceed the maximum permitted height unless a height variance has been approved.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: proposed_far
attributes.description: The FAR proposed by the development project as submitted in the entitlement application. Calculated as proposed gross floor area divided by gross site area. Must not exceed total allowable FAR for compliance.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: proposed_gross_floor_area_sqf
attributes.description: Total proposed gross floor area of the development in square feet (SQF) as submitted in the entitlement application. Used to calculate proposed FAR and assess compliance with density limits.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: proposed_units
attributes.description: Number of residential dwelling units proposed in the development application. Compared against maximum density units to assess density compliance.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Specific regulatory body or planning commission responsible for adjudicating this entitlement (e.g., 'City Planning Commission', 'Board of Zoning Appeals', 'Environmental Review Board'). May differ from the broader jurisdiction.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: site_area_sqf
attributes.description: Gross area of the subject development parcel in square feet (SQF). Used as the denominator in FAR calculations and for density limit assessments.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: total_allowable_far
attributes.description: The maximum permitted FAR for the subject parcel, calculated as the sum of base FAR allowance and any approved bonus FAR. Represents the regulatory ceiling for building density on the site.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this entitlement record was last modified. Used for incremental data processing, change detection, and audit trail compliance in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: coo_issuance_date

attributes.name: coo_issued

attributes.name: coo_number

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: environmental_review_required

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: fee_payment_date

attributes.name: final_inspection_date

attributes.name: inspection_result_notes

attributes.name: inspection_status

attributes.name: issuance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the permit was officially issued by the authority. Marks the start of the authorized construction window and triggers the permit validity period.

attributes.name: issuing_authority

attributes.name: permit_conditions

attributes.name: permit_description

attributes.name: permit_fee_amount

attributes.name: permit_fee_paid

attributes.name: permit_number

attributes.name: permit_phase

attributes.name: permit_status

attributes.name: revision_number

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1926

attributes.name: general_liability_limit

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_number

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_per_day

attributes.name: minority_business_required

attributes.name: performance_bond_amount

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_required

Captures change order number, originating contract, change type, description of scope change, cost impact, schedule impact (days), approval status, approval date, approving authority, and cumulative change order total against the contract. SSOT for construction change order tracking within the development domain. Critical for contract value management, budget variance analysis, and dispute documentation.

attributes.description: Calendar date on which the change order received final approval from the designated approving authority. Triggers contract value adjustment and schedule extension recognition.

attributes.name: cost_code
attributes.description: Project cost code or CSI MasterFormat division code to which the change order cost impact is allocated. Enables cost tracking by trade, work type, and budget line item within the project CAPEX budget.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; CSI MasterFormat; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: cost_impact_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary cost impact of the change order on the contract value, expressed in the contract currency. Positive values indicate additions to contract value; negative values indicate deductions (credits). Core field for CAPEX budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; FASB ASC 840 CAPEX; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the change order record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; FASB ASC 840; Procore Construction and Development Project Management

attributes.name: cumulative_co_amount
attributes.description: Running total of all approved change order cost impacts against the originating contract as of this change order's approval, inclusive of the current change order. Represents the total contract value adjustment from original contract sum. Used for contract value management and budget variance reporting.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G702/G703; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: dispute_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the nature of the dispute if the change order is contested, including the basis of disagreement on scope, cost, or schedule impact. Populated only when is_disputed is True.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G701

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the approved change order takes contractual effect, which may differ from the approval date. Governs when the contractor is authorized to proceed with changed scope and when schedule adjustments commence.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code in SAP S/4HANA or Yardi Voyager to which the change order cost impact is posted for financial consolidation and CAPEX capitalization. Aligns with the chart of accounts for fixed asset and project accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; Yardi Voyager General Ledger; FASB ASC 840 CAPEX; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: is_disputed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change order is currently subject to a formal dispute between the owner and contractor. Disputed change orders require separate tracking for legal and claims management purposes.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G701

attributes.name: is_time_and_material
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change order is priced on a time-and-material basis rather than a lump sum or unit price. T&M change orders require field verification of labor hours and material quantities before final cost settlement.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G701

attributes.name: justification
attributes.description: Business or technical justification for the change order, including root cause analysis, reference to RFIs, design bulletins, or site conditions that necessitated the change. Supports dispute resolution and owner approval.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G701

attributes.name: lump_sum_amount
attributes.description: Fixed lump sum price agreed for the change order scope when priced on a lump sum basis. Null when the change order is priced on a time-and-material or unit price basis.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G701

attributes.name: markup_percentage
attributes.description: Overhead and profit markup percentage applied by the contractor to direct costs on this change order, as negotiated per the contract terms. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Used for cost reasonableness review.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G701

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable identifier for the change order as assigned in Procore or the contract administration system. Used in correspondence, RFIs, and dispute documentation. Format: CO-{ProjectCode}-{Sequence}.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G701 Change Order

attributes.name: original_contract_amount
attributes.description: The original executed contract sum prior to any change orders, captured at the time of this change order for reference and variance calculation. Supports contract value management and budget baseline reporting.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G701; FASB ASC 840 CAPEX

attributes.name: prime_contract_co_number
attributes.description: Change order number as recorded on the prime (owner-contractor) contract, which may differ from the internal Procore sequence number. Used for cross-referencing with owner records and AIA G701 documentation.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G701

attributes.name: procore_co_reference
attributes.description: Native change order identifier from the Procore Construction Management system, used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational source system.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management

attributes.name: retention_percentage
attributes.description: Retainage percentage withheld from progress payments on this change order, as specified in the contract. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10%). Governs cash flow and payment application processing.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G702/G703

attributes.name: revised_contract_amount
attributes.description: Updated total contract value after incorporating this change order, equal to the original contract amount plus cumulative change order amounts. Represents the current contract sum for payment application and budget tracking purposes.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G701; FASB ASC 840 CAPEX; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision counter for the change order, incremented each time the change order is revised prior to final approval. Revision 0 represents the original submission.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G701

attributes.name: schedule_impact_days

attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G701

attributes.name: scope_description

attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G701

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the change order was formally submitted by the contractor or owner for review and approval. Marks the start of the approval clock for contractual response-time obligations.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G701

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Applicable sales tax, use tax, or VAT amount included in the change order cost impact. Tracked separately for tax accounting and CAPEX capitalization purposes.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; FASB ASC 840 CAPEX; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the change order record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for incremental data loading, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; Procore Construction and Development Project Management

attributes.name: work_completed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the physical work associated with the change order was substantially completed in the field. Used for payment application timing and project milestone tracking.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management; AIA Document G702/G703

products.name: draw_request
products.description: Captures each CAPEX draw request (AIA G702/G703 pay application) submitted for payment against a construction contract, along with all associated lien waivers. Draw-level data: draw number, billing period, scheduled value, work completed to date, materials stored, total earned, retainage withheld, net payment due, lender approval status, title company review status, and disbursement date. Lien waiver detail per draw: waiver type (conditional/unconditional, progress/final), executing party (contractor or subcontractor), waiver amount, through-date, execution date, notarization status, and document storage reference. SSOT for construction payment applications and lien waiver compliance within the development domain. Critical for construction loan administration, CAPEX cash flow management, and lender/title requirements.
products.reference: AIA G702 Pay Application / CAPEX Draw

attributes.name: lender_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the construction lender formally approved this draw request for disbursement from the construction loan facility.
attributes.references: Construction Loan Administration Best Practices

attributes.name: lender_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of the construction lender's review and approval of this draw request. Lender approval is required before funds are disbursed from the construction loan facility. Critical for construction loan administration.
attributes.references: Construction Loan Administration Best Practices; CMBS Servicing Standards

attributes.name: lien_waiver_status
attributes.description: Aggregate status of lien waiver collection for this draw request across all contractors and subcontractors. Indicates whether all required conditional and/or unconditional lien waivers have been received and validated.

attributes.name: materials_stored
attributes.description: Dollar value of materials and equipment presently stored on-site or in bonded storage but not yet incorporated into the work (Column F on AIA G703). Subject to lender approval and may require stored materials agreement.

attributes.name: original_contract_amount
attributes.description: The original executed contract sum as stated in the construction contract before any approved change orders. Corresponds to the 'Original Contract Sum' field on AIA G702. Used as the baseline for tracking contract value changes.
attributes.references: AIA G702 Application and Certificate for Payment; FASB ASC 840/842

attributes.name: owner_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the property owner or owner's representative formally approved this draw request for submission to the construction lender.
attributes.references: AIA G702; Construction Loan Administration Best Practices

attributes.name: owner_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of the owner's review and approval of this draw request. Owner approval is required before lender disbursement can be initiated.
attributes.references: AIA G702; Construction Loan Administration Best Practices

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: Overall percentage of the contract work completed to date, calculated as total_earned_to_date divided by revised_contract_amount. Corresponds to Column H on AIA G703. Critical metric for lender draw approval and construction loan monitoring.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet; Construction Loan Administration

attributes.name: previous_payments
attributes.description: Total amount of all prior certified payments made to the contractor under this contract. Corresponds to 'Less Previous Certificates for Payment' on AIA G702. Used to calculate the current net payment due.
attributes.references: AIA G702 Application and Certificate for Payment

attributes.name: procore_draw_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier for this draw request record within Procore Construction Management system. Used for system-of-record traceability and data lineage from the source operational system.

attributes.name: retainage_rate
attributes.description: Contractual retainage percentage applied to earned value for this draw (e.g., 0.1000 = 10%). May be reduced at substantial completion milestones per contract terms. Stored as a decimal fraction.
attributes.references: AIA A201 General Conditions; State Prompt Payment Acts

attributes.name: retainage_withheld_current
attributes.description: Retainage amount withheld from the current period's earned value. Corresponds to Column J on AIA G703. Calculated as the applicable retainage percentage applied to current period work completed.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet; State Prompt Payment Acts

attributes.name: retainage_withheld_previous
attributes.description: Cumulative retainage withheld from all prior draw requests. Corresponds to Column I on AIA G703. Retainage is a percentage of earned value held back by the owner as security for contract completion.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet; State Prompt Payment Acts

attributes.name: revised_contract_amount
attributes.description: Current contract sum including all approved change orders (original_contract_amount + approved_change_order_amount). Corresponds to 'Contract Sum to Date' on AIA G702. Represents the total authorized contract value at time of this draw.
attributes.references: AIA G702 Application and Certificate for Payment

attributes.name: scheduled_value
attributes.description: Total scheduled value of all work items in the Schedule of Values (AIA G703) for this contract as of this draw. Represents the total value of work to be performed under the contract.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet; Schedule of Values

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contractor formally submitted this draw request / pay application to the owner or construction manager for review and approval.
attributes.references: AIA G702; Construction Loan Administration Best Practices

attributes.name: title_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the title company completed its review and issued clearance (or noted exceptions) for this draw request.
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Standards

attributes.name: title_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the title company's review of lien waivers and title endorsement for this draw. Title company clearance confirms no mechanic's liens have been filed and is typically required by the lender before disbursement.
attributes.references: ALTA Title Insurance Standards; Construction Loan Administration

attributes.name: total_earned_less_retainage
attributes.description: Net amount earned to date after deducting total retainage withheld (total_earned_to_date minus total_retainage_withheld). Corresponds to Column L on AIA G703. Represents the contractor's net certified entitlement.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet

attributes.name: total_earned_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative total amount earned to date including work completed in all prior periods, work completed in the current period, and materials presently stored (work_completed_previous + work_completed_current + materials_stored). Corresponds to Column G on AIA G703.
attributes.references: AIA G703 Continuation Sheet

attributes.name: total_retainage_withheld
attributes.description: Total cumulative retainage withheld to date across all draw requests including current period (retainage_withheld_previous + retainage_withheld_current). Corresponds to Column K on AIA G703.

products.description: Master registry of real estate investment funds, REITs, and pooled investment vehicles. Captures fund name, type (open-end, closed-end, REIT, partnership, CMBS/RMBS trust), domicile jurisdiction, base currency, target and actual AUM, inception date, fund status, investment strategy (core, core-plus, value-add, opportunistic), target return metrics (IRR, equity multiple), fee terms (management fee rate, carried interest, preferred return hurdle, fee basis, fee cap, fee waiver conditions), fund term and extension options, GP entity, regulatory classification, ESG mandate, and investment mandate parameters (target property types, geographies, leverage range, deal size range, concentration limits). SSOT for fund identity, strategy, terms, fee structures, and mandate parameters.
products.reference: REIT / Real Estate Fund — NCREIF, INREV, SEC Form N-2

attributes.name: actual_aum
attributes.description: Current total Assets Under Management (AUM) representing the fair market value of all assets held by the fund, expressed in the fund's base currency. Sourced from MRI Software and Argus Enterprise valuations. Updated at each reporting period.
attributes.references: SEC Form ADV Part 1A; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the independent external auditor engaged to audit the fund's annual financial statements. Required for SEC-registered funds and institutional LP due diligence.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X; PCAOB Auditing Standards

attributes.name: called_capital
attributes.description: Cumulative capital drawn down from LP commitments to fund investments, fees, and expenses, expressed in the fund's base currency. Used in DPI (Distributions to Paid-In) and TVPI (Total Value to Paid-In) multiple calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; ILPA Reporting Standards; NCREIF PREA

attributes.name: carried_interest_rate
attributes.description: GP's share of profits above the preferred return hurdle, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2000 = 20%). Represents the performance-based compensation to the General Partner. Sourced from LPA terms in DocuSign CLM.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; LPA Standard Terms; IRS Revenue Ruling 93-27 (carried interest taxation)

attributes.name: concentration_limit
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of total fund GAV that may be invested in any single asset or property, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.20 = 20%). Enforces diversification requirements per the LPA investment mandate.
attributes.references: LPA Investment Guidelines; SEC Investment Company Act of 1940; NCREIF PREA

attributes.name: distributed_capital
attributes.description: Cumulative capital returned to Limited Partners (LPs) through asset dispositions, refinancing proceeds, and income distributions, expressed in the fund's base currency. Key input for DPI multiple and IRR calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; ILPA Reporting Standards; NCREIF PREA

attributes.name: esg_framework
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Reporting Framework
attributes.description: Primary ESG reporting framework adopted by the fund (e.g., GRESB for real estate, UN PRI, TCFD). Null if esg_mandate is false. Drives sustainability data collection and disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: GRESB Real Estate Assessment; UN Principles for Responsible Investment (PRI); TCFD Recommendations; SFDR

attributes.name: esg_mandate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund operates under a formal Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) investment mandate requiring ESG screening, LEED/BREEAM certification targets, or sustainability reporting obligations.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) LEED; BREEAM; SEC ESG Disclosure Rules; SFDR (EU Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation)

attributes.name: extension_options
attributes.description: Number of permissible one-year extension options available to the General Partner (GP) beyond the base fund term, as specified in the LPA. Supports fund lifecycle planning and investor communication.
attributes.references: LPA Standard Terms; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: fee_basis
attributes.description: The capital base upon which the annual management fee rate is applied. Committed capital is common during the investment period; invested capital or NAV is common during the harvest period.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; LPA Standard Terms; ILPA Fee Transparency Template

attributes.name: fee_cap
attributes.description: Maximum absolute dollar amount of management fees that may be charged to the fund in any given year, expressed in the fund's base currency. Null if no cap is specified in the LPA.
attributes.references: LPA Standard Terms; ILPA Fee Transparency Template

attributes.name: fee_waiver_conditions
attributes.description: Narrative description of conditions under which management fees may be waived or reduced (e.g., GP co-investment, fund underperformance, LP negotiated side letter terms). Sourced from LPA and side letter agreements in DocuSign CLM.
attributes.references: LPA Standard Terms; SEC Form ADV Part 2A; ILPA Fee Transparency Template

attributes.name: final_close_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fund completed its capital raising period and accepted its last investor commitment. Marks the end of the fundraising phase and the start of the investment period. Null for open-end funds.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act of 1940; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the fund across systems (e.g., MRI Software, Argus Enterprise, SAP S/4HANA). Used as the business key in cross-system reconciliation and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); SEC EDGAR Fund Identifier

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the investment fund or vehicle as registered with the relevant regulatory authority (e.g., SEC, FINRA). Used in investor communications, regulatory filings, and reporting.
attributes.references: SEC Form ADV; FASB ASC 946 Financial Services — Investment Companies

attributes.name: fund_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fund. Drives operational workflows, investor reporting obligations, and capital call eligibility. Fundraising indicates the fund is accepting commitments; fully_invested indicates deployment is complete; harvesting indicates asset disposition phase.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; Urban Land Institute (ULI) Fund Lifecycle Framework

attributes.name: fund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investment vehicle structure. Determines regulatory treatment, investor redemption rights, and accounting framework. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open_end|closed_end|reit|partnership|cmbs_trust|rmbs_trust|separate_account|co_investment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Investment Company Act of 1940; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: gav
attributes.description: Gross Asset Value (GAV) of the fund representing the total fair market value of all real estate assets before deducting fund-level debt and liabilities, expressed in the fund's base currency. Used in leverage ratio and LTV calculations.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: gp_entity_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the General Partner entity responsible for managing the fund, making investment decisions, and fulfilling fiduciary obligations to Limited Partners (LPs). Sourced from MRI Software Investment Management module.
attributes.references: SEC Form ADV; Investment Advisers Act of 1940; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fund was legally formed and commenced operations. Used as the start date for IRR, equity multiple, and since-inception performance calculations in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form N-2; IFRS 16

attributes.name: investment_period_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fund's investment period expires and the GP is no longer permitted to make new investments or call capital for new acquisitions. After this date, capital calls are limited to follow-on investments and fund expenses.
attributes.references: LPA Standard Terms; FASB ASC 946; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: investment_strategy
attributes.description: Risk-return strategy classification of the fund per industry convention. Core strategies target stabilized assets with lower risk; opportunistic strategies target higher-risk, higher-return repositioning or development. Drives benchmark selection and performance attribution in Argus Enterprise and MRI Software.
attributes.references: National Council of Real Estate Investment Fiduciaries (NCREIF); Urban Land Institute (ULI) Strategy Classification

attributes.name: management_fee_rate
attributes.description: Annual management fee charged by the GP to the fund, expressed as a decimal of the fee basis (e.g., 0.0150 = 1.50% of committed capital). Sourced from LPA terms and tracked in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; LPA Standard Terms; SEC Form ADV Part 2A

attributes.name: max_deal_size
attributes.description: Maximum individual asset or transaction size (in base currency) that the fund is mandated to consider for investment. Prevents over-concentration in a single asset and ensures portfolio diversification per LPA guidelines.
attributes.references: LPA Investment Guidelines; ULI Investment Mandate Standards

attributes.name: min_deal_size
attributes.description: Minimum individual asset or transaction size (in base currency) that the fund is mandated to consider for investment. Ensures portfolio concentration and operational efficiency thresholds are maintained.
attributes.references: LPA Investment Guidelines; ULI Investment Mandate Standards

attributes.name: nav
attributes.description: Net Asset Value (NAV) of the fund as of the most recent valuation date, calculated as total assets minus total liabilities, expressed in the fund's base currency. Primary metric for open-end fund unit pricing and investor redemption calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; IVSC Valuation Standards; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: preferred_return_hurdle
attributes.description: Minimum annualized return rate (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.0800 = 8.00%) that must be distributed to Limited Partners (LPs) before the General Partner (GP) is entitled to receive carried interest. Also known as the hurdle rate or preferred return.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; LPA Standard Terms; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the fund produces and distributes financial and performance reports to Limited Partners (LPs). Drives reporting calendar in MRI Software and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Form N-CEN; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: target_aum
attributes.description: Target total Assets Under Management (AUM) the fund intends to reach at full deployment, expressed in the fund's base currency. Used in fundraising materials, investor presentations, and portfolio planning in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: SEC Form ADV Part 1A; NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: target_equity_multiple
attributes.description: Target equity multiple (TVPI — Total Value to Paid-In) the fund aims to return to investors, expressed as a ratio (e.g., 1.80 = 1.8x). Represents total distributions plus residual NAV divided by total called capital.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; NCREIF PREA; CFA Institute GIPS Standards

attributes.name: target_irr
attributes.description: Target net Internal Rate of Return (IRR) expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1200 = 12.00%) that the fund aims to deliver to investors over its life. Used in fund marketing materials, LP reporting, and performance benchmarking in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: CFA Institute GIPS Standards; NCREIF PREA; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: target_leverage_max
attributes.description: Maximum Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio permitted under the fund's investment mandate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.65 = 65%). Defines the upper bound of the fund's leverage range. Exceeding this threshold may trigger LP notification requirements.
attributes.references: LPA Investment Guidelines; NCREIF PREA; Basel III

attributes.name: target_leverage_min
attributes.description: Minimum Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio permitted under the fund's investment mandate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.40 = 40%). Defines the lower bound of the fund's leverage range for portfolio construction and risk management.
attributes.references: LPA Investment Guidelines; NCREIF PREA; Basel III (applicable to fund-level credit facilities)

attributes.name: term_years
attributes.description: Contractual life of the fund in years from inception to scheduled termination, as defined in the Limited Partnership Agreement (LPA) or fund prospectus. Null for open-end funds with no fixed term.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form N-2; LPA Standard Terms

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date on which the fund is dissolved and all assets are liquidated and distributed to investors. Null for open-end or perpetual-life funds. Drives WALT and WALE calculations for portfolio wind-down planning.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form N-14; ULI Fund Lifecycle Framework

attributes.name: total_commitments
attributes.description: Aggregate capital committed by all Limited Partners (LPs) to the fund as of the final close, expressed in the fund's base currency. Represents the maximum capital available for investment and fee calculation basis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form D; LPA Standard Terms

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal appraisal or valuation of the fund's portfolio used to calculate NAV and GAV. Typically quarterly for institutional funds. Sourced from Argus Enterprise valuation models.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Appraisal Institute USPAP; FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement

products.name: portfolio
products.description: Master record for an investment portfolio — a named collection of real estate assets managed under a unified strategy. Captures portfolio name, portfolio type (core, diversified, sector-specific), associated fund, asset manager (AM), benchmark index, target GAV, target NAV, target NOI, geographic focus, property type focus, WALT target, WALE target, portfolio inception date, reporting currency, consolidation entity, and portfolio status. Serves as the SSOT for portfolio-level identity and strategy. Sourced from MRI Software and Argus Enterprise.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.building_class. Business justification: Portfolio investment mandates define target building class for asset selection, benchmark peer group assignment, and investor reporting. Used in portfolio strategy documents and concentration limit co
