attributes.name: benchmark_index
attributes.description: The market index or peer benchmark against which portfolio performance (IRR, TWR, total return) is measured (e.g., NCREIF NPI, MSCI Real Estate Index, FTSE NAREIT All Equity REITs Index).
attributes.references: NCREIF; MSCI Real Estate; FTSE NAREIT; GIPS Performance Standards

attributes.name: called_capital
attributes.description: Total equity capital drawn down (called) from investors and deployed into portfolio assets as of the most recent reporting date. Used to calculate remaining uncalled capital and deployment pace.
attributes.references: ILPA Capital Call Standards; SEC Investment Advisers Act; MRI Software

attributes.name: carried_interest_rate
attributes.description: General partner's carried interest (promote) rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.20 = 20%) representing the share of profits above the preferred return. Core economic term in fund waterfall and partnership agreements.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Advisers Act; ILPA Principles; IRS Carried Interest Rules; MRI Software

attributes.name: committed_capital
attributes.description: Total equity capital formally committed by investors to the portfolio as of the most recent reporting date. Distinct from called/deployed capital. Tracks fundraising progress against target fund size.
attributes.references: SEC Form D; ILPA Capital Call Standards; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the portfolio master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management per SOX and GDPR requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: distribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which income distributions (dividends, preferred returns) are made to investors from portfolio cash flows. Governs investor cash flow expectations and treasury planning.
attributes.references: SEC REIT Distribution Requirements; INREV Distribution Guidelines; MRI Software

attributes.name: ffo_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this portfolio reports Funds From Operations (FFO) and Adjusted Funds From Operations (AFFO) per NAREIT standards. Applicable primarily to REIT-structured portfolios for SEC and investor reporting.
attributes.references: NAREIT FFO White Paper; SEC REIT Reporting; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the portfolio was established and began accepting capital commitments or acquiring assets. Used as the baseline for IRR, TWR, and performance period calculations.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; GIPS (Global Investment Performance Standards); CFA Institute

attributes.name: leverage_policy
attributes.description: Portfolio-level leverage policy classification governing the use of debt financing. Unleveraged = no debt; Low = LTV <30%; Moderate = LTV 30-60%; High = LTV >60%. Aligns with investment strategy and risk mandate.
attributes.references: CMBS Underwriting Standards; SEC Investment Advisers Act; MRI Software

attributes.name: management_fee_rate
attributes.description: Annual asset management fee rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0100 = 1.00% of AUM or GAV) charged by the investment manager. Disclosed in fund offering documents and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Advisers Act; INREV Fee Guidelines; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: open_end_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the portfolio is structured as an open-end fund allowing ongoing investor subscriptions and redemptions (True) versus a closed-end fund with a fixed capital raise and defined term (False).
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act; INREV Fund Structures; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: portfolio_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the portfolio used in investor reporting, Argus Enterprise, MRI Software, and regulatory filings. Unique across all portfolios.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting; RESO Data Standards

attributes.name: portfolio_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the investment portfolio as used in investor communications, fund documents, and management reporting (e.g., 'Core Office Fund III', 'Diversified Income REIT Portfolio').
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: portfolio_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the portfolio. Active = fully operational; Inactive = temporarily not deploying capital; Winding Down = in liquidation/disposition phase; Closed = fully liquidated; Pending Launch = pre-inception setup; Suspended = operations halted pending review.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; SEC Fund Lifecycle Reporting

attributes.name: portfolio_type
attributes.description: Investment strategy classification of the portfolio reflecting risk-return profile. Core = stabilized low-risk assets; Core Plus = modest value enhancement; Value Add = repositioning required; Opportunistic = highest risk/return; Diversified = multi-sector; Sector Specific = single property type focus; Debt = mortgage/CMBS/RMBS instruments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: core|core_plus|value_add|opportunistic|diversified|sector_specific|debt — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCREIF ODCE Classification; ULI Investment Strategy Framework; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: preferred_return_rate
attributes.description: Annualized preferred return rate (hurdle rate) expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0800 = 8.00%) that must be paid to limited partners before the general partner participates in carried interest. Core term in fund waterfall structures.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Advisers Act; ILPA Private Equity Principles; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this portfolio record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary sources are MRI Software and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: sox_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this portfolio is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) internal control requirements, applicable to publicly traded REITs and entities with SEC reporting obligations.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404; SEC Reporting Requirements; SAP S/4HANA Financial Controls

attributes.name: target_aum
attributes.description: Target total Assets Under Management (AUM) for the portfolio representing the aggregate market value of all real estate assets managed on behalf of investors. Used for fee calculation and capacity planning.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Advisers Act; INREV AUM Guidelines; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: target_cap_rate
attributes.description: Target portfolio-level Capitalization Rate (CAP Rate) expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0550 = 5.50%) representing the expected NOI yield on asset value. Used for acquisition underwriting and portfolio valuation benchmarking.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: target_equity_multiple
attributes.description: Target equity multiple (EM) representing the total expected return of invested capital as a ratio (e.g., 1.80x means $1.80 returned per $1.00 invested). Complements IRR as a return metric in investor presentations.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; GIPS Performance Standards; ULI Investment Metrics

attributes.name: target_fund_size
attributes.description: Total target equity capital raise for the portfolio/fund expressed in the reporting currency. Represents the maximum committed capital the fund intends to raise from investors. Used for capital deployment planning.
attributes.references: SEC Form D; INREV Fund Reporting; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: target_gav
attributes.description: Target Gross Asset Value (GAV) representing the total undiscounted market value of all assets in the portfolio at full deployment, before deducting liabilities. Used for capital raising targets and AUM reporting.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise; INREV NAV Guidelines

attributes.name: target_irr
attributes.description: Target annualized Internal Rate of Return (IRR) expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0850 = 8.50%) representing the expected return on invested equity over the portfolio's life. Primary performance hurdle for investor commitments.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; GIPS Performance Standards; CFA Institute IRR Methodology

attributes.name: target_ltv
attributes.description: Target portfolio-level Loan-to-Value Ratio (LTV) expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.60 = 60%) representing the maximum leverage policy for the portfolio. Governs debt capacity and risk management guidelines.
attributes.references: CMBS Underwriting Standards; DSCR Guidelines; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: target_nav
attributes.description: Target Net Asset Value (NAV) representing the portfolio's equity value after deducting all liabilities from GAV. Key metric for open-end fund unit pricing, investor redemptions, and performance reporting.
attributes.references: INREV NAV Guidelines; FASB ASC 946; Argus Enterprise; SEC Form N-2

attributes.name: target_noi
attributes.description: Target annual Net Operating Income (NOI) for the portfolio representing total revenue less operating expenses before debt service and capital expenditures. Core income metric for CAP rate valuation and DSCR analysis.
attributes.references: NCREIF NOI Definition; Argus Enterprise; Yardi Voyager NOI Reporting

attributes.name: target_occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Target portfolio-level physical occupancy rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.95 = 95%) representing the proportion of Net Leasable Area (NLA) that is leased and occupied. Core operational KPI for income forecasting.
attributes.references: NCREIF Occupancy Standards; Yardi Voyager; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: target_wale
attributes.description: Target Weighted Average Lease Expiry (WALE) in years representing the income-weighted average time until lease expiry across all portfolio assets. Distinct from WALT as it measures time to expiry rather than total term.
attributes.references: RESO Lease Standards; Argus Enterprise; INREV Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: target_walt
attributes.description: Target Weighted Average Lease Term (WALT) in years representing the income-weighted average remaining lease duration across all portfolio assets. Key metric for income stability and refinancing risk assessment.
attributes.references: RESO Lease Standards; Argus Enterprise; MRI Software Lease Management

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual date on which the portfolio is fully wound down and closed. Null for open-ended portfolios. Used for fund lifecycle management and investor distribution planning.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; SEC Fund Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the portfolio master record. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and audit compliance for investment management records.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; MRI Software Audit Trail

attributes.name: valuation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which independent or internal valuations are conducted for portfolio assets to update NAV and GAV. Quarterly is standard for institutional funds; monthly for open-end funds with frequent redemptions.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; INREV Valuation Guidelines; Argus Enterprise; SEC

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: Primary valuation methodology applied to assets within this portfolio for NAV and GAV calculations. DCF = Discounted Cash Flow; Direct Capitalization = NOI/CAP Rate; Sales Comparison = comparable transactions; Cost Approach = replacement cost; NAV Based = for fund-of-funds.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Appraisal Institute USPAP; Argus Enterprise; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Legal and structural form of the investment vehicle housing this portfolio. Determines regulatory reporting obligations (SEC for REITs), tax treatment, and investor eligibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reit|open_end_fund|closed_end_fund|separate_account|partnership|joint_venture|cmbs|rmbs — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEC REIT Reporting; FASB ASC 946; IRS REIT Qualification Rules

products.name: investor
products.description: SSOT for institutional and individual investor identities participating in real estate funds and portfolios. Captures investor legal name, investor type (institutional, HNWI, family office, pension fund, sovereign wealth fund, endowment, retail), KYC/AML status, accreditation status, domicile country, tax identification, preferred currency, investor tier, relationship manager, onboarding date, and investor status. Distinct from the owner domain (which tracks property ownership) — this entity tracks capital contributors to investment vehicles.
products.reference: Limited Partner / Investor — ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Institutional investors (pension funds, fund-of-funds, family offices) invest through a legal entity. Linking investor to their legal entity supports KYC/AML compliance, ERISA tracking, tax reporting,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: market_segment_id

attributes.name: preferred_currency_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency_code. Business justification: Investor preferred currency drives distribution payment processing, capital account statement generation, and FX conversion for multi-currency fund distributions. Role-prefixed to distinguish from oth

attributes.name: target_property_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.property_type. Business justification: Investor mandate specifies target property type for deal matching, co-investment eligibility screening, and fund-investor mandate alignment reporting used in investor relations and capital raising.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accreditation_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investor's accreditation verification expires. Accreditation must be re-verified periodically to maintain eligibility for private placement investments under SEC Regulation D. Drives compliance monitoring and investor eligibility gating.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rule 501; Investment Company Act of 1940

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Regulatory accreditation classification of the investor under SEC Regulation D. Accredited investors meet income or net worth thresholds permitting participation in private placements. Qualified purchaser status permits investment in 3(c)(7) funds. Critical for fund eligibility gating and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D Rule 501; Investment Company Act of 1940 Section 3(c)(7)

attributes.name: aml_status
attributes.description: Current Anti-Money Laundering (AML) screening status for the investor. Cleared indicates the investor has passed sanctions screening and adverse media checks. Flagged indicates a potential match requiring enhanced due diligence. Mandatory for regulatory compliance under FinCEN and FATF guidelines.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; FATF Recommendations; Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: co_investment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor is eligible to participate in co-investment opportunities alongside the fund. Co-investment rights are typically granted to anchor investors and platinum-tier relationships. True enables the investor to receive co-investment deal flow notifications and participate in direct deal allocations.
attributes.references: Investment Advisers Act of 1940; Internal Investment Advisory Policy

attributes.name: committed_capital_amount
attributes.description: Total capital amount formally committed by the investor to real estate funds or investment vehicles, expressed in the investor's preferred currency. Represents the contractual obligation to fund capital calls up to this amount. Core metric for AUM (Assets Under Management) calculation and fund capacity management in MRI Software and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Regulation D; MRI Software Investor Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the investor record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Represents the audit trail creation event. Used for data lineage, compliance audit trails, and SOX financial controls reporting.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 8601

attributes.name: crs_classification
attributes.description: OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS) entity classification for automatic exchange of financial account information between tax authorities. Reportable Person indicates the investor's account information must be reported to their country of tax residency. Drives annual CRS reporting obligations.
attributes.references: OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS); GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: distribution_bank_account_ref
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized reference to the investor's designated bank account for distribution wire transfers and capital return payments. Full account details are stored in the secure payment vault; this field holds only the reference token. Used by Yardi Voyager AP module for distribution processing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; GDPR Article 9; Yardi Voyager AP Module

attributes.name: distribution_preference
attributes.description: Investor's preferred frequency and method for receiving investment distributions (income and return of capital). Quarterly is most common for real estate funds. Reinvest indicates the investor elects to reinvest distributions into additional fund units. Drives distribution waterfall processing in MRI Software and Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investor Module; Yardi Voyager; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: esg_mandate_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Mandate Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor has a formal ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) investment mandate requiring portfolio companies and assets to meet defined sustainability criteria. True triggers ESG screening in deal sourcing and LEED/BREEAM certification requirements in asset selection.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) LEED; BREEAM; SEC ESG Disclosure Rules; ULI ESG Framework

attributes.name: fatca_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) Classification
attributes.description: FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act) entity classification for the investor. Determines US withholding tax obligations and IRS reporting requirements. US Person classification triggers Form W-9 requirements. Foreign Financial Institution (FFI) classification requires GIIN registration. NFFE (Non-Financial Foreign Entity) requires beneficial ownership disclosure.
attributes.references: FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474); IRS Form W-8BEN-E; IRS Form W-9

attributes.name: investment_horizon_years
attributes.description: Investor's preferred investment hold period expressed in years. Drives fund structure matching (open-end vs. closed-end funds), asset disposition timing, and WALT (Weighted Average Lease Term) alignment in portfolio construction. Typical real estate investment horizons range from 3 to 10+ years.
attributes.references: NCREIF; ULI Investment Strategy Framework; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: investor_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier assigned to the investor upon onboarding. Used across MRI Software, Yardi Voyager, and Argus Enterprise to reference the investor in capital accounts, distribution statements, and fund reporting.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); MRI Software Investor Module

attributes.name: investor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the investor record. Active indicates the investor is in good standing with capital deployed. Pending indicates onboarding in progress. Suspended indicates a hold due to KYC/AML review. Redeemed indicates full capital withdrawal. Closed indicates the investor relationship has been formally terminated.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; FINRA KYC Rules; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: investor_tier
attributes.description: Relationship tier classification assigned to the investor based on committed capital, strategic importance, and relationship depth. Drives fee schedule application, co-investment priority access, reporting frequency, and relationship manager assignment. Platinum typically denotes anchor investors with largest AUM commitments.
attributes.references: Internal Investment Advisory Policy; ULI Best Practices

attributes.name: investor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investor by entity category. Drives regulatory treatment, reporting obligations, and fee structures. Institutional includes insurance companies, banks, and asset managers. HNWI (High Net Worth Individual) denotes qualifying individuals. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: institutional|hnwi|family_office|pension_fund|sovereign_wealth_fund|endowment|retail|reit|fund_of_funds — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; Investment Advisers Act of 1940; FINRA Rule 4512

attributes.name: kyc_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current Know Your Customer (KYC) documentation expires and renewal is required. Triggers automated alerts for re-verification workflows. Investors with expired KYC may be restricted from participating in new capital calls or fund subscriptions.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Know Your Customer (KYC) due diligence process for the investor. Approved indicates all identity verification and background checks have been completed satisfactorily. Expired indicates KYC documentation has lapsed and requires renewal. Drives onboarding gates and capital call eligibility.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; FATF Recommendations; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the investor as registered with regulatory authorities. For institutional investors, this is the registered entity name; for individuals, the full legal name as on government-issued identification. Used for KYC/AML compliance, subscription agreements, and capital account statements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SEC Regulation D; FINRA KYC Rules

attributes.name: minimum_investment_amount
attributes.description: Minimum capital amount the investor is willing to deploy per investment vehicle or fund subscription. Used during fund structuring and deal allocation to ensure investment sizing meets investor thresholds. Expressed in the investor's preferred currency.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; Investment Advisers Act of 1940; MRI Software

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investor completed the onboarding process and was formally admitted as an investor in the platform. Marks the start of the investor relationship lifecycle. Used for WALT (Weighted Average Lease Term) equivalent calculations in investor tenure analytics and anniversary-based reporting.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; MRI Software Investor Module

attributes.name: pep_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor or any beneficial owner is classified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) under AML regulations. PEP status requires enhanced due diligence (EDD) and senior management approval for onboarding. True indicates PEP status confirmed; False indicates no PEP association identified.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; FinCEN AML Program Requirements; Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for investor communications including capital call notices, distribution notices, quarterly reports, and K-1 tax documents. Must be a valid, monitored email address per investor subscription agreement requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SEC Regulation D; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the investor organization. For individual investors, this is the investor themselves. For institutional investors, this is the designated relationship contact (e.g., portfolio manager, treasurer, or investment officer) responsible for fund communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the investor's designated contact. Used for urgent communications, capital call confirmations, and relationship management outreach. Stored in E.164 international format.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: registered_address_city
attributes.description: City of the investor's registered legal address. Used in conjunction with registered address fields for KYC verification, regulatory correspondence, and tax document delivery.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FinCEN AML Requirements

attributes.name: registered_address_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the investor's registered legal address country. Used for regulatory jurisdiction determination, sanctions screening, and tax treaty application.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 4; FinCEN AML Requirements

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the investor's registered legal address. Used for regulatory correspondence, K-1 mailing, subscription agreement execution, and AML/KYC address verification. For institutional investors, this is the registered office address.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; IRS Publication 515; FinCEN AML Requirements

attributes.name: sanctions_screened_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor has been screened against applicable sanctions lists including OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, and UN Security Council Sanctions List. True indicates screening has been completed. Must be True before capital can be accepted from the investor.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; FinCEN AML Requirements

attributes.name: side_letter_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor has a side letter agreement with the fund manager granting special terms, rights, or concessions beyond the standard limited partnership agreement (LPA). Side letters may include MFN (Most Favored Nation) clauses, reduced management fees, enhanced reporting rights, or co-investment priority. True triggers side letter terms application in fee and distribution calculations.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation D; Investment Advisers Act of 1940; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: source_of_funds
attributes.description: Declared source of the investor's capital being deployed into real estate investments. Required for AML compliance to verify the legitimacy of invested capital. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: operating_income|asset_sale|inheritance|pension_fund|endowment_corpus|debt_financing|equity_raise|insurance_reserves|sovereign_allocation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; FATF Recommendations; Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: target_equity_multiple
attributes.description: Investor's target equity multiple (total distributions divided by total invested capital) for real estate investments. A multiple of 2.0x means the investor expects to receive twice their invested capital over the investment hold period. Used in Argus Enterprise for investment screening and portfolio performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise; NCREIF

attributes.name: target_irr_max
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Internal Rate of Return (IRR) Maximum
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable Internal Rate of Return (IRR) threshold expressed as a decimal percentage. Defines the upper bound of the investor's risk-return appetite. Investors with low IRR maximums typically prefer core or core-plus strategies. Used alongside target_irr_min to define the investor's return corridor in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise; CFA Institute Standards

attributes.name: target_irr_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Internal Rate of Return (IRR) Minimum
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable Internal Rate of Return (IRR) threshold expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.0800 = 8.00%). Represents the investor's stated return hurdle below which investment opportunities are not considered. Used in Argus Enterprise for deal screening and portfolio matching against investor mandates.
attributes.references: IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise; CFA Institute Standards

attributes.name: tax_id_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax identification number provided. EIN (Employer Identification Number) for US entities, SSN (Social Security Number) for US individuals, ITIN (Individual Taxpayer Identification Number) for non-resident individuals, Foreign TIN for non-US entities, GIIN (Global Intermediary Identification Number) for FATCA-registered entities.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 515; FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474)

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the investor. For US entities, this is the EIN (Employer Identification Number) or SSN (Social Security Number). For non-US entities, the equivalent national tax registration number. Used for IRS Form K-1 issuance, FATCA reporting, and withholding tax calculations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 515; FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474); GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: tax_residency_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the investor's country of tax residency, which may differ from domicile country. Used for CRS (Common Reporting Standard) automatic exchange of information and applicable withholding tax treaty determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS); FATCA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the investor record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline, audit trail maintenance, and detecting stale KYC/AML data.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 8601

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The gross total capital amount the investor has committed to the fund or investment vehicle, expressed in the commitment currency. Represents the investor's maximum obligation under the subscription agreement. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; IVSC Valuation Standards

attributes.name: aum_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The portion of this commitment that contributes to the fund's reported Assets Under Management (AUM) figure, which may differ from the total commitment amount based on fund accounting policies and deployment stage.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; Argus Enterprise; SEC Form ADV; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: called_capital_amount
attributes.description: Total capital that has been called (drawn down) from the investor to date across all capital calls against this commitment. Represents cumulative funded capital. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; ILPA Capital Call Standards

attributes.name: capital_call_schedule_type
attributes.description: The methodology governing how and when capital calls are issued against this commitment. Determines cash flow planning for both the fund manager and the investor.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Standards

attributes.name: carried_interest_rate
attributes.description: The carried interest (promote) percentage applicable to this commitment, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2000 for 20%). Represents the fund manager's share of profits above the preferred return.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Fee Transparency Standards; SEC Form ADV

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: The fund closing date at which this commitment was accepted. Funds may have multiple closes (first close, second close, final close); this identifies which close the investor participated in.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Fund Reporting Standards

attributes.name: co_investment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commitment is a co-investment alongside the main fund vehicle (True) or a standard fund commitment (False). Co-investments typically carry different fee structures and governance rights.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Co-Investment Guidelines

attributes.name: commitment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the investor formally committed capital to the fund, typically the date the subscription agreement or LOI was executed. Serves as the principal business event date (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category).
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: commitment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the commitment, used in investor correspondence, subscription documents, and capital call notices. Sourced from MRI Software Investment Management.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946 Investment Companies

attributes.name: commitment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the capital commitment from LOI through full deployment. Tracks progression: pending (LOI received), executed (subscription agreement signed), funded (capital fully called and received), defaulted (investor failed to meet capital call), cancelled (commitment withdrawn), transferred (commitment assigned to another investor). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|executed|funded|defaulted|cancelled|transferred — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; SEC Regulation D; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this capital commitment record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for data lineage and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: default_date
attributes.description: The date on which the investor defaulted on a capital call obligation. Populated only when commitment_status is 'defaulted'. Triggers default remedies per the limited partnership agreement.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; SEC Regulation D

attributes.name: distributed_capital_amount
attributes.description: Total capital returned to the investor through distributions (return of capital, realized gains, income distributions) against this commitment to date. Used in DPI (Distributions to Paid-In) calculations.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: erisa_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor's assets are subject to ERISA (Employee Retirement Income Security Act) regulations. ERISA investors trigger plan asset rules and fiduciary obligations for the fund manager.
attributes.references: ERISA; U.S. Department of Labor; MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: first_call_date
attributes.description: The date of the first capital call issued against this commitment. Marks the beginning of the capital deployment phase and triggers the investment period clock.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Capital Call Standards

attributes.name: fund_term_end_date
attributes.description: The scheduled termination date of the fund, representing the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for the commitment's binding period. After this date, the fund is expected to be wound down and all capital returned.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; FASB ASC 946; SEC Form ADV

attributes.name: investment_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fund's investment period expires, after which no new capital calls may be issued for new investments (only follow-on investments and fund expenses). Critical for uncalled capital management.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Fund Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: loi_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Letter of Intent (LOI) that preceded the formal subscription agreement. Tracks the initial non-binding expression of interest in the commitment lifecycle.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; NAR Transaction Standards

attributes.name: management_fee_basis
attributes.description: The basis on which the management fee is calculated for this commitment — committed capital (during investment period), invested capital (post-investment period), NAV (Net Asset Value), or GAV (Gross Asset Value).
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Fee Transparency Standards

attributes.name: management_fee_rate
attributes.description: The annual management fee rate applicable to this commitment, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0150 for 1.5%). Typically charged on committed or invested capital depending on fund terms.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Fee Transparency Standards; SEC Form ADV

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special conditions, or investor-specific terms associated with this commitment that are not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: preferred_return_rate
attributes.description: The annual preferred return (hurdle rate) percentage applicable to this commitment, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0800 for 8%). The fund manager earns carried interest only after this return threshold is met for the investor.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Fee Transparency Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: recallable_distributions_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative amount of distributions made to the investor that are subject to recall (clawback) for future capital calls, per the fund's limited partnership agreement. Affects the effective uncalled capital balance.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: side_letter_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commitment is accompanied by a side letter granting the investor special rights, terms, or concessions beyond the standard limited partnership agreement (e.g., MFN rights, fee discounts, reporting preferences).
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Side Letter Principles

attributes.name: side_letter_reference
attributes.description: Document reference identifier for the executed side letter associated with this commitment. Populated only when side_letter_flag is True. Links to DocuSign CLM for document retrieval.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; MRI Software Investment Management; ILPA Side Letter Principles

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by MRI Software Investment Management for this commitment record. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail back to the system of record.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management

attributes.name: subscription_agreement_ref

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total all-in cost to acquire the property asset, including purchase price, transaction costs, due diligence fees, and closing costs. Represents the initial cost basis for book value tracking, depreciation, and gain/loss calculations. Denominated in the portfolio's functional currency.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the property asset was acquired and added to the investment portfolio. Used as the holding period start date for IRR calculations, depreciation schedules, and capital gains tax computations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 805 Business Combinations; IFRS 3; Yardi Voyager — Fixed Assets

attributes.name: acquisition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing key details about the acquisition rationale, deal structure, special conditions, or investment thesis for this asset. Used by asset managers and investment committees for context and historical reference.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis

attributes.name: actual_exit_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the asset was disposed of or transferred out of the portfolio. Populated upon disposition completion. Used for realized IRR calculations, hold period reporting, and fund performance attribution.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; NCREIF Performance Reporting

attributes.name: allocated_debt
attributes.description: Total debt financing allocated to this asset holding, including mortgage debt, mezzanine financing, and any other encumbrances. Used for LTV ratio monitoring, DSCR calculations, and portfolio leverage reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; CMBS/RMBS reporting standards

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the asset within the portfolio. Drives workflow routing for asset reviews, disposition approvals, and reporting inclusion. 'active' = currently held and performing; 'under_review' = strategic review in progress; 'disposition_pending' = approved for sale; 'disposed' = sold/transferred out; 'on_hold' = temporarily suspended from active management.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Argus Enterprise — Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: capex_budget
attributes.description: Total approved Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) budget allocated to this asset for the current hold period, including planned improvements, repositioning costs, and major capital repairs. Used for value-add strategy tracking and return-on-investment analysis.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; Yardi Voyager — Budgeting and Forecasting; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: capex_spent_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) actually spent on this asset from acquisition date through the most recent reporting period. Compared against capex_budget to monitor capital deployment progress and cost control.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; Yardi Voyager — Fixed Assets; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this portfolio asset record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: current_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the asset on the portfolio's books after accumulated depreciation and any impairment charges. Used for balance sheet reporting, NAV calculations, and GAAP/IFRS financial statements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IFRS 16; MRI Software — Property Accounting; Yardi Voyager — Fixed Assets

attributes.name: disposition_price
attributes.description: Gross sale price received upon disposition of the asset from the portfolio. Populated when asset_status = 'disposed'. Used for realized gain/loss calculation, IRR computation, and fund performance reporting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; FASB ASC 360; NCREIF

attributes.name: equity_invested
attributes.description: Total equity capital deployed into this asset by the portfolio, net of debt financing. Used as the denominator in equity multiple and ROI calculations, and for tracking capital deployment against fund commitments.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; MRI Software — Investment Management; NCREIF

attributes.name: gla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Leasable Area (GLA) in Square Feet (SQF)
attributes.description: Total Gross Leasable Area (GLA) of the property asset measured in square feet (SQF). Used for PSF rent analysis, portfolio size reporting, and benchmarking against market comparables. Sourced from the property domain master record.
attributes.references: BOMA International Measurement Standards; RESO Data Dictionary; CoStar Suite

attributes.name: hold_strategy
attributes.description: Investment hold strategy assigned to this asset within the portfolio. Determines capital allocation priorities, return expectations, and exit planning. 'core_hold' = long-term stabilized income; 'value_add' = active repositioning for value creation; 'opportunistic' = higher-risk/return transformation; 'disposition_target' = approved for near-term sale; 'development' = ground-up or major redevelopment.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; Urban Land Institute (ULI); MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: in_place_noi
attributes.description: Current annualized Net Operating Income (NOI) generated by the asset based on in-place leases and operating expenses. Used for CAP rate derivation, DSCR monitoring, and portfolio income reporting. Sourced from Yardi Voyager NOI statements.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — General Ledger; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling; NCREIF

attributes.name: investment_risk_profile
attributes.description: Risk-return classification of this asset holding per institutional investment framework. Distinct from hold_strategy — this reflects the underwriting risk tier used for investor disclosure, fund mandate compliance, and performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: NCREIF; Urban Land Institute (ULI); SEC — REIT Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: is_encumbered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset is subject to debt financing, liens, or other encumbrances (True) or is unencumbered (False). Used for portfolio leverage analysis, lender reporting, and unencumbered asset pool tracking for REIT compliance.
attributes.references: SEC — REIT Disclosure; FASB ASC 470; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: is_joint_venture
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset is held through a joint venture or co-investment structure (True) or is wholly owned by the portfolio (False). Drives proportional consolidation logic and joint venture reporting requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 323 Equity Method; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements

attributes.name: occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Current physical occupancy rate of the property asset expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9200 = 92.00%). Key operational KPI for income stability assessment, lender covenant compliance, and portfolio performance dashboards.
attributes.references: NCREIF; CoStar Suite — Property Analytics; Yardi Voyager — Lease Administration

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Portfolio's percentage ownership interest in the property asset, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.7500 = 75.00%). Critical for proportional consolidation of NOI, GAV, debt, and equity in fund-level reporting. Supports joint venture and co-investment structures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; IFRS 10; SEC — REIT Reporting

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: Identifier or reference code from the originating operational system of record (e.g., Argus Enterprise asset ID, MRI Software property code, Yardi Voyager property ID). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager; MRI Software; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: stabilized_noi
attributes.description: Projected stabilized Net Operating Income (NOI) upon completion of the asset's business plan (lease-up, repositioning, or value-add program). Used in exit valuation modeling, IRR projections, and investment committee reporting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; Appraisal Institute USPAP

attributes.name: target_cap_rate
attributes.description: Underwritten target Capitalization Rate (CAP Rate) at acquisition, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0550 = 5.50%). Represents the expected NOI yield on the asset value used in the investment thesis and exit pricing assumptions.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; Appraisal Institute; NCREIF

attributes.name: target_equity_multiple
attributes.description: Underwritten target equity multiple (total distributions + residual value divided by equity invested) for this asset at acquisition. Expressed as a ratio (e.g., 1.8500 = 1.85x). Used alongside target_irr for investment committee approval and performance tracking.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; CFA Institute; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: target_exit_date
attributes.description: Planned or target date for disposition or exit of this asset from the portfolio. Used in hold period analysis, IRR projections, fund lifecycle planning, and WALT/WALE reporting. Nullable for open-ended core holds.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: target_irr
attributes.description: Underwritten target Internal Rate of Return (IRR) for this asset at the time of acquisition, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1200 = 12.00%). Represents the return threshold used in investment committee approval and ongoing performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; CFA Institute; NCREIF

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_loss
attributes.description: Difference between the current appraised value (adjusted for ownership percentage) and the current book value, representing the mark-to-market unrealized gain or loss on this holding. Positive = unrealized gain; negative = unrealized loss. Key input for NAV reporting and investor performance statements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 Fair Value Measurement; IFRS 13; Argus Enterprise — Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this portfolio asset record was most recently updated. Used for change detection, incremental data loads, and audit trail compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

products.name: fund_performance
products.description: Period-level investment performance and valuation record for a fund — the operational SSOT for how a fund performed and was valued in a given measurement period. Captures period dates, period type (quarterly, annual, trailing-12, since-inception), gross/net IRR, equity multiple (MOIC), NPV, DPI, RVPI, TVPI, TWR, MWR, benchmark return, alpha, GAV (sum of appraised values), NAV (GAV minus liabilities), NAV per unit/share, units outstanding, premium/discount to NAV, AUM, total revenue, NOI, FFO, AFFO, OPEX, CAPEX, leverage ratio, NAV calculation methodology, auditor sign-off status, and period status (open, closed, audited). Supports REIT reporting, investor redemption pricing, SEC filings, and ILPA reporting standards. Sourced from Argus Enterprise and MRI Software.

attributes.name: affo
attributes.description: Adjusted Funds From Operations (AFFO) for the measurement period — FFO adjusted for recurring capital expenditures (CAPEX), straight-line rent adjustments, and other non-cash items. Considered a more accurate proxy for distributable cash flow than FFO.
attributes.references: NAREIT FFO White Paper; SEC Form 10-K; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: alpha
attributes.description: The fund's excess return over the benchmark return for the measurement period (TWR minus benchmark_return). Positive alpha indicates outperformance; negative alpha indicates underperformance relative to the benchmark.
attributes.references: GIPS — CFA Institute; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external audit firm that reviewed or signed off on this performance period (e.g., 'Deloitte', 'PwC', 'KPMG', 'Ernst & Young'). Required for SEC filings and investor transparency.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X; PCAOB Standards

attributes.name: auditor_signoff_status
attributes.description: The external auditor's sign-off status for this performance period. 'not_required' for interim periods; 'pending' for annual periods awaiting audit; 'signed_off' for unqualified audit opinion; 'qualified' or 'adverse' for modified opinions. Required for SOX and SEC compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X; PCAOB Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: aum
attributes.description: Total Assets Under Management (AUM) for the fund as of the period end date. May differ from GAV when leverage is included or when AUM is defined per the fund's limited partnership agreement. Used for management fee calculations and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SEC Form ADV; ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: benchmark_name
attributes.description: The name of the benchmark index used for performance comparison (e.g., 'NCREIF ODCE', 'MSCI US REIT Index', 'FTSE NAREIT All Equity REITs'). Provides context for interpreting benchmark_return and alpha.
attributes.references: GIPS — CFA Institute; NCREIF; MSCI Real Estate Index

attributes.name: benchmark_return
attributes.description: The return of the designated benchmark index (e.g., NCREIF ODCE, MSCI Real Estate, S&P 500) for the same measurement period. Used to compute alpha and assess relative fund performance.
attributes.references: GIPS — CFA Institute; NCREIF; MSCI Real Estate Index

attributes.name: cap_rate
attributes.description: The weighted average Capitalization Rate (CAP Rate) applied across the fund's portfolio for the period — NOI divided by GAV. A key real estate valuation metric used in Argus Enterprise models and investor reporting.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC — IVS 105; NAREIT; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: capex
attributes.description: Total Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) incurred by the fund's portfolio during the measurement period, including Tenant Improvement (TI) allowances, building improvements, and major repairs that extend asset life.
attributes.references: NAREIT; FASB ASC 840/842; Yardi Voyager — Fixed Assets

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fund performance record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount rate or hurdle rate applied in the fund's DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) valuation models for the period, expressed as a decimal. Used to compute NPV and to assess whether the fund is meeting its return threshold.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; IVSC — IVS 105; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: distribution_per_unit
attributes.description: Cash distribution declared or paid per fund unit or share during the measurement period. Used for investor yield calculations, REIT dividend reporting, and AFFO payout ratio analysis.
attributes.references: NAREIT; SEC Form 10-K; FASB ASC 946; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: dpi
attributes.description: Distributions to Paid-In Capital (DPI) ratio — total cumulative distributions paid to investors divided by total paid-in capital. Measures the realized return component. A DPI of 1.0 means investors have received back their full invested capital in cash.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; GIPS — CFA Institute

attributes.name: equity_multiple
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equity Multiple (MOIC — Multiple on Invested Capital)
attributes.description: The ratio of total value (realized distributions plus unrealized NAV) to total invested capital, also known as Multiple on Invested Capital (MOIC). A value of 1.75 means investors have received or hold 1.75x their invested capital.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; GIPS — CFA Institute

attributes.name: ffo
attributes.description: Funds From Operations (FFO) for the measurement period — net income plus real estate depreciation and amortization, adjusted for gains/losses on property sales. The NAREIT-defined primary earnings metric for REITs, used in lieu of GAAP net income.
attributes.references: NAREIT FFO White Paper; SEC Form 10-K; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: gav
attributes.description: Gross Asset Value (GAV) of the fund as of the period end date — the sum of appraised market values of all properties and investments held by the fund, before deducting liabilities. Sourced from Argus Enterprise appraisal models.
attributes.references: IVSC — IVS 105; Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 820; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: gross_irr
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Internal Rate of Return (Gross IRR)
attributes.description: The annualized gross Internal Rate of Return (IRR) for the fund over the measurement period, before management fees and carried interest. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1250 = 12.50%). Core metric for ILPA and SEC reporting.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; GIPS — CFA Institute; SEC Form N-2

attributes.name: leverage_ratio
attributes.description: The fund's leverage ratio as of the period end date, typically expressed as total debt divided by GAV (Loan-to-Value / LTV). Monitors compliance with fund-level debt covenants and risk parameters.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Form N-2; FASB ASC 946; Lender Covenant Agreements

attributes.name: mwr
attributes.description: Money-Weighted Return (MWR) for the measurement period, reflecting the actual investor experience including the timing and magnitude of capital calls and distributions. Equivalent to the period IRR from the investor's perspective.
attributes.references: GIPS — CFA Institute; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: nav
attributes.description: Net Asset Value (NAV) of the fund as of the period end date — GAV minus total liabilities. The primary valuation basis for investor redemptions, unit pricing, and REIT reporting. Sourced from MRI Software and Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; IVSC; SEC Form N-2; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: nav_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology used to determine the NAV for this period. 'independent_appraisal' uses third-party Appraisal Institute-certified appraisers; 'internal_valuation' uses Argus Enterprise DCF models; 'broker_opinion' uses Broker Price Opinion (BPO); 'automated_valuation' uses AVM models; 'hybrid' combines methods.
attributes.references: IVSC — IVS 105; Appraisal Institute USPAP; FASB ASC 820; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: nav_per_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Asset Value Per Unit/Share (NAV per Unit)
attributes.description: NAV divided by total units or shares outstanding as of the period end date. The per-unit pricing basis for investor subscriptions, redemptions, and REIT share pricing.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form N-2; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: net_irr
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Internal Rate of Return (Net IRR)
attributes.description: The annualized net Internal Rate of Return (IRR) for the fund over the measurement period, after deducting management fees, carried interest, and fund expenses. Primary investor-facing performance metric.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; GIPS — CFA Institute; SEC Form N-2

attributes.name: noi
attributes.description: Net Operating Income (NOI) of the fund's underlying real estate portfolio for the measurement period — total revenue minus operating expenses, before debt service, depreciation, and income taxes. Core metric for real estate valuation and CAP rate analysis.
attributes.references: NAREIT; Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 946; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: npv
attributes.description: Net Present Value (NPV) of the fund's projected cash flows discounted at the fund's hurdle rate or discount rate as of the period end date. Sourced from Argus Enterprise DCF models.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; IVSC — IVS 105; FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: opex
attributes.description: Total Operating Expenditure (OPEX) of the fund's underlying portfolio for the measurement period, including property management fees, insurance, utilities, repairs, and Common Area Maintenance (CAM) costs.
attributes.references: NAREIT; FASB ASC 946; Yardi Voyager — General Ledger

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the measurement period for which fund performance metrics are reported (e.g., 2024-03-31 for Q1 2024).
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the measurement period for which fund performance metrics are reported (e.g., 2024-01-01 for Q1 2024).
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle state of the performance record. 'open' indicates the period is still accumulating data; 'closed' indicates the period is finalized; 'audited' indicates external auditor sign-off has been received; 'restated' indicates a prior-period correction has been applied.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the measurement period horizon. Drives how IRR, TWR, and benchmark comparisons are interpreted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: monthly|quarterly|annual|trailing_12|since_inception — promote to reference product if additional period types are required]
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; GIPS (Global Investment Performance Standards) — CFA Institute

attributes.name: premium_discount_to_nav
attributes.description: The percentage premium or discount at which the fund's market price or transaction price trades relative to its NAV per unit. Positive values indicate a premium; negative values indicate a discount. Critical for publicly traded REITs and closed-end funds.
attributes.references: SEC Form N-2; FASB ASC 946; NAREIT

attributes.name: rvpi
attributes.description: Residual Value to Paid-In Capital (RVPI) ratio — the current NAV of unrealized investments divided by total paid-in capital. Measures the unrealized return component. RVPI + DPI = TVPI.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; GIPS — CFA Institute

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The originating system record identifier from Argus Enterprise or MRI Software from which this performance record was sourced (e.g., Argus portfolio report ID or MRI period close reference). Supports data lineage and audit traceability.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: total_distributions
attributes.description: Total cash distributions paid to all fund investors during the measurement period. Feeds into DPI calculation and is a key component of ILPA cash flow reporting.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; NAREIT; SEC Form 10-K

attributes.name: total_liabilities
attributes.description: Total outstanding liabilities of the fund as of the period end date, including mortgage debt, credit facilities, accrued fees, and other obligations. NAV = GAV minus total_liabilities.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; IFRS 16; SEC Form N-2

attributes.name: total_revenue
attributes.description: Total revenue generated by the fund's underlying properties and investments during the measurement period, including Gross Rental Income (GRI), interest income, and other operating income. Sourced from MRI Software property accounting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; NAREIT FFO White Paper; MRI Software — Property Accounting

attributes.name: tvpi
attributes.description: Total Value to Paid-In Capital (TVPI) ratio — the sum of DPI and RVPI. Represents the total value created per dollar of invested capital, combining both realized and unrealized returns.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; GIPS — CFA Institute

attributes.name: twr
attributes.description: Time-Weighted Return (TWR) for the measurement period, eliminating the distorting effects of external cash flows (capital calls and distributions). The GIPS-compliant return metric for comparing fund manager performance against benchmarks.
attributes.references: GIPS — CFA Institute; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: units_outstanding
attributes.description: Total number of fund units or shares outstanding as of the period end date. Used to compute NAV per unit and to track dilution from new subscriptions or reduction from redemptions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; SEC Form N-2

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fund performance record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, restatement detection, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The specific date as of which the fund's GAV and NAV were determined. May differ from period_end_date if appraisals are conducted on a lag (e.g., appraisal as of December 31 reported in February).
attributes.references: IVSC — IVS 105; Appraisal Institute USPAP; FASB ASC 820

products.name: asset_performance
products.description: Period-level performance, valuation, and DCF modeling record for an individual portfolio asset. Captures actual results (NOI, EGI, PGI, vacancy rate, CAP rate, cash-on-cash return, unlevered/levered IRR, NPV, DSCR, LTV, total return, OPEX PSF, revenue PSF, occupancy rate, WALT, WALE) and DCF model parameters (model version, discount rate, hold period, projected NOI by year, projected growth rates, exit CAP rate, terminal value, sensitivity scenario). Enables asset-level attribution, scenario analysis, and roll-up to portfolio and fund performance. SSOT for investment-oriented asset analytics. Sourced from Argus Enterprise and Yardi Voyager.
products.reference: Asset-Level Performance — NCREIF Property Index, MSCI Real Estate
