attributes.name: appraised_value
attributes.description: Most recent third-party or internal appraised market value of the asset as of the performance period. Used for CAP rate calculation, LTV computation, and NAV/GAV reporting.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; USPAP; Argus Enterprise — Valuation

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this asset performance record was formally approved and finalized by the authorized asset manager or investment officer.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: cap_rate
attributes.description: Capitalization rate for the asset during the period, calculated as NOI divided by current market value. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0550 = 5.50%). Primary valuation and benchmarking metric for income-producing real estate.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; NCREIF; Argus Enterprise — Valuation

attributes.name: capex
attributes.description: Capital expenditures incurred on the asset during the period including tenant improvements (TI), leasing commissions, and building capital improvements. Distinct from OPEX; impacts cash-on-cash return and levered IRR.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 840/842; NCREIF; Yardi Voyager — Fixed Assets

attributes.name: cash_on_cash_return
attributes.description: Annual pre-tax cash flow divided by total equity invested in the asset. Expressed as a decimal. Measures the actual cash income earned on the equity invested, before considering appreciation or leverage effects.
attributes.references: NCREIF; ULI; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset performance record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this performance record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements. Primary sources are Argus Enterprise and Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; ISO 55000 Data Governance

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: Risk-adjusted discount rate applied in the DCF model to calculate NPV and present value of projected cash flows. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0750 = 7.50%). Reflects required rate of return for the investment strategy.
attributes.references: CFA Institute; Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: dscr
attributes.description: Ratio of NOI to total debt service (principal and interest) for the period. A DSCR above 1.0 indicates the property generates sufficient income to cover debt obligations. Critical metric for lenders and CMBS compliance.
attributes.references: CMBS Underwriting Standards; FASB; Yardi Voyager — Accounts Payable

attributes.name: egi
attributes.description: Actual gross income collected during the period after deducting vacancy and credit loss from PGI. EGI = PGI minus vacancy and credit loss. Core revenue metric for property-level performance.
attributes.references: NCREIF; Appraisal Institute; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: exit_cap_rate
attributes.description: Projected CAP rate applied to the terminal year NOI to calculate the asset's residual/terminal value at the end of the hold period. Expressed as a decimal. Key assumption in DCF terminal value calculation.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; Argus Enterprise — Valuation

attributes.name: hold_period_years
attributes.description: Projected investment hold period in years as modeled in the DCF analysis. Determines the time horizon over which cash flows are projected and the terminal value is calculated.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; ULI

attributes.name: levered_irr
attributes.description: Internal Rate of Return calculated on the asset's equity cash flows after accounting for debt financing. Expressed as a decimal. Reflects the return to equity investors after leverage effects.
attributes.references: NCREIF; CFA Institute; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of outstanding debt to current appraised or market value of the asset. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.6500 = 65%). Key leverage metric for lenders, CMBS covenants, and portfolio risk management.
attributes.references: CMBS Underwriting Standards; FASB; Federal Reserve Guidance

attributes.name: nla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Leasable Area in Square Feet (NLA SQF)
attributes.description: Net leasable area of the property in square feet as of the performance period. Used as the denominator for PSF metrics (OPEX PSF, revenue PSF) and occupancy calculations.
attributes.references: BOMA Standards; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: noi
attributes.description: Net Operating Income for the period calculated as EGI minus operating expenses. Primary measure of a property's income-generating ability before debt service and capital expenditures. SSOT metric for investment performance.
attributes.references: NCREIF; Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 842; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: npv
attributes.description: Net Present Value of the asset's projected cash flows discounted at the model's discount rate. Positive NPV indicates value creation above the required return threshold. Sourced from Argus Enterprise DCF model.
attributes.references: CFA Institute; Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of total leasable area that is occupied and generating income during the performance period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9150 = 91.50%). Core leasing performance indicator.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; NCREIF; CoStar Suite — Property Analytics

attributes.name: operating_expenses
attributes.description: Total property-level operating expenditures for the period including property management fees, insurance, taxes, utilities, repairs, and CAM costs. Excludes debt service and capital expenditures.
attributes.references: NCREIF; FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager — General Ledger

attributes.name: opex_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Expense Per Square Foot (OPEX PSF)
attributes.description: Total operating expenses divided by the property's net leasable area in square feet. Expressed as currency per square foot (PSF). Enables cross-property benchmarking of operating efficiency.
attributes.references: BOMA Standards; NCREIF; CoStar Suite — Property Analytics

attributes.name: performance_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the reporting period for which this asset performance record is calculated. Together with performance_period_start_date defines the measurement window.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: performance_period_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the reporting period for which this asset performance record is calculated. Used to define the measurement window for NOI, EGI, occupancy, and other period-level metrics.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: performance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this asset performance record. Draft indicates in-progress calculation; preliminary is unaudited; final is approved; restated reflects post-close corrections; archived is superseded.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the performance measurement period. Determines whether the record represents a monthly, quarterly, annual, trailing 12-month, or year-to-date snapshot.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Portfolio Reporting; ULI Best Practices

attributes.name: pgi
attributes.description: Total scheduled rental income assuming 100% occupancy at market or contracted rents for the period. Represents the theoretical maximum revenue before vacancy and credit loss deductions. Sourced from Yardi Voyager rent rolls.
attributes.references: NCREIF; Appraisal Institute; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: projected_noi_growth_rate
attributes.description: Annual NOI growth rate assumption applied in the DCF model for projecting future cash flows. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0300 = 3.00%). Reflects rent escalation, occupancy improvement, and expense management assumptions.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling; NCREIF

attributes.name: revenue_psf
attributes.description: Effective gross income divided by the property's net leasable area in square feet. Expressed as currency per square foot (PSF). Benchmarks revenue productivity across the portfolio.
attributes.references: BOMA Standards; NCREIF; CoStar Suite — Property Analytics

attributes.name: sensitivity_scenario
attributes.description: DCF sensitivity scenario label for this performance record. Base is the primary underwriting case; upside reflects optimistic assumptions; downside reflects conservative assumptions; stress reflects severe adverse conditions.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; ULI; NCREIF

attributes.name: terminal_value
attributes.description: Projected residual value of the asset at the end of the DCF hold period, calculated as terminal year NOI divided by exit CAP rate. Represents the expected sale proceeds at disposition.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; CFA Institute

attributes.name: total_return
attributes.description: Total investment return for the period combining income return (NOI yield) and capital appreciation return. Expressed as a decimal. NCREIF-standard metric for benchmarking against property indices.
attributes.references: NCREIF Property Index (NPI); CFA Institute; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: unlevered_irr
attributes.description: Internal Rate of Return calculated on the asset's cash flows before debt financing (unlevered/all-equity basis). Expressed as a decimal. Measures the intrinsic return of the asset independent of capital structure.
attributes.references: NCREIF; CFA Institute; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset performance record was last modified. Tracks restatements, corrections, and updates to performance data throughout the record lifecycle.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: vacancy_credit_loss
attributes.description: Deduction from PGI representing income lost due to vacant units and uncollectable rents during the period. Used to derive EGI from PGI.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; NCREIF; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: vacancy_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of total leasable area that is unoccupied during the performance period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0850 = 8.50%). Inverse of occupancy rate; key driver of EGI and NOI.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; NCREIF; CoStar Suite — Property Analytics

attributes.name: wale
attributes.description: Weighted average date on which leases across the asset expire, weighted by rental income or NLA. Expressed as a date. Indicates the point in time when the portfolio faces significant re-leasing risk.
attributes.references: RESO; NCREIF; Argus Enterprise — Lease Management

attributes.name: walt
attributes.description: Weighted average remaining lease term across all occupied tenants, weighted by rental income or NLA. Expressed in years. Measures lease duration risk and income security of the asset.
attributes.references: RESO; NCREIF; Argus Enterprise — Lease Management

SSOT for investment-level debt instruments and covenant compliance monitoring.

attributes.description: Maximum principal amount committed by the lender under this facility. For revolving or construction facilities, this is the total available commitment, not the drawn balance.

attributes.name: covenant_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of all financial covenants on this facility. Drives lender notification workflows, waiver requests, and regulatory disclosures.

attributes.name: covenant_dscr_threshold
attributes.business_glossary_term: Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) Covenant Threshold
attributes.description: Minimum DSCR required under the loan covenant, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.20). Breach triggers lender notification, cash trap, or default provisions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; CMBS Underwriting Standards; HUD

attributes.name: covenant_ltv_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum LTV ratio permitted under the loan covenant, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.75 for 75%). Breach triggers lender notification and potential cure obligations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; CMBS Underwriting Standards; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: covenant_measurement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which financial covenants (LTV, DSCR, occupancy) are tested and reported to the lender.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement

attributes.name: covenant_occupancy_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum physical occupancy rate required under the loan covenant, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.85 for 85%). Measured against GLA or NLA depending on loan agreement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; CMBS Underwriting Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this debt facility record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: cure_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the borrower has to remedy a covenant breach before the lender may declare an event of default. Defined in the loan agreement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement

attributes.name: dscr
attributes.description: Ratio of Net Operating Income (NOI) to total annual debt service (principal and interest). Measures the property's ability to cover debt obligations. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.25). Key covenant and underwriting metric.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Appraisal Institute; CMBS Underwriting Standards; HUD

attributes.name: extended_maturity_date
attributes.description: Maturity date after exercise of extension options, if applicable. Null if no extension has been exercised or no extension option exists.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; MRI Software — Loan Tracking

attributes.name: extension_options_count
attributes.description: Number of extension options available to the borrower to extend the maturity date, subject to conditions (e.g., no event of default, minimum DSCR). Common in bridge and construction loans.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Loan Tracking; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: extension_period_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of each extension option. Multiplied by extension_options_count to determine maximum extended term.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Loan Tracking; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Descriptive business name for the debt facility (e.g., 'One Market Plaza Senior Mortgage', 'Portfolio Bridge Facility 2024'). Used for identification in reporting and dashboards.
attributes.references: Internal Naming Convention; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: facility_number
attributes.description: Externally-known loan or facility reference number assigned by the lender or originating system. Used for lender correspondence, CMBS reporting, and covenant tracking.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Debt Management Module; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: facility_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the debt facility. Drives covenant monitoring workflows, reporting inclusion, and asset management alerts.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; MRI Software — Debt Tracking

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the debt instrument by structure and purpose. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mortgage_loan|construction_loan|bridge_loan|mezzanine_debt|credit_facility|cmbs|rmbs — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 — Debt; CMBS/RMBS industry classification; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: All-in annual interest rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.065 for 6.5%). For floating rate facilities, this is the current effective rate (spread plus index). Used in debt service and NOI analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: interest_rate_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interest rate is fixed for the loan term, floating (variable based on a benchmark index), or hybrid (fixed converting to floating or vice versa).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 815 Derivatives and Hedging; IFRS 9; ARM/FRM industry classification

attributes.name: io_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months from origination during which only interest payments are required, with no principal amortization. Common in bridge loans and construction facilities.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: is_cross_collateralized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this facility is secured by multiple properties under a cross-collateralization agreement. True for portfolio loans; False for single-asset facilities.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; ALTA Standards

attributes.name: is_cross_defaulted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a default on this facility triggers a default on other debt facilities under a cross-default provision. Critical for portfolio risk management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; SEC Regulation S-K; CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement

attributes.name: last_covenant_test_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent covenant compliance measurement was performed. Used to determine when the next test is due.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement

attributes.name: lender_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current covenant compliance status requires formal written notification to the lender per the loan agreement terms.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; SEC Regulation S-K; SOX

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of the outstanding loan balance to the appraised or market value of the collateral property at origination or last measurement. Key underwriting and covenant metric expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.65 for 65% LTV).
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; FASB ASC 310; HUD Underwriting Guidelines

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Contractual date on which the outstanding principal balance is due in full. Key input for WALT/WALE analysis and refinancing pipeline management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: origination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the debt facility was originated or closed. Marks the start of the loan term and triggers amortization schedule calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Yardi Voyager — Debt Module

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Current drawn and outstanding principal balance on the debt facility as of the last reporting date. Used in LTV calculations, DSCR analysis, and balance sheet reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; IFRS 9; Yardi Voyager — Debt Module

attributes.name: prepayment_lockout_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which prepayment is permitted (subject to applicable penalty). Null if no lockout period applies.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement Standards

attributes.name: prepayment_type
attributes.description: Type of prepayment restriction or penalty applicable to this facility: lockout (no prepayment allowed), yield maintenance, defeasance, step-down penalty, or none.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement Standards

attributes.name: rate_index
attributes.description: Benchmark interest rate index to which the floating rate spread is applied (e.g., SOFR, Prime Rate, Treasury). Null for fixed-rate facilities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SOFR|LIBOR|Prime|EURIBOR|Treasury|SONIA|fixed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 815; ARRC SOFR Transition Guidelines; IFRS 9

attributes.name: rate_spread
attributes.description: Margin or spread above the benchmark index expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0200 for 200 basis points). Applicable to floating rate facilities only.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: recourse_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the debt obligation is full recourse, non-recourse, or partial recourse to the borrower entity. Critical for risk assessment and balance sheet classification.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; IVSC Valuation Standards; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: seniority_tier
attributes.description: Capital stack position of this debt facility relative to other obligations on the same collateral. Determines priority of repayment in liquidation or refinancing scenarios.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; SEC Regulation S-K; ULI Capital Markets Standards

attributes.name: servicer_name
attributes.description: Name of the loan servicer responsible for collecting payments, managing escrows, and administering the loan on behalf of the lender or CMBS trust.
attributes.references: CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement; FASB ASC 860

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating system of record for this debt facility record (e.g., Yardi Voyager loan ID, MRI debt module reference). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance; Yardi Voyager; MRI Software

attributes.name: unfunded_commitment
attributes.description: Portion of the total commitment not yet drawn by the borrower. Relevant for construction loans, credit facilities, and revolving debt structures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this debt facility record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance

Enables proactive covenant compliance monitoring across the debt portfolio. Sourced from MRI Software and SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: compliance_violation_id

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the borrowing legal entity (SPV, REIT, partnership, LLC) obligated under this covenant. Supports entity-level covenant compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Financial Consolidation; SEC — REIT Reporting

attributes.name: lender_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lender or lending institution that imposed this covenant. Used to group covenant compliance obligations by counterparty.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Compliance teams map each covenant

attributes.name: breach_date
attributes.description: The date on which a covenant breach was first identified. Populated when compliance_status transitions to 'breach'. Used to calculate cure deadlines and trigger lender notification workflows.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470-50; IFRS 9; MRI Software

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific calculation methodology for the covenant metric as defined in the loan agreement, including any agreed adjustments, exclusions, or definitions (e.g., how NOI is defined for DSCR purposes, whether straight-line rent is included).
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling; FASB ASC 470; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance state of this covenant: compliant (threshold met), breach (threshold violated), waiver (lender has granted a formal waiver), cure_period (within contractual cure window), watch_list (approaching threshold), or not_tested (measurement not yet due).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470-50; IFRS 9; MRI Software — Investment Management; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: covenant_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the covenant terms and conditions as extracted from the loan agreement, including any qualifications, exclusions, or special calculation methodologies.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Contract Lifecycle Management; FASB ASC 470

attributes.name: covenant_metric
attributes.description: The specific financial or operational metric being tested by this covenant, such as Loan-to-Value Ratio (LTV), Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR), occupancy rate, Net Operating Income (NOI), debt yield, Interest Coverage Ratio (ICR), Funds From Operations (FFO), Adjusted Funds From Operations (AFFO), or Net Asset Value (NAV). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LTV|DSCR|occupancy_rate|NOI|debt_yield|ICR|FFO|AFFO|NAV|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; IFRS 16; Appraisal Institute; IVSC; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: covenant_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or short description of the covenant as defined in the loan agreement (e.g., 'Minimum DSCR Test', 'Maximum LTV Covenant', 'Minimum Occupancy Requirement').
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: covenant_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this covenant as referenced in the loan agreement or credit facility documentation. Used for lender correspondence and audit trail.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; DocuSign CLM — Contract Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: covenant_scope
attributes.description: Defines the level at which the covenant is tested: asset_level (single property), portfolio_level (pool of properties), entity_level (borrowing SPV or LLC), or fund_level (entire investment fund or REIT).
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; SAP S/4HANA; SEC — REIT Reporting

attributes.name: covenant_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the covenant: financial (ratio-based tests), operational (occupancy, NOI), reporting (information delivery obligations), maintenance (ongoing compliance tests), or incurrence (triggered by specific actions). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: financial|operational|reporting|maintenance|incurrence — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 — Debt; IFRS 9 — Financial Instruments; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this covenant record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX — Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5; ISO 55000 — Asset Management

attributes.name: cure_deadline_date
attributes.description: The specific calendar date by which a covenant breach must be remedied, calculated from the breach detection date plus the cure_period_days. Populated only when compliance_status is 'breach' or 'cure_period'.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470-50; MRI Software

attributes.name: cure_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the borrower has to remedy a covenant breach before the lender may exercise remedies (e.g., acceleration, default). Defined in the loan agreement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470-50; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this covenant becomes binding and enforceable under the loan agreement. Marks the start of the compliance obligation period.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; DocuSign CLM; MRI Software

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this covenant obligation expires or is released, typically aligned with the loan maturity date or a contractual release event. Null for covenants with no defined end date.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: is_cross_default
attributes.description: Indicates whether a breach of this covenant triggers a cross-default event under other debt facilities of the same borrower or related entities. Critical for portfolio-level risk management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470-50; IFRS 9; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: is_financial_covenant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this covenant is classified as a financial covenant under FASB ASC 470 or IFRS 9, which may require reclassification of the associated debt from long-term to current liabilities upon breach.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470-50; IFRS 9 — Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA — Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: last_measured_value
attributes.description: The most recently calculated or reported value of the covenant metric as of the last measurement date. Compared against threshold_value to determine compliance_status.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Argus Enterprise — Portfolio Reporting; FASB ASC 470

attributes.name: last_measurement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the covenant metric was most recently calculated and tested against the threshold. Used to determine when the next measurement is due.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; FASB ASC 470

attributes.name: lender_notification_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days within which the borrower must notify the lender following a covenant breach, as specified in the loan agreement. Applicable only when lender_notification_required is True.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; MRI Software

attributes.name: lender_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loan agreement requires the borrower to formally notify the lender upon a covenant breach or when the metric approaches the threshold. Drives automated notification workflows.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: How often the covenant metric must be calculated and reported to the lender: monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, or on-demand (triggered by specific events such as a new acquisition or disposition).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: The look-back or calculation period used when computing the covenant metric: trailing 12 months (T12), trailing 3 months annualized, point-in-time (balance sheet date), or annualized from a shorter period.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Cash Flow Modeling; FASB ASC 470; MRI Software

attributes.name: next_measurement_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next covenant measurement and compliance test. Derived from last_measurement_date and measurement_frequency but stored explicitly to support proactive monitoring workflows.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for asset managers or compliance officers to record additional context, remediation actions taken, lender communications, or other qualitative information relevant to this covenant.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal breach notification was dispatched to the lender. Used to evidence compliance with contractual notification obligations and support audit requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470-50; SOX — Financial Controls; MRI Software

attributes.name: reporting_due_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the measurement period end date by which the compliance certificate or reporting package must be delivered to the lender. Applicable when reporting_package_required is True.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; FASB ASC 470

attributes.name: reporting_package_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender requires a formal compliance certificate or reporting package (e.g., rent roll, financial statements, occupancy report) to be submitted alongside each covenant measurement.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; SAP S/4HANA; SOX

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this covenant record was sourced: MRI Software, SAP S/4HANA, Yardi Voyager, Argus Enterprise, or Manual (for covenants entered directly into the lakehouse).
attributes.references: MRI Software; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The unique identifier or record reference for this covenant in the originating source system (MRI Software or SAP S/4HANA). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability between the lakehouse and operational systems.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; SAP S/4HANA — Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: threshold_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the covenant requires the metric to be at or above a minimum (e.g., minimum DSCR of 1.25x) or at or below a maximum (e.g., maximum LTV of 75%). Determines the breach logic for compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the threshold value: ratio (e.g., LTV expressed as 0.75), percentage (e.g., occupancy rate as 85%), currency (e.g., minimum NOI in USD), or times (e.g., DSCR expressed as 1.25x).
attributes.references: IVSC; Appraisal Institute; MRI Software

attributes.name: threshold_value
attributes.description: The contractually defined threshold or limit for the covenant metric. For ratio-based covenants (LTV, DSCR), this is expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.75 for 75% LTV). For monetary covenants (minimum NOI), this is expressed in the applicable currency.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; IFRS 9; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this covenant record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used to detect stale records and support incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX — Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: waiver_date
attributes.description: The date on which the lender formally granted a waiver for a covenant breach. Populated only when compliance_status is 'waiver'.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470-50; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: waiver_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which a lender-granted waiver expires. After this date, the covenant reverts to its standard compliance testing regime. Null if the waiver is permanent.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470-50; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: watch_list_threshold_value
attributes.description: An internal early-warning threshold set by the asset management team, typically more conservative than the contractual threshold_value. When last_measured_value approaches this level, the covenant is flagged as 'watch_list' to trigger proactive remediation.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Argus Enterprise — Portfolio Reporting; ULI Best Practices

attributes.description: Operational status of the deal record, distinct from deal_stage. Indicates whether the deal is actively being pursued (active), paused (on_hold), IC-approved (approved), IC-rejected (rejected), withdrawn by counterparty (withdrawn), or fully closed (closed).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Deal Pipeline; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: hold_period_years
attributes.description: Projected investment hold period in years as assumed in the underwriting model (e.g., 5.00, 7.50, 10.00). Drives IRR calculation and exit strategy planning in Argus Enterprise DCF models.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: ic_approving_members
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IC member names or IDs who voted to approve the deal. Captured for governance audit trail and SOX compliance. Stored as a structured string; full member details reside in the workforce domain.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: ic_conditions_of_approval
attributes.description: Free-text description of any conditions, covenants, or requirements attached to the IC's conditional approval (e.g., 'Subject to satisfactory Phase I ESG environmental review', 'Requires lender commitment letter at ≤65% LTV'). Null if unconditional approval or not yet decided.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; EPA Environmental Compliance; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: ic_decision
attributes.description: Formal decision rendered by the Investment Committee (IC): approved (unconditional go-ahead), rejected (deal declined), conditional_approval (approved subject to conditions), deferred (decision postponed pending additional information), withdrawn (deal pulled before IC vote).
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Section 302/404; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: ic_decision_date
attributes.description: Date the Investment Committee (IC) rendered its formal decision (approve, reject, or conditional approval) on the deal. Essential for IC governance audit trail and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: ic_key_risks
attributes.description: Free-text summary of key investment risks identified in the IC memo (e.g., lease rollover risk, market vacancy trends, environmental exposure, construction cost overruns). Supports IC governance documentation and post-investment risk monitoring.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); SEC Regulation S-X; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: ic_recommendation
attributes.description: AM team's formal recommendation to the IC as stated in the IC memo: recommend (team supports proceeding), do_not_recommend (team advises against), conditional_recommend (team supports subject to conditions). Distinct from the IC's actual decision.
attributes.references: Urban Land Institute (ULI); SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: ic_submission_date
attributes.description: Date the IC memo was formally submitted to the Investment Committee (IC) for review. Marks the start of the IC governance process. Critical for IC audit trail and governance compliance.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Section 302/404; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: is_off_market
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deal was sourced through proprietary off-market channels (True) rather than publicly marketed processes such as MLS, broker campaigns, or auctions (False). Key metric for sourcing strategy and competitive advantage analytics.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); CoStar Suite

attributes.name: loi_date
attributes.description: Date the Letter of Intent (LOI) was submitted or executed with the counterparty. Marks the transition from initial sourcing to formal deal pursuit. Key milestone in the investment pipeline lifecycle.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Contract Lifecycle Management; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General free-text notes and commentary on the deal, including negotiation context, counterparty background, market observations, or deal-specific considerations not captured in structured fields. Sourced from Salesforce CRM deal pipeline notes.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Deal Pipeline

attributes.name: projected_close_date
attributes.description: Anticipated closing date for the transaction as projected during underwriting or per the PSA. Used for capital deployment forecasting, fund cash flow planning, and pipeline reporting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Portfolio Reporting; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating system record for this deal (e.g., Salesforce CRM Opportunity ID, MRI Software deal reference). Enables lineage tracing and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and operational systems of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Deal Pipeline; MRI Software — Investment Management

attributes.name: sourced_date
attributes.description: Date the investment opportunity was first identified and entered into the deal pipeline. Represents the business event timestamp for deal origination. Used to measure pipeline velocity and sourcing lead times.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Deal Pipeline; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the deal in the investment pipeline lifecycle: sourced (initial identification), loi (Letter of Intent submitted), due_diligence (active investigation), ic_review (Investment Committee review), under_contract (PSA executed), closed (transaction completed), dead (deal terminated). Drives pipeline reporting and IC governance audit trail. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sourced|loi|due_diligence|ic_review|under_contract|closed|dead — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Deal Pipeline; Urban Land Institute (ULI) — Investment Process Standards

attributes.name: target_cap_rate
attributes.description: Underwritten going-in Capitalization Rate (CAP Rate) expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0550 = 5.50%). Calculated as Net Operating Income (NOI) divided by purchase price. Key return metric for acquisition underwriting and IC memo.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC; Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: target_equity_multiple
attributes.description: Underwritten equity multiple (total distributions / total equity invested) over the projected hold period. Complements IRR as a return metric in IC memos (e.g., 1.85x means $1.85 returned per $1.00 invested).
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: target_irr
attributes.description: Underwritten levered Internal Rate of Return (IRR) expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1200 = 12.00%). Represents the projected annualized return on equity over the hold period. Primary return hurdle metric evaluated by the Investment Committee (IC).
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; CFA Institute; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: underwritten_debt_amount
attributes.description: Total debt financing assumed in the underwriting model for this deal. Represents the debt portion of the capital stack. Used to calculate Loan-to-Value Ratio (LTV) and Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) in IC analysis.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; FASB ASC 470; CMBS/RMBS standards

attributes.name: underwritten_equity_amount
attributes.description: Total equity capital required for the deal as underwritten in the IC memo. Represents the equity portion of the capital stack (total deal cost minus debt). Drives capital call planning and fund commitment tracking.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Investment Analysis; FASB ASC 946; SEC Regulation D

attributes.name: underwritten_ltv
attributes.description: Underwritten Loan-to-Value Ratio (LTV) expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.6500 = 65%). Calculated as underwritten debt divided by underwritten value. Key leverage metric reviewed by the IC and lenders.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; FASB ASC 310; CMBS underwriting standards

attributes.name: underwritten_noi
attributes.description: Stabilized Net Operating Income (NOI) as projected in the underwriting model. Represents effective gross income minus operating expenses, excluding debt service and capital expenditures. Foundation of CAP rate and DCF valuation.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; NCREIF; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: underwritten_value
attributes.description: Internal valuation of the asset as determined by the Asset Manager's (AM) underwriting model (typically a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) or direct capitalization approach in Argus Enterprise). Represents the AM's view of intrinsic value, distinct from asking price.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise — Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; IVSC — International Valuation Standards; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this investment deal pipeline record was last modified. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer and audit trail requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 8601

products.name: capital_account
products.description: Periodic investor capital account statement summarizing each investor's position in a fund. Captures statement period, beginning capital account balance, capital contributions in period, distributions in period, allocated income/loss, management fees charged, carried interest allocated, ending capital account balance, ownership percentage, unrealized gain/loss, and cumulative IRR since inception. Supports LP reporting obligations and ILPA transparency standards. SSOT for investor-level fund position reporting.
products.reference: Capital Account Statement — ILPA Reporting Template, K-1 Tax Reporting

attributes.name: capital_account_id
attributes.description: Primary key for capital_account

attributes.name: commitment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investor's capital commitment agreement within the fund, linking this statement to the specific subscription or limited partnership agreement.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency_code. Business justification: Capital account currency drives investor statement generation, K-1 tax reporting, and multi-currency NAV per unit calculations — a core fund administration and investor reporting process.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment fund (REIT, partnership, or private equity vehicle) to which this capital account statement belongs.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Regulation D; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: fund_performance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.fund_performance. Business justification: A capital account statement is a periodic investor-level reconciliation that must align with the fund's performance reporting period. The capital account captures allocated income/loss, NAV per unit,

attributes.name: investor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the limited partner or investor entity whose capital account position is summarized in this statement.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Regulation D

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: LP capital account statements are produced from a specific ledger (GAAP, tax, IFRS). Fund accountants must know which ledger basis underlies each capital account balance for audit, LP reporting, and t
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Capital account statements (K-1s, investor statements) are tied to regulatory filings (tax filings, SEC reports, FATCA/CRS). Linking capital accounts to regulatory filings supports investor tax report
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: reporting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.reporting_period. Business justification: Capital account statements are issued per reporting period (quarterly/annual). Linking to reporting_period enables period-over-period LP capital balance tracking, audit trail, and regulatory LP statem
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: valuation_nav_calculation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to valuation.nav_calculation. Business justification: Investor capital account statements report nav_per_unit sourced from the formal NAV calculation. LP quarterly statements and K-1 preparation require tracing the NAV per unit to the specific calculatio
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: allocated_income_loss
attributes.description: Net income or loss allocated to this investor's capital account during the period per the fund's partnership agreement waterfall and allocation methodology. Positive values represent income allocation; negative values represent loss allocation.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; IRS Schedule K-1; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: beginning_capital_balance
attributes.description: Investor's capital account balance at the start of the statement period, equal to the ending balance of the immediately preceding period. Serves as the opening balance for the period's capital account roll-forward reconciliation.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: capital_contributions
attributes.description: Total capital contributed by the investor during the statement period in response to capital calls. Includes funded amounts from all capital calls settled within the period. Increases the capital account balance.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: capital_distributions
attributes.description: Total distributions returned to the investor during the statement period, including return of capital, realized gains, and income distributions. Decreases the capital account balance. Reported as a positive number representing cash out to the investor.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: carried_interest_allocated
attributes.description: Performance-based carried interest (carry) allocated to the general partner and charged against this investor's capital account during the period, per the fund's waterfall provisions. Typically triggered after the preferred return hurdle is met.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; SEC Regulation D; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capital account statement record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 946; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: cumulative_contributions
attributes.description: Total capital contributed by the investor from fund inception through the end of the statement period. Used for IRR calculation, return-of-capital tracking, and ILPA transparency reporting.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: cumulative_distributions
attributes.description: Total distributions returned to the investor from fund inception through the end of the statement period. Used for DPI (Distributions to Paid-In) multiple calculation and ILPA transparency reporting.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: dpi
attributes.description: Distributions to Paid-In (DPI) multiple for this investor from inception through the statement period end date. Calculated as cumulative_distributions / cumulative_contributions. Measures the realized return multiple relative to invested capital.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; CFA Institute GIPS; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: ending_capital_balance
attributes.description: Investor's capital account balance at the close of the statement period. Calculated as: beginning_capital_balance + capital_contributions - capital_distributions + allocated_income_loss - management_fees_charged - carried_interest_allocated - other_fees_charged. This is the SSOT for the investor's fund position at period end.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter number (1–4) within the fiscal year for this statement period. Supports quarterly LP reporting packages and quarterly performance attribution analysis.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year in which this statement period falls (e.g., 2024). Used for annual rollup reporting, tax K-1 preparation, and year-over-year performance comparison.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946; IRS Schedule K-1; ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: inception_to_date_irr
attributes.description: Cumulative Internal Rate of Return (IRR) for this investor's capital account from fund inception through the statement period end date, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.142500 = 14.25%). Calculated using the XIRR methodology on all cash flows. Primary performance metric for LP reporting.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; CFA Institute GIPS; Argus Enterprise; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: is_tax_exempt_investor
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor is a tax-exempt entity (e.g., pension fund, endowment, foundation, ERISA plan) for purposes of UBTI (Unrelated Business Taxable Income) tracking and tax reporting. True = tax-exempt; False = taxable investor.
attributes.references: IRS UBTI Rules; ERISA; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: management_fees_charged
attributes.description: Asset management fees charged to this investor's capital account during the period, calculated per the fund's management fee schedule (typically expressed as a percentage of committed or invested capital). Reduces the capital account balance.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Investment Advisers Act; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: moic
attributes.description: Multiple on Invested Capital (MOIC) for this investor from inception through the statement period end date. Calculated as (ending_capital_balance + cumulative_distributions) / cumulative_contributions. Measures total value creation relative to invested capital.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; CFA Institute GIPS; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: nav_per_unit
attributes.description: Net Asset Value per fund unit or interest as of the statement period end date, used to value the investor's position. Derived from the fund's total NAV divided by total units outstanding. Supports investor-level NAV attribution.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for asset manager or fund administrator annotations regarding this capital account statement, such as restatement explanations, special allocation notes, or investor-specific adjustments.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Investor's percentage ownership interest in the fund as of the statement period end date, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.125000 = 12.5%). Used for income/loss allocation, voting rights, and NAV attribution calculations.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; SEC Regulation D

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Frequency classification of the reporting period for this capital account statement. Determines the cadence of LP reporting obligations and aligns with fund governing document requirements.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: preferred_return_accrued
attributes.description: Cumulative preferred return accrued but not yet distributed to the investor from fund inception through the statement period end date. Represents the outstanding preferred return obligation owed to the LP before carried interest can be earned.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: preferred_return_rate
attributes.description: Annual preferred return (hurdle rate) percentage applicable to this investor's capital account per the fund's limited partnership agreement (e.g., 0.0800 = 8.00%). Determines the threshold above which carried interest is charged to the investor.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; SEC Regulation D

attributes.name: realized_gain_loss
attributes.description: Investor's pro-rata share of realized gains or losses from asset dispositions completed during the statement period. Represents the difference between net sale proceeds and cost basis allocated to this investor.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; IRS Schedule K-1

attributes.name: rvpi
attributes.description: Residual Value to Paid-In (RVPI) multiple for this investor as of the statement period end date. Calculated as ending_capital_balance / cumulative_contributions. Measures the unrealized value remaining relative to invested capital.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; CFA Institute GIPS; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: Identifier or reference code from the originating system of record (e.g., MRI Software or Argus Enterprise) for this capital account statement record. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability back to the operational system.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ILPA Reporting Standards; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: statement_issue_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this capital account statement was formally issued and made available to the investor. Used for ILPA compliance tracking and investor communication audit trails.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Regulation D

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable identifier for this capital account statement, typically formatted as FUND-INVESTOR-PERIOD (e.g., FUND001-LP042-2024Q4). Used in LP reporting packages and investor communications.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: statement_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the reporting period covered by this capital account statement (e.g., 2024-03-31 for Q1 2024). Defines the end of the measurement window and the valuation date for ending balance calculations.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: statement_period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the reporting period covered by this capital account statement (e.g., 2024-01-01 for Q1 2024). Defines the beginning of the measurement window for all period activity fields.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the capital account statement. Draft indicates in-preparation; preliminary indicates unaudited release; final indicates audited and approved; restated indicates a corrected reissuance; superseded indicates replaced by a newer version.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946 Financial Services — Investment Companies

attributes.name: tax_basis_adjustment
attributes.description: Cumulative tax basis adjustment to the investor's capital account from inception through the statement period end date, reflecting differences between GAAP book basis and tax basis (e.g., depreciation timing differences, Section 754 elections). Supports K-1 preparation.
attributes.references: IRS Schedule K-1; IRS Section 754; FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: total_commitment_amount
attributes.description: Investor's total committed capital to the fund as stated in the limited partnership agreement or subscription agreement. Represents the maximum capital obligation of the investor regardless of how much has been called.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; SEC Regulation D; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: uncalled_commitment_amount
attributes.description: Remaining capital commitment not yet called by the fund as of the statement period end date. Calculated as total_commitment_amount minus cumulative_contributions. Represents the investor's remaining unfunded obligation (dry powder).
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: units_held
attributes.description: Number of fund units, interests, or shares held by the investor as of the statement period end date. Used in conjunction with nav_per_unit to calculate the investor's total NAV position.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_loss
attributes.description: Investor's pro-rata share of unrealized appreciation or depreciation in the fund's portfolio as of the statement period end date, based on current fair market valuations versus cost basis. Positive values indicate unrealized gain; negative values indicate unrealized loss.
attributes.references: ILPA Reporting Standards; FASB ASC 946; IVSC Valuation Standards; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capital account statement record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks restatements, corrections, and preliminary-to-final transitions for audit and SOX compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 946; ILPA Reporting Standards

domains.name: maintenance

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) Project Completion Date

attributes.references: Procore Project Management; FASB ASC 360; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: actual_spend_to_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) Spend to Date
attributes.description: Cumulative actual expenditure incurred on the project to date, sourced from SAP S/4HANA cost collection or Yardi AP postings. Used for budget variance analysis, cash flow forecasting, and CAPEX vs. OPEX classification reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; Yardi Voyager AP; FASB ASC 360; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) Project Start Date
attributes.description: Date on which project construction or installation activities actually commenced. Compared against planned start date for schedule variance analysis and contractor performance evaluation.
attributes.references: Procore Project Management; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Level of organizational authority that approved this capital project. Reflects the delegation of authority matrix for CAPEX approvals. Used for SOX controls documentation and audit trail. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: property_manager|asset_manager|vp_operations|cfo|investment_committee|board — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; FASB ASC 360; Internal CAPEX Authorization Policy

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the capital project received formal investment committee or board approval. Required for SOX financial controls documentation and CAPEX authorization audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; FASB ASC 360; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: Board or investment committee approved budget for the capital project in the operating currency. Represents the authorized CAPEX spend ceiling. Used for variance analysis against actual spend and DSCR/LTV covenant compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SOX Financial Controls; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: Classification of the asset being created or improved by the capital project. Determines the depreciation method and useful life schedule applied upon capitalization. Aligns with the fixed asset register taxonomy in Yardi and SAP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: building_structure|mechanical_systems|electrical_systems|plumbing_systems|hvac|roof|elevators|parking|it_infrastructure|fit_out — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets; SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting; ISO 55000

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the completed project costs were capitalized and transferred to the fixed asset register in the GL. Marks the start of the depreciation schedule. Critical for FASB ASC 360 compliance and balance sheet accuracy.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets; SAP S/4HANA Fixed Assets; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: change_order_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative value of all approved change orders against the primary construction contract. Added to the original contract value to determine the revised contract sum. Used for budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: Procore Change Orders; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: change_order_count
attributes.description: Total number of approved change orders issued against the primary construction contract. Indicates project scope stability and contractor performance. High change order counts may signal design deficiency or scope creep.
attributes.references: Procore Change Orders; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: committed_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total value of purchase orders and contracts committed but not yet invoiced or paid for this project. Represents financial obligations already incurred. Used in cash flow forecasting and budget-to-complete analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; Procore Commitments; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: contract_value_amount
attributes.description: Total contracted value with the primary general contractor for execution of the capital project. May differ from approved budget due to contingency reserves or owner-direct procurement. Used for commitment tracking and lien exposure management.
attributes.references: Procore Commitments; SAP S/4HANA Procurement; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: coo_issued_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Certificate of Occupancy (COO) was issued by the relevant authority, confirming the completed improvement meets all building code and safety requirements. Required before tenant occupancy and asset capitalization.
attributes.references: HUD Regulatory Requirements; Local Building Codes; OSHA Building Safety; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capital project record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls documentation. Sourced from Building Engines or Procore at project initiation.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; ISO 55000

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting depreciation method to be applied to the capitalized asset upon project completion. Determined by asset category and accounting policy. Straight-line is most common for real estate assets under FASB ASC 360.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: erp_project_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Project System Code
attributes.description: Project code assigned in SAP S/4HANA Project Systems (PS module) for cost collection, procurement integration, and financial consolidation. Used to reconcile CAPEX spend between the maintenance CMMS and the ERP general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Source of funds financing the capital project. Determines accounting treatment, loan covenant implications, and investor reporting requirements. Insurance proceeds and tenant reimbursements have distinct revenue recognition rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: operating_reserves|debt_financing|equity_contribution|insurance_proceeds|tenant_reimbursement|government_grant|refinancing_proceeds — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; FASB ASC 842; SEC REIT Reporting; CMBS Loan Covenants

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code in Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA to which CAPEX project costs are posted. Ensures correct balance sheet classification (asset vs. expense) and supports financial consolidation and audit.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager General Ledger; SAP S/4HANA GL; FASB ASC 360; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: is_esg_initiative
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Initiative Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capital project is classified as an ESG initiative (e.g., LEED certification upgrade, BREEAM improvement, energy efficiency retrofit, EV charging installation). Supports ESG portfolio reporting and green financing eligibility.
attributes.references: USGBC LEED Certification; BREEAM; EPA Environmental Compliance; SEC ESG Disclosure; ULI ESG Standards

attributes.name: is_tenant_improvement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capital project constitutes a Tenant Improvement (TI) as defined under ASC 842 or IFRS 16. TI projects have distinct lease accounting treatment, amortization rules, and may be partially reimbursed by tenants.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 Lease Accounting; IFRS 16 Leases; NAR Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the capital project record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; ISO 55000

attributes.name: leed_certification_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Target
attributes.description: Target LEED certification level sought for this capital project, if applicable. Relevant for green building upgrades and ESG-linked financing. Null or 'none' if LEED certification is not a project objective.
attributes.references: USGBC LEED Certification; EPA Environmental Compliance; SEC ESG Disclosure

attributes.name: osha_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Compliance Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capital project has mandatory OSHA safety compliance requirements (e.g., asbestos abatement, fall protection systems, electrical safety upgrades). Triggers safety inspection and documentation workflows.
attributes.references: OSHA Building Safety Standards; EPA Environmental Compliance; Building Engines Facility Operations

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Planned Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) Project Completion Date
attributes.description: Originally scheduled date for substantial completion of the capital project. Used for tenant coordination, COO applications, and fixed asset capitalization planning.
attributes.references: Procore Project Management; FASB ASC 360; COO Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Planned Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) Project Start Date
attributes.description: Originally scheduled start date for project construction or installation activities. Used for project scheduling, contractor mobilization planning, and tenant disruption coordination.
attributes.references: Procore Project Management; Building Engines Work Order Management

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority classification of the capital project, reflecting urgency, safety risk, regulatory compliance obligation, or strategic importance. Critical projects may involve OSHA safety compliance or COO requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA Building Safety; Building Engines Facility Operations; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: procore_project_code
attributes.description: External project identifier from Procore construction management system. Enables cross-system traceability for RFIs, submittals, change orders, and document control records associated with this CAPEX project.
attributes.references: Procore Construction and Development Project Management

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the scope of work, business justification, and expected outcome of the capital project. Supports investment committee review, LOI documentation, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Procore Document Control; FASB ASC 360; ISO 55000

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Descriptive short name for the capital project (e.g., 'HVAC Chiller Replacement — Tower A', 'Roof Membrane Renewal — Building 3'). Used in reporting dashboards, budget approvals, and fixed asset registers.
attributes.references: Procore Project Management; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable project identifier assigned at project initiation. Used across Procore, SAP S/4HANA Project Systems, and Yardi Fixed Assets for cross-system reference and audit trail. Format: CAPEX-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; Procore Project Management; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: project_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the capital project workflow. Drives approval routing, budget release, and fixed asset capitalization triggers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|in_progress|on_hold|completed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Procore Project Management; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capital project by nature of work. Determines accounting treatment, depreciation schedule, and regulatory reporting category. Tenant Improvement (TI) projects may have separate amortization rules under ASC 842. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_construction|renovation|equipment_replacement|infrastructure_upgrade|tenant_improvement|environmental_remediation|safety_compliance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; ASC 842 Lease Accounting; OSHA Building Safety; ISO 55000

attributes.name: revised_budget_amount
attributes.description: Most recent approved revision to the original project budget, reflecting change orders, scope changes, or cost escalations. Null if no revision has been approved. Supports change order management and budget variance reporting.
attributes.references: Procore Change Orders; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated useful life of the asset in years, used to calculate the annual depreciation charge upon capitalization. Set at project approval based on asset category and engineering assessment. Aligns with FASB ASC 360 and ISO 55000 asset lifecycle standards.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; ISO 55000 Asset Management; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

products.name: billable_charge
products.description: Billable maintenance charge record generated when maintenance costs are recoverable from tenants under NNN or modified gross lease structures as part of CAM reconciliation. Captures the originating work order or service contract, tenant reference, charge amount, charge category (HVAC, janitorial, repairs, landscaping), billing period, CAM pool allocation method, and invoice reference in the property management accounting system. Bridges the maintenance domain to the finance and lease domains for CAM charge-back processing.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the billing period to which this charge is allocated. Together with billing_period_start_date defines the CAM reconciliation window for this charge.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period to which this charge is allocated. Used in CAM reconciliation to match charges to the correct annual or monthly reconciliation cycle.

attributes.name: cam_allocation_method
