attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; BOMA Standards; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16

attributes.name: charge_category
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance activity type that generated this billable charge. Used for CAM pool segmentation, tenant billing transparency, and OPEX vs. CAPEX reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HVAC|janitorial|repairs|landscaping|security|electrical|plumbing|pest_control|elevator|general_maintenance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Building Engines Facility Operations; Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: charge_date
attributes.description: The principal business event date on which the billable maintenance charge was incurred or the service was rendered. Used as the basis for billing period assignment and CAM pool allocation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: charge_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable charge reference number used in tenant invoices, CAM reconciliation statements, and property management accounting systems such as Yardi Voyager AR. Format: BC-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; Building Engines

attributes.name: charge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billable charge from creation through collection or write-off. Drives workflow routing in Yardi Voyager AR and CAM reconciliation processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|invoiced|collected|disputed|written_off|voided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; Building Engines

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Distinguishes the nature of the billable charge: CAM recoverable (pooled allocation), direct tenant charge (tenant-caused damage or exclusive service), capital improvement (CAPEX), emergency response, or warranty claim. Drives GL coding and lease compliance.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Property Management; FASB ASC 842; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: cost_classification
attributes.description: Indicates whether the maintenance charge is classified as an Operating Expenditure (OPEX) or Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) per accounting policy. Critical for financial reporting, asset lifecycle tracking, and REIT compliance under FASB and IFRS standards.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IFRS 16; SAP S/4HANA Fixed Assets; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billable charge record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data governance and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tenant formally raised a dispute against this charge. Used to track dispute resolution timelines and SLA compliance for tenant relations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; Building Engines

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the tenant's stated reason for disputing this charge. Populated when charge_status is 'disputed'. Used for dispute resolution tracking and lease compliance review.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; Building Engines Tenant Service Requests

attributes.name: estimated_cam_paid
attributes.description: Total estimated CAM payments already collected from the tenant during the reconciliation period. Used to calculate the reconciliation true-up amount (over- or under-collection) at year-end.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; FASB ASC 842; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code in Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA to which this billable charge is posted. Determines the financial statement classification (revenue, expense recovery, or liability) for the charge.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager General Ledger; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; FASB; GAAP

attributes.name: gross_charge_amount
attributes.description: Total gross cost of the maintenance activity before any tenant allocation, CAM pool proration, or adjustments. Represents the full vendor invoice or internal cost amount in the property's operating currency.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tenant invoice containing this charge was issued. Used for payment due date calculation and aging analysis in Accounts Receivable.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: is_cam_reconciliation_charge
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Reconciliation Charge Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge is part of an annual CAM reconciliation adjustment (true) or a current-period direct billing (false). CAM reconciliation charges arise when actual expenses differ from estimated CAM payments collected during the year.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; FASB ASC 842; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: lease_structure_type
attributes.description: The lease structure under which this charge is recoverable from the tenant. NNN (Triple Net) leases pass through all operating expenses; modified gross leases recover specific categories; gross leases are typically non-recoverable. Determines billing eligibility.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; NAR

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for property managers to record additional context, special billing instructions, or explanatory notes related to this charge. Visible in tenant-facing CAM reconciliation statements.
attributes.references: Building Engines; Yardi Voyager Property Management

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the tenant is required to remit payment for this charge per the lease agreement terms. Used for AR aging, late fee assessment, and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: reconciliation_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal year for which the CAM reconciliation is being performed. Applicable only when is_cam_reconciliation_charge is true. Used to match reconciliation charges to the correct operating year.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which a disputed charge was resolved, either through adjustment, credit, or confirmation of the original amount. Marks the closure of the dispute lifecycle.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; Building Engines

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this billable charge record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between Building Engines CMMS and Yardi Voyager AR.
attributes.references: Building Engines; Yardi Voyager; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: source_system_charge_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this charge record in the originating source system (e.g., Building Engines charge ID or Yardi Voyager transaction ID). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and deduplication in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Building Engines; Yardi Voyager; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Applicable sales or use tax assessed on the billable maintenance charge, where required by jurisdiction. Included in the tenant invoice and tracked separately for tax remittance compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; IRS; State Tax Authorities

attributes.name: tenant_allocated_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gross charge amount allocated to the specific tenant after applying the CAM pool allocation method (pro-rata share, fixed percentage, or direct assignment). This is the net amount billed to the tenant.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; FASB ASC 842; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: tenant_pro_rata_share
attributes.description: The tenant's proportionate share of the CAM pool expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.125000 = 12.5%). Derived from the ratio of the tenant's Net Leasable Area (NLA) to the total building NLA or applicable pool area as defined in the lease.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; BOMA Standards; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: total_invoiced_amount
attributes.description: Net total amount invoiced to the tenant, equal to the tenant_allocated_amount plus tax_amount. Represents the final receivable amount recorded in Yardi Voyager AR for this charge.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: contract_asset_coverage
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between service_contract and building_asset. It captures the formal coverage relationship defining which specific building equipment assets are in scope for a given maintenance service contract. Each record links one service_contract to one building_asset and carries attributes — coverage scope, effective dates, and primary-contract designation — that exist only in the context of this specific contract-asset pairing. Operationally managed by facility managers when contracts are executed, amended, or when assets are added/removed from scope.. Existence Justification: In real estate facility management, a single service contract (e.g., an HVAC maintenance agreement) routinely covers a portfolio of specific building assets — multiple rooftop units, air handling units, and chillers — while a single building asset (e.g., a chiller) may be covered by multiple contracts over time or simultaneously by overlapping agreements (e.g., a manufacturer warranty-backed service contract AND a full-coverage HVAC contract). The business actively manages which assets are in scope for each contract, adds or removes assets when scope changes, and tracks coverage dates and primary-contract designation per asset. This is not derivable from existing FKs — the `asset_id` on `service_contract` is described as a reference to the 'primary property', not to individual equipment assets.

Supports asset lifecycle tracking and BIM integration. [Moved from service_contract: This free-text description of covered equipment on service_contract is a denormalized summary of what should be formally represented as individual contract_asset_coverage records. attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the listing agreement, used in DocuSign CLM and Salesforce CRM for cross-system reference and document tracking.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the listing agreement. Draft indicates the agreement is being prepared. Active indicates it is fully executed and in force. Expired indicates the term has lapsed without a transaction. Terminated indicates early cancellation by either party. Withdrawn indicates the property was removed from market. Closed indicates a successful transaction was completed.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the listing agreement defining the scope of brokerage authority and commission entitlement. Exclusive Right to Sell grants the broker commission regardless of who procures the buyer. Exclusive Agency allows the owner to sell without commission if they find the buyer themselves. Open Listing allows multiple brokers with commission only to the procuring broker. Net Listing pays the broker any amount above the owner's net price. Exclusive Right to Lease applies to leasing engagements.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: The total number of formal amendments executed against this listing agreement since its original execution, tracking changes to price, term, commission, or other material terms.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: broker_license_number
attributes.description: The state-issued real estate broker license number of the brokerage firm executing this listing agreement, required for regulatory compliance and agreement validity under state licensing laws.
attributes.references: State Real Estate Licensing Laws; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: broker_license_state
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code in which the broker's license is issued and under whose laws this listing agreement is governed.
attributes.references: State Real Estate Licensing Laws; ISO 3166-2

attributes.name: brokerage_side
attributes.description: Identifies the brokerage's role in the transaction: sell-side (representing the seller/landlord), buy-side (representing the buyer/tenant), lease listing (marketing a property for lease), tenant representation, or dual agency (representing both parties with disclosed consent).
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Licensing Laws

attributes.name: co_broker_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the listing agreement authorizes the listing broker to cooperate with and compensate a co-broker (buyer's agent or tenant's representative) from the total commission. True enables MLS co-broker cooperation.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Multiple Listing Service (MLS) Rules

attributes.name: co_broker_split_rate
attributes.description: The portion of the total commission allocated to the cooperating co-broker (buyer's agent), expressed as a decimal percentage of the total commission or of the transaction price, as specified in the agreement. Null when co-broker authorization is false.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Multiple Listing Service (MLS) Rules

attributes.name: commission_flat_fee
attributes.description: The agreed fixed brokerage commission amount in the agreement currency, applicable when the commission structure is a flat fee rather than a percentage. Null when a percentage-based commission rate is used.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: The agreed brokerage commission expressed as a decimal percentage of the transaction price (e.g., 0.0600 = 6.00%). Applicable when the commission structure is percentage-based. Null when a flat fee structure is used.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: commission_structure
attributes.description: Defines the method by which the brokerage commission is calculated: percentage of transaction price, flat fee, tiered based on price thresholds, or net above a reserve price (net listing).
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this listing agreement record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse, sourced from DocuSign CLM or Salesforce CRM ingestion. Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: docusign_envelope_code
attributes.description: The DocuSign CLM envelope identifier for the executed listing agreement document, enabling retrieval of the signed contract and audit trail of digital signatures.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ESIGN Act; eIDAS Regulation

attributes.name: dual_agency_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property owner has provided informed written consent for the broker to act as a dual agent, representing both the seller/landlord and the buyer/tenant in the same transaction, as required by state licensing laws.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Licensing Laws

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the listing agreement becomes legally binding and the brokerage is authorized to begin marketing the property. Corresponds to the commencement date in DocuSign CLM.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: esg_disclosure_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Disclosure Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the listing agreement requires the broker to include Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) disclosures or sustainability certifications (e.g., LEED, BREEAM, ENERGY STAR) in the property marketing materials.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) LEED; BREEAM; SEC ESG Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which all parties signed and fully executed the listing agreement via DocuSign CLM or physical signature. May differ from the effective date.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the listing agreement term ends and the brokerage authorization lapses if no transaction has been completed. Nullable for open-ended arrangements.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: last_amended_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent formal amendment to the listing agreement. Null if no amendments have been executed.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: lockbox_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property owner has authorized the broker to install a lockbox on the property to facilitate agent showings without requiring the owner to be present.

attributes.name: marketing_budget
attributes.description: The agreed marketing expenditure budget allocated for promoting the listed property, covering advertising, photography, virtual tours, signage, and digital syndication costs as specified in the listing agreement.

attributes.name: minimum_acceptable_price
attributes.description: The lowest transaction price the owner has authorized the broker to accept or present for consideration, as agreed in the listing agreement. Used to guide offer evaluation and negotiation boundaries.

attributes.name: owner_disclosure_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property owner has completed and delivered all required property disclosure statements (e.g., seller's disclosure, lead paint, environmental hazards) as mandated by applicable state and federal regulations.

attributes.name: price_reduction_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the listing agreement grants the broker authority to reduce the listing price within defined parameters without requiring a formal amendment, enabling faster market responsiveness.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: protection_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days after the listing agreement expires during which the broker retains the right to earn a commission if the property is sold or leased to a prospect introduced by the broker during the listing term. Also known as the safety clause or tail period.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); State Real Estate Licensing Laws

attributes.name: salesforce_opportunity_code
attributes.description: The Salesforce CRM Opportunity record ID associated with this listing agreement, enabling traceability from the deal pipeline stage through to agreement execution and transaction close.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: showing_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text instructions governing how and when the property may be shown to prospective buyers or tenants, including notice requirements, access restrictions, and contact protocols as specified by the owner.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this listing agreement record was ingested: DocuSign CLM (contract execution), Salesforce CRM (deal pipeline), or manual entry for legacy records.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the listing agreement was terminated prior to its scheduled expiration, whether by mutual consent, breach, or unilateral withdrawal. Null if the agreement ran to its natural expiration or closed successfully.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: termination_reason

products.name: brokerage_deal
products.description: Core transactional record representing a brokerage deal from prospect to close, sourced from Salesforce CRM opportunity pipeline. Tracks deal type (sale, lease, sublease, assignment), deal stage (prospect, LOI, under contract, due diligence, closed, dead), property reference, deal size (SF/SQM, total consideration), projected and actual close dates, probability percentage, deal source, assigned broker/agent, and exclusivity periods. Includes immutable stage transition history as child records capturing prior stage, new stage, transition timestamp, reason for change, and triggering broker — enabling pipeline velocity analysis, stage duration tracking, and CRM workflow compliance auditing. Serves as the SSOT for brokerage deal pipeline activity and deal stage audit trail across buy-side and sell-side operations.

attributes.name: controlling_area

attributes.name: cost_center_category

'opex' = Operating Expenditure (OPEX) only; 'capex' = Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) only; 'mixed' = both OPEX and CAPEX; 'overhead' = corporate overhead allocation; 'revenue' = revenue-generating center for NOI tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center_code

Used in Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA for financial allocation, NOI statements, and OPEX/CAPEX tracking. Serves as the business-facing identifier across all financial systems.

attributes.name: cost_center_description

attributes.name: cost_center_name

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Master; Yardi Voyager GL Module

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. 'active' = open for GL postings; 'inactive' = temporarily suspended; 'pending' = awaiting activation; 'closed' = permanently decommissioned; 'locked' = frozen for period-end close or audit.

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: department_code

attributes.description: Indicates whether expenses posted to this GL account are recoverable from tenants as Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges under NNN or modified gross lease structures. attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: Classifies the GL account as a primary cost element (originating costs from external postings), secondary cost element (internal cost allocations and settlements), or not applicable (for balance sheet and revenue accounts). attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this GL account record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Provides the audit trail creation timestamp for SOX compliance and data lineage tracking in the Databricks silver layer. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.description: Maps the GL account to its role in the EBITDA roll-up calculation used for investment analysis, DSCR calculations, and portfolio performance reporting. attributes.name: ifrs16_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is mapped to IFRS 16 lease accounting requirements, covering right-of-use asset recognition, lease liability measurement, depreciation of ROU assets, and interest on lease liabilities. attributes.description: Code identifying the legal entity (company code in SAP S/4HANA) to which this GL account belongs. In a multi-entity real estate portfolio, different legal entities (property-owning SPEs, management companies, REITs) may maintain separate charts of accounts or share a common chart with entity-specific account assignments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: mri_account_code
attributes.description: The corresponding account code as configured in MRI Software for investment management and residential property accounting. Supports cross-system reconciliation for portfolios managed in MRI alongside Yardi Voyager, ensuring consistent GL mapping across both property management platforms.
attributes.references: MRI Software Property Accounting Module; Real Estate Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: noi_category
attributes.description: Maps the GL account to its position in the real estate NOI waterfall: Potential Gross Income (PGI), vacancy/credit loss, Effective Gross Income (EGI), operating expense, Net Operating Income (NOI), or below-NOI items (debt service, depreciation, capital expenditures). Enables automated NOI statement generation and CAP rate calculations at property and portfolio level.
attributes.references: NCREIF PREA Reporting Standards; Argus Enterprise NOI Model; Yardi Voyager NOI Report; ULI Real Estate Finance

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account's natural (expected) balance is a debit or credit per double-entry bookkeeping rules. Assets and expenses carry a debit normal balance; liabilities, equity, and revenue carry a credit normal balance. Used by Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA to validate journal entry postings and detect sign reversals.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 942; GAAP Double-Entry Accounting; SAP S/4HANA GL; Yardi Voyager GL

attributes.name: parent_account_code
attributes.description: The account code of the immediate parent account in the GL account hierarchy. Enables roll-up of financial data from detail accounts to summary accounts for NOI statements, EBITDA roll-ups, and portfolio-level P&L reporting. Null for top-level (root) accounts in the hierarchy.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 942; SAP S/4HANA Account Hierarchy; Yardi Voyager GL Hierarchy

attributes.name: profit_center_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this GL account require a profit center assignment in SAP S/4HANA, enabling property-level and portfolio-level profitability analysis. When True, all journal entries to this account must carry a profit center (typically mapped to a property or legal entity) to support segment reporting and NOI attribution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Profit Center Accounting; FASB ASC 280 Segment Reporting; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this GL account master record was sourced: Yardi Voyager (property-level GL), SAP S/4HANA (financial consolidation), MRI Software (investment/residential accounting), or manual (directly entered in the data platform). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and master data management governance.
attributes.references: Real Estate Data Governance Standards; Databricks Silver Layer Data Lineage; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is subject to SOX Section 302/404 internal control over financial reporting (ICFR) requirements. Accounts flagged as SOX-relevant require documented controls, segregation of duties enforcement, and periodic management testing. Applicable to publicly traded REITs and their subsidiaries.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X; PCAOB Auditing Standards; FASB ASC 942

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax determination code assigned to the GL account for automated sales tax, VAT, or property tax calculation during transaction posting. Maps to the tax configuration in SAP S/4HANA and Yardi Voyager to ensure correct tax treatment on revenue and expense postings. Null for accounts not subject to tax determination.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code; SAP S/4HANA Tax Configuration; Yardi Voyager Tax Module; FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this GL account record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Tracks the latest change for SOX-compliant audit trail, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks silver layer. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); SAP S/4HANA Audit Log; Yardi Voyager Audit Trail

attributes.name: yardi_account_code
attributes.description: The corresponding account code as configured in Yardi Voyager Property Management system. Enables cross-system reconciliation between Yardi Voyager (operational source of record for property-level accounting) and SAP S/4HANA (financial consolidation system). Used for ETL mapping and data lineage tracking in the silver layer.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL Module; SAP S/4HANA Integration; Real Estate Data Governance Standards

products.name: legal_entity
products.description: Master registry of all legal entities within the real estate enterprise — including property-owning SPEs, REITs, joint-venture entities, holding companies, and operating subsidiaries. Serves as the consolidation anchor for financial reporting and SOX compliance. Attributes include entity name, entity type (REIT, LLC, LP, JV), EIN/tax ID, jurisdiction, functional currency, consolidation method, parent entity, REIT election status, and SEC reporting flag.

attributes.description: Reference to the immediate parent legal entity in the ownership hierarchy, enabling consolidation roll-ups for REIT structures, holding companies, and joint-venture entities. Null for top-level entities.

attributes.name: primary_legal_functional_currency_code_id

attributes.name: property_type_id

attributes.name: argus_entity_code
attributes.description: Entity identifier used in Argus Enterprise for valuation, cash flow modeling, and portfolio reporting. Links this legal entity to Argus DCF models and NAV calculations.

attributes.name: audit_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the most recently completed external audit period for this entity. Tracks audit cycle completion for SOX compliance monitoring and financial statement issuance scheduling.

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the independent registered public accounting firm (PCAOB-registered) responsible for auditing the entity's financial statements. Required for SOX Section 404 attestation and SEC annual report disclosures.

attributes.name: aum_usd
attributes.description: Total gross asset value (GAV) of real estate assets owned or managed by this legal entity, expressed in USD. Key metric for fund reporting, investor disclosures, and management fee calculations. Sourced from Argus Enterprise or MRI portfolio reports.

attributes.name: consolidation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method applied when consolidating this entity into parent financial statements. 'Full' for wholly-owned subsidiaries, 'proportional' for JVs, 'equity' for minority interests, 'cost' for passive investments per FASB ASC 810.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the legal entity record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements, SOX ICFR documentation, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the legal entity was formally dissolved, wound down, or deregistered. Null for active entities. Triggers cessation of financial postings and initiates final tax return filing obligations.

attributes.name: ein
attributes.description: IRS-assigned Employer Identification Number (EIN) / Federal Tax Identification Number for the entity. Required for tax filings (Form 1065, 1120-REIT, K-1), lender due diligence, and title company transactions.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRC Section 856 (REIT); ALTA Settlement

attributes.name: entity_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the legal entity across operational systems (Yardi company code, SAP company code). Used as the cross-system integration key for GL, AP, AR, and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Company Code; SAP S/4HANA Company Code (BUKRS)

attributes.name: entity_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the legal entity. Controls whether the entity is eligible for new transactions, financial postings, and regulatory filings. 'Dissolved' entities are retained for historical reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code Status; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: entity_subtype
attributes.description: Functional subclassification of the entity within the enterprise structure. Distinguishes Special Purpose Entities (SPEs) used for property ownership from operating companies, fund vehicles, and management entities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HOLDING_CO|OPERATING_CO|SPE|FUND|MANAGEMENT_CO|DEVELOPMENT_CO|FINANCE_CO|ADVISORY_CO — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 VIE; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity's organizational structure. Drives consolidation method, tax treatment, and SEC reporting obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: REIT|LLC|LP|GP|C_CORP|S_CORP|JV|TRUST|LLP|PARTNERSHIP — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810; SEC Form 10-K; IRS Entity Classification

attributes.name: fiscal_year_end_month
attributes.description: Calendar month (1–12) in which the entity's fiscal year ends. Determines the period-end close schedule, annual report filing deadlines, and tax return due dates. Most US REITs use December (12) fiscal year end.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 538; SEC Form 10-K Filing Deadlines

attributes.name: formation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the legal entity was officially formed and registered with the applicable jurisdiction. Used for entity age calculations, compliance tracking, and historical financial reporting.
attributes.references: State Secretary of State Articles of Organization/Incorporation

attributes.name: gl_company_code
attributes.description: Company code assigned to this legal entity in the General Ledger system (SAP S/4HANA BUKRS or Yardi company code). The primary integration key linking this master record to all financial transactions, journal entries, and trial balances.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code (BUKRS); Yardi Voyager GL Module

attributes.name: is_reit_elected
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Election Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entity has made a valid REIT election under IRC Section 856. REIT-elected entities must distribute at least 90% of taxable income, qualify asset and income tests, and file Form 1120-REIT annually.
attributes.references: IRC Section 856-860; SEC Form 10-K; IRS Form 1120-REIT

attributes.name: is_sec_reporting
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entity is a reporting company subject to SEC disclosure requirements (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K filings). Triggers SOX compliance obligations, XBRL tagging, and enhanced internal control requirements.
attributes.references: SEC Exchange Act Section 13; SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: is_sox_in_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entity is within scope for SOX Section 404 internal control over financial reporting (ICFR) assessments. Determines which entities require management assessment and external auditor attestation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: is_variable_interest_entity
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entity qualifies as a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) under FASB ASC 810, requiring consolidation by the primary beneficiary regardless of voting interest. Common for SPEs and certain JV structures in real estate.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810-10 Variable Interest Entities

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the legal entity record. Required for change data capture (CDC) processing in the Databricks lakehouse pipeline and SOX audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5 (data accuracy); ISO 55000

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the entity as it appears on formation documents, tax filings, and regulatory submissions (e.g., 'Acme Properties LLC', 'Acme REIT I, L.P.'). Must match state/jurisdiction registration records.
attributes.references: SEC EDGAR; IRS EIN Registration; State Secretary of State Filing

attributes.name: mri_entity_code
attributes.description: Entity identifier assigned in MRI Software for investment management and property accounting. Enables cross-system reconciliation between MRI and SAP/Yardi financial records.
attributes.references: MRI Software Investment Management Module

attributes.name: nav_usd
attributes.description: Net Asset Value of the entity calculated as total assets minus total liabilities, expressed in USD. Primary valuation metric for REIT and fund entities used in investor reporting, unit pricing, and performance benchmarking per INREV/NCREIF guidelines.
attributes.references: INREV NAV Guidelines; NCREIF; FASB ASC 946; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the legal entity owned by the immediate parent entity, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 100.00 for wholly-owned, 50.00 for 50/50 JV). Drives consolidation thresholds and minority interest calculations under FASB ASC 810.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 3A-02

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the primary contact for the entity. Used for regulatory notifications, audit correspondence, and financial reporting communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact or authorized representative for the entity, typically the CFO, Controller, or Asset Manager responsible for financial reporting and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 Certifying Officer; SEC Exchange Act

attributes.name: registered_address_city
attributes.description: City of the entity's official registered address. Required for state tax filings, regulatory submissions, and legal service of process.
attributes.references: State Secretary of State; IRS EIN Registration

attributes.name: registered_address_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the entity's official registered address. Distinguishes domestic US entities from foreign subsidiaries requiring FBAR and FATCA reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IRS FATCA; FinCEN FBAR

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the entity's official registered address as filed with the state Secretary of State and IRS. Used for legal notices, regulatory correspondence, and title company communications.
attributes.references: State Secretary of State; IRS EIN Registration; ALTA

attributes.name: registered_address_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the entity's official registered address. Used for tax jurisdiction determination and regulatory correspondence routing.
attributes.references: USPS; IRS EIN Registration

attributes.name: registered_address_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the entity's official registered address. May differ from the formation jurisdiction for entities with a registered agent in a different state.
attributes.references: State Secretary of State; USPS State Abbreviations

attributes.name: registered_agent_name
attributes.description: Name of the entity's designated registered agent responsible for receiving legal service of process, state notices, and annual report reminders on behalf of the entity.
attributes.references: State Secretary of State; Uniform Business Organizations Code

attributes.name: state_registration_number
attributes.description: State-issued entity registration or charter number assigned by the Secretary of State in the jurisdiction of formation. Used for state tax filings, good-standing certificates, and title searches.
attributes.references: State Secretary of State; ALTA Title Standards

attributes.name: state_tax_nexus
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of two-letter US state codes where the entity has established tax nexus through property ownership, operations, or employee presence. Drives multi-state apportionment and state tax filing obligations.

attributes.name: tax_classification
attributes.description: IRS federal tax classification of the entity for income tax purposes. Determines the applicable tax return form (1120-REIT, 1065, Schedule C) and pass-through treatment for investors.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8832; IRC Section 856; IRS Check-the-Box Regulations

attributes.name: tax_year_end_month
attributes.description: Calendar month (1–12) in which the entity's tax year ends, which may differ from the fiscal year end for certain partnership structures. Drives K-1 issuance timing and estimated tax payment schedules.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 538; IRC Section 441

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Operating or 'doing business as' (DBA) name used in commercial transactions, marketing, and tenant-facing communications when different from the registered legal name.
attributes.references: State DBA Registration; NAR Business Practices

attributes.name: yardi_entity_code

Attributes include journal entry number, posting date, period, document type, source system, approval status, reversal flag, and per-line: debit/credit indicator, amount, functional currency amount, GL account, cost center, property reference, profit center, segment, tax code, and line description.

attributes.name: functional_currency_code

attributes.name: functional_debit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all debit line item amounts translated to the functional currency using the exchange_rate. Used for financial statement preparation, NOI reporting, and EBITDA roll-ups in the entity's reporting currency.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA Parallel Currency; Yardi Voyager GL

attributes.name: header_text

attributes.name: intercompany_partner_code

attributes.name: is_reversal

attributes.name: noi_category

Categorizes postings as revenue (rental income, CAM recoveries), operating expense (property OPEX), capital expenditure (CAPEX), below-NOI items, or non-operating. Drives property-level NOI reporting and CAP Rate analysis.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the General Ledger (GL). Determines the accounting period in which the transaction is recognized. Distinct from the document date and value date. Maps to SAP BKPF-BUDAT.

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit code controlling the debit/credit indicator, account type, and field selection for the journal entry posting. Maps to SAP posting key (BSEG-BSCHL). Common values include 40 (GL debit), 50 (GL credit), 01 (customer invoice), 31 (vendor invoice).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Posting Key; Yardi Voyager Posting Rules; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number linking this journal entry to a related business document such as a lease agreement, invoice, purchase order, or contract. Supports cross-document traceability and audit trail. Maps to SAP BKPF-XBLNR.

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: source_system_ref

attributes.name: tax_code

attributes.name: total_debit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all debit line item amounts in the transaction currency for this journal entry. Must equal total_credit_amount for the entry to be balanced per double-entry bookkeeping principles. Used for entry-level validation and reconciliation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: is_recurring

attributes.name: is_void

attributes.name: net_amount

attributes.name: paid_amount

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment was issued to the vendor. Used for cash flow reporting, vendor aging analysis, and DSCR calculations at the property level.

attributes.name: payment_method

attributes.name: payment_number

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: posting_date

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was physically or electronically received by the accounts payable department. Used to calculate processing cycle time and aging from receipt.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA AP

attributes.name: service_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the service period covered by this invoice. Used alongside service_period_start for accrual-basis expense recognition and period-over-period reporting.

attributes.name: service_period_start

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA AP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: source_system_invoice_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or unique identifier of this invoice record in the originating source system (Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA). Enables traceability from the Silver layer back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA AP; Data Lineage Best Practices

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax component of the invoice including sales tax, use tax, or VAT as applicable. Separated for tax reporting, input tax recovery, and compliance with tax authorities.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why the invoice was voided. Required for SOX audit trail and AP quality control reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Yardi Voyager AP Module

attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Workflow

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the individual who authorized this payment for disbursement. Required for SOX-compliant audit trails and segregation of duties documentation. Captures the approver at time of authorization.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Workflow

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment was approved for disbursement. Used for SOX audit trails, approval turnaround time analysis, and segregation of duties compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Workflow

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing transit number of the vendor's receiving bank account. Required for ACH and wire payment processing. Stored for remittance and payment audit purposes. Classified confidential as it is a banking identifier.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Physical or laser-printed check number for check-based payments. Null for ACH, wire, or virtual card payments. Used for positive pay file submission to the bank and check register reconciliation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; NACHA Positive Pay Standards

attributes.name: cleared_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payment was confirmed as settled/cleared by the bank (i.e., funds debited from the company bank account and confirmed received). Used for bank reconciliation, outstanding check aging, and cash position reporting. Null until cleared.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this AP payment record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and record-level change tracking. Populated by the ingestion pipeline at load time.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: discount_taken_amount
attributes.description: Early-payment discount amount deducted from the invoice balance at time of payment (e.g., 2/10 net 30 terms). Reduces the net cash disbursed and is tracked separately for GL posting to discount income accounts.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; FASB ASC 450

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied at the time of payment to convert the transaction currency amount to the functional (base) currency. Applicable for cross-border vendor payments. Stored for audit and financial consolidation purposes per FASB ASC 830.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; IASB IAS 21

attributes.name: expense_category
attributes.description: High-level expense classification for financial reporting and NOI analysis. 'opex' = Operating Expenditure (OPEX) for property operations; 'capex' = Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) for improvements; 'ti' = Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance; 'cam' = Common Area Maintenance (CAM) expense; 'debt_service' = mortgage or loan payment; 'tax' = property tax; 'insurance' = property insurance premium. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: opex|capex|ti|cam|debt_service|tax|insurance — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; FASB ASC 840/842; NAR Standards; NCREIF

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Accounting fiscal period (YYYY-MM format) to which this payment is attributed for financial reporting. Derived from gl_posting_date but stored explicitly to support period-based filtering, NOI period reporting, and budget-vs-actual variance analysis.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; FASB ASC 230; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Payment amount expressed in the entity's functional (base) currency after applying the exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting, NOI statements, and EBITDA roll-ups across multi-currency portfolios.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; IASB IAS 21

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which this payment is posted to the General Ledger. May differ from payment_date due to period-close cutoffs or accrual adjustments. Determines the accounting period for financial reporting and SOX-compliant period-end close.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager GL Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; FASB ASC 230; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_1099_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is subject to IRS Form 1099 reporting requirements. True = payment must be included in annual 1099 filing for the vendor. Determined by vendor tax classification and payment type.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-MISC; IRS Form 1099-NEC; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP

attributes.name: is_partial_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment represents a partial settlement of the associated invoice(s) rather than full payment. True = partial payment; False = full payment. Used for open invoice aging and vendor statement reconciliation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP

attributes.name: is_voided
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment has been voided (cancelled after issuance but before or after clearing). True = payment is voided and should be excluded from cash disbursement totals. Used for audit trails and reissuance tracking.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Actual net cash disbursed to the vendor after deducting any early-payment discounts or adjustments from the gross payment amount. Equals payment_amount minus discount_taken_amount. Used for bank reconciliation and cash management reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount disbursed to the vendor in the transaction currency. Represents the total funds transferred, before any discount adjustments. Core monetary field for AP cash disbursement reporting and DSCR calculations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; FASB ASC 230; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The principal business event date on which the payment was issued or disbursed to the vendor. For checks, this is the check date; for ACH/wire, this is the value date. Used for cash flow reporting and period-close cutoff.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; FASB ASC 230; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_memo
attributes.description: Free-text memo or description associated with the payment, as entered by the AP processor. Appears on check stubs, ACH addenda records, or wire instructions. Used for vendor communication and internal reference.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; NACHA CCD+ Addenda Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The instrument or mechanism used to disburse funds to the vendor. 'check' = physical or laser-printed check; 'ach' = Automated Clearing House electronic transfer; 'wire' = same-day wire transfer; 'virtual_card' = single-use virtual credit card; 'eft' = generic electronic funds transfer.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable payment reference number assigned by the source system (e.g., Yardi check number or SAP payment document number). Used for reconciliation, audit trails, and vendor remittance advice.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the AP payment. 'pending' = approved but not yet disbursed; 'issued' = check printed or ACH/wire initiated; 'cleared' = confirmed settled by bank; 'voided' = cancelled before clearing; 'stopped' = stop-payment placed; 'returned' = ACH/wire returned by receiving bank.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Business classification of the payment purpose. 'vendor_payment' = standard operating expense vendor; 'ti_allowance' = Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance disbursement to tenant or contractor; 'construction_draw' = CAPEX draw for development/renovation; 'security_deposit_refund' = return of tenant security deposit; 'owner_distribution' = distribution to property owner; 'corporate_payable' = non-property corporate expense. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vendor_payment|ti_allowance|construction_draw|security_deposit_refund|owner_distribution|corporate_payable — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: positive_pay_submitted

attributes.name: remittance_advice_number

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this payment record originated. Used for data lineage, reconciliation between systems, and Silver Layer provenance tracking. Supports multi-system consolidation across Yardi Voyager and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; MRI Software; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_payment_code
attributes.description: Native payment identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Yardi Voyager internal payment key or SAP FI document number). Preserved for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage, and drill-back to the operational system of record.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The bank value date on which funds are available to the recipient. For ACH payments, this is the settlement date (typically T+1 or T+2). For wires, this is the same-day settlement date. Distinct from payment_date (initiation) and cleared_date (confirmation).

attributes.name: void_date

attributes.name: void_reason

attributes.name: withholding_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from the vendor payment for backup withholding, retention, or tax withholding purposes. Common in construction contracts (retention holdback) and for 1099-reportable vendors subject to IRS backup withholding. Reduces net disbursement.

attributes.name: billing_period_end
attributes.description: Last day of the billing period covered by this invoice. Together with billing_period_start defines the service period for revenue recognition and CAM reconciliation.

attributes.name: billing_period_start

attributes.name: breakpoint_amount

attributes.name: cam_reconciliation_year

attributes.name: credit_memo_reference

attributes.name: days_past_due

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date on which the invoice dispute was formally raised. Used to track dispute resolution SLAs and tenant relationship metrics.

attributes.name: dispute_reason

attributes.name: capex_reserve
attributes.description: Capital expenditure reserve amount set aside for the reporting period for major building improvements, replacements, and non-recurring capital items. Deducted from NOI to arrive at AFFO in REIT reporting.
attributes.references: NAREIT AFFO Definition; Appraisal Institute; ISO 55000 Asset Management; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: concessions
attributes.description: Monetary value of rent-free periods, move-in incentives, and other lease concessions granted to tenants during the reporting period. Expressed as a positive deduction from PGI in the income waterfall.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this NOI statement record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Provides the audit trail for record provenance and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Internal Data Governance Policy; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: credit_loss
attributes.description: Revenue lost due to tenant non-payment, bad debt write-offs, and collection shortfalls during the reporting period. Expressed as a positive deduction from PGI. Sourced from Yardi Voyager AR aging.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Appraisal Institute Income Approach; Yardi Voyager AR

attributes.name: debt_service
attributes.description: Total principal and interest payments on property-level debt obligations for the reporting period. Used as the denominator in DSCR calculations. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA loan schedules.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; CMBS/RMBS Reporting Standards; SAP S/4HANA; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: dscr
attributes.description: Debt Service Coverage Ratio — NOI divided by total debt service for the reporting period (NOI / Debt Service). A DSCR below 1.0 indicates the property does not generate sufficient income to cover debt obligations. Critical for lender covenant compliance and CMBS reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; CMBS Reporting Standards; SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: egi
attributes.description: Effective Gross Income — PGI minus vacancy loss, credit loss, and concessions, plus other income. Represents the actual income collected or collectible from the property. Core input for NOI and CAP rate calculations.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number within the fiscal year (1–12 for monthly, 1–4 for quarterly). Enables period-over-period variance analysis and WALE/WALT calculations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager General Ledger; SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this NOI statement belongs (e.g., 2024). Used for annual roll-up, budget comparison, and SEC/REIT regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: gla_sqft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Leasable Area (GLA) in Square Feet (SQF)
attributes.description: Total Gross Leasable Area of the property in square feet as of the reporting period. Used to calculate PSF metrics (NOI PSF, rent PSF) for benchmarking and CAP rate analysis.
attributes.references: BOMA International Measurement Standards; RESO Data Dictionary; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: implied_property_value
attributes.description: Estimated property value derived by dividing NOI by the applied CAP rate (NOI / CAP Rate). Used for investor reporting, portfolio NAV calculations, and REIT asset valuations. Not a formal appraisal value.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: insurance_expense
attributes.description: Property and casualty insurance premiums allocated to the reporting period. Includes building, liability, and any specialized coverage (flood, earthquake). Component of total operating expenses.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; Yardi Voyager AP; OSHA

attributes.name: is_consolidated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NOI statement represents a consolidated multi-property or portfolio-level roll-up (True) versus a single-property statement (False). Drives aggregation logic in SAP S/4HANA financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation; FASB ASC 810; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: leasing_commission_expense
attributes.description: Brokerage leasing commissions paid or accrued during the reporting period for new leases and renewals. Tracked separately for AFFO adjustments and amortized per FASB ASC 842 straight-line requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; NAREIT AFFO Definition; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: management_fee_expense
attributes.description: Fee paid to the property manager (PM) for operational management services, typically calculated as a percentage of EGI or collected rents. Key line item for NOI sensitivity and management contract evaluation.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; Yardi Voyager Property Management; NAR

attributes.name: management_fee_rate
attributes.description: Management fee expressed as a decimal percentage of EGI or collected rents (e.g., 0.0400 = 4.00%). Used to validate the management_fee_expense calculation and benchmark against market rates.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; NAR; Yardi Voyager Property Management

attributes.name: noi
attributes.description: Net Operating Income — EGI minus total operating expenses. The primary measure of a property's income-generating performance before debt service, capital expenditures, depreciation, and income taxes. Authoritative input for CAP rate valuation and DSCR calculations.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 842; NAREIT; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: noi_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Operating Income Per Square Foot (NOI PSF)
attributes.description: NOI divided by GLA in square feet, expressed as a per-square-foot metric. Industry-standard benchmark for comparing property performance across the portfolio and against market comparables.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; CoStar Suite; NAREIT

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative notes from the asset manager or finance team providing context for unusual variances, one-time items, or material events affecting the NOI statement for the reporting period.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC IVS 105; Internal Financial Reporting Policy

attributes.name: occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of total leasable area that is occupied and generating rent during the reporting period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9200 = 92.00%). Complement of vacancy rate; used in investor dashboards and REIT disclosures.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; NAREIT; CoStar Suite; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: period_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency granularity of this NOI statement — monthly for operational monitoring, quarterly for investor reporting, annual for REIT filings, year-to-date for cumulative tracking, or trailing 12 months for CAP rate valuation.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; NAREIT FFO/AFFO Reporting Guidelines; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: pgi
attributes.description: Potential Gross Income — the maximum theoretical rental revenue achievable if the property were 100% occupied at market rents for the full reporting period. Top line of the NOI income waterfall. Sourced from Yardi Voyager lease schedules.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: property_tax_expense
attributes.description: Real estate tax and special assessment charges levied on the property for the reporting period. A primary component of operating expenses and a key driver of NOI sensitivity analysis.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; HUD; Yardi Voyager AP

attributes.name: repairs_maintenance_expense
attributes.description: Costs for routine repairs, preventive maintenance, and non-capital building upkeep during the reporting period. Sourced from Building Engines work orders and Yardi Voyager AP. Component of total operating expenses.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Appraisal Institute; Yardi Voyager AP; Building Engines

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the financial reporting period covered by this NOI statement (e.g., 2024-01-31 for a January monthly statement).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
attributes.description: First calendar date of the financial reporting period covered by this NOI statement (e.g., 2024-01-01 for a January monthly statement).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: restatement_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why a previously published NOI statement was restated. Required when statement_status is 'restated'. Supports SOX audit trail and SEC disclosure requirements for material restatements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this NOI statement data was sourced (e.g., Yardi Voyager for property-level actuals, Argus Enterprise for budget/forecast, SAP S/4HANA for consolidated financials, or manual for off-system entries).
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this NOI statement, formatted as NOI-YYYY-MM-PropertyCode. Used in investor reports, audit trails, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the NOI statement. Draft indicates work-in-progress; under_review is pending approval; approved is finalized; published is distributed to investors; restated indicates a prior-period correction; voided is cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|under_review|approved|published|restated|voided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 842; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: statement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the statement as actual reported results, approved budget, current forecast, reforecast, or prior-year actual for variance analysis. Drives how the statement is consumed in Argus Enterprise and investor reporting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: ti_allowance
attributes.description: Tenant Improvement allowance costs incurred or accrued during the reporting period for build-out and fit-out of leased spaces. Impacts AFFO calculations and is tracked separately from operating expenses per FASB ASC 842.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; NAREIT AFFO Definition; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: total_operating_expenses
attributes.description: Sum of all property-level operating expenditures for the reporting period, including management fees, repairs and maintenance, insurance, property taxes, utilities, and administrative costs. Deducted from EGI to arrive at NOI.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; FASB ASC 842; SOX

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this NOI statement record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Tracks restatements, corrections, and re-approvals for audit and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Internal Data Governance Policy; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: utilities_expense
attributes.description: Landlord-paid utility costs for the reporting period including electricity, gas, water, sewer, and trash removal for common areas and vacant spaces. Component of total operating expenses.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; EPA Environmental Compliance; Yardi Voyager AP

attributes.name: vacancy_loss
attributes.description: Revenue lost due to unoccupied units or spaces during the reporting period. Expressed as a positive deduction from PGI. Includes both physical vacancy and economic vacancy from lease-up periods.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; IVSC IVS 105; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: vacancy_rate
attributes.description: Physical vacancy rate for the property during the reporting period, expressed as a decimal percentage of total leasable area that is unoccupied (e.g., 0.0800 = 8.00%). Key driver of PGI-to-EGI waterfall.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute Income Approach; RESO Data Dictionary; CoStar Suite

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Fixed asset register for all capitalized real estate assets including buildings, land improvements, tenant improvements (TI), HVAC systems, and capital equipment. Supports CAPEX tracking, depreciation schedules, and FASB ASC 360 asset impairment testing. Sourced from Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets and SAP S/4HANA FA. Attributes include asset number, asset description, asset class, property reference, acquisition date, acquisition cost, useful life, depreciation method, accumulated depreciation, net book value, disposal date, and disposal proceeds.
products.reference: Fixed Asset — SAP S/4HANA FI-AA / Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets
