attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense charged against this asset from the in-service date through the current reporting period. Contra-asset balance used to compute net book value.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total capitalized cost of the fixed asset at the time of acquisition, including purchase price, transaction costs, and any costs necessary to bring the asset to its intended use. Represents the gross book value before depreciation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IFRS 16; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fixed asset was acquired, purchased, or placed in service. This is the capitalization date used as the start point for depreciation calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IRS Publication 946; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Classification of the fixed asset into a standardized category that governs depreciation method and useful life defaults. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: building|land|land_improvement|tenant_improvement|hvac_system|capital_equipment|furniture_fixtures|leasehold_improvement|infrastructure|intangible — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA Asset Class Configuration; IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the fixed asset, such as 'HVAC Rooftop Unit — Building A' or 'Lobby Renovation — Tenant Improvement Suite 400'. Used for identification in financial reports and audits.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: asset_location
attributes.description: Physical location of the asset within the property, such as building name, floor, suite, or room number (e.g., 'Building A — Floor 3 — Mechanical Room'). Supports physical inventory verification.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset indicating its operational and accounting state. 'under_construction' applies to assets in the Assets Under Construction (AUC) stage prior to capitalization.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: asset_sub_class
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing finer granularity within an asset class, such as 'Mechanical' or 'Electrical' within the HVAC class, or 'Structural' within Building. Supports detailed CAPEX reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: asset_tag
attributes.description: Physical barcode or RFID tag number affixed to the asset for inventory tracking and physical verification during annual fixed asset audits.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: book_tax_difference
attributes.description: Cumulative difference between book depreciation and tax depreciation for this asset, representing the temporary timing difference used in deferred tax calculations under FASB ASC 740.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fixed asset record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in compliance with SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: depreciation_convention
attributes.description: Timing convention applied to the first and last year of depreciation, determining how much depreciation is taken in the year of acquisition and disposal. Relevant for MACRS and book depreciation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946; FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to allocate the cost of the asset over its useful life. 'macrs' refers to the Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery System used for US tax depreciation. Land assets use 'no_depreciation'.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IRS Publication 946; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fixed asset was disposed of, sold, scrapped, or retired from service. Triggers the recognition of any gain or loss on disposal in the GL.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method by which the fixed asset was removed from the asset register. Determines the accounting treatment for the disposal transaction.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Net cash proceeds received upon disposal or sale of the fixed asset. Used to calculate the gain or loss on disposal (disposal_proceeds minus net_book_value at disposal date).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: impairment_loss
attributes.description: Cumulative impairment charge recognized against this asset when its carrying amount exceeds its recoverable amount per FASB ASC 360 impairment testing. Reduces net book value below the normal depreciation schedule.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Impairment Testing; IFRS IAS 36; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: impairment_test_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent FASB ASC 360 impairment test was performed for this asset. Required for SOX compliance documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; IFRS IAS 36

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was placed into active service and depreciation commenced. May differ from acquisition_date for assets under construction that are capitalized upon completion.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IRS Publication 946; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Reference to the property or equipment insurance policy covering this fixed asset. Required for insurance claims processing and risk management reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Real Estate Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: insured_value
attributes.description: Replacement cost or insured value of the fixed asset as declared on the insurance policy. May differ from net book value and is used for insurance adequacy reviews.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; ALTA American Land Title Association

attributes.name: leed_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset or the improvement it represents has achieved LEED certification from the U.S. Green Building Council. Supports ESG reporting and green building compliance tracking.
attributes.references: USGBC LEED Certification Standards; EPA Environmental Compliance; ESG Reporting

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the fixed asset on the balance sheet, calculated as acquisition_cost minus accumulated_depreciation minus any impairment charges. Represents the asset's accounting value at the reporting date.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IFRS 16; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number associated with the acquisition of this fixed asset. Links the asset to the originating procurement transaction for three-way match and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; Yardi Voyager AP

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. Used in straight-line depreciation calculations as the floor below which book value is not depreciated.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IRS Publication 946; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number for equipment and mechanical assets such as HVAC units, elevators, and generators. Used for warranty tracking and maintenance records.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Building Engines Facility Operations

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this fixed asset record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets and SAP S/4HANA FI-AA.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_asset_code
attributes.description: Native asset identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Yardi asset number or SAP asset master number). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; Yardi Voyager Fixed Assets

attributes.name: tax_depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation method applied for US federal income tax purposes, which may differ from the book depreciation method. MACRS and bonus depreciation are common for real estate capital assets.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946; FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: tax_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Useful life assigned to the asset for tax depreciation purposes under IRS MACRS or ADS rules. May differ from the book useful_life_years used for GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946; FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fixed asset record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change data capture, incremental loads, and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated useful economic life of the asset in years, used to calculate straight-line and other depreciation schedules. Determined per asset class per FASB ASC 360 and IRS guidelines.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; IRS Publication 946; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the vendor, contractor, or supplier from whom the asset was acquired or who performed the capital improvement. Supports AP reconciliation and vendor spend analysis.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA Procurement

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer or contractor warranty for this asset expires. Used to trigger preventive maintenance scheduling and warranty claim management before expiry.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Building Engines Facility Operations

attributes.name: ytd_depreciation
attributes.description: Depreciation expense charged against this asset in the current fiscal year to date. Used for period-end financial reporting and budget-to-actual CAPEX variance analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

products.name: bank_account

Supports cash position monitoring and bank reconciliation. Attributes include account number (masked), bank name, bank routing number, account type (operating, escrow, security deposit, reserve), currency, property or entity reference, account status, and signatory details.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id

attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — GL Account Mapping; SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center associated with this bank account for financial reporting and expense allocation. Supports property-level and portfolio-level P&L reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Accounting; Yardi Voyager Cost Center

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: RE bank accounts for international properties are domiciled in specific countries for AML compliance, FATF reporting, foreign ownership regulations, and withholding tax determination. Replaces denorma

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity (corporate entity, SPE, or ownership structure) that holds this bank account. Supports multi-entity financial consolidation in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Company Code; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment portfolio this bank account is associated with. Supports portfolio-level cash management and Assets Under Management (AUM) reporting.
attributes.references: MRI Software — Investment Management; Argus Enterprise Portfolio Reporting

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Official name of the bank account as registered with the financial institution. Typically reflects the legal entity or property name (e.g., 'Acme Realty LLC — Operating Account').
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Account Setup; SAP S/4HANA House Bank

attributes.name: account_number_masked
attributes.description: Masked bank account number retaining only the last four digits for display and reconciliation purposes. Full account number must not be stored in the lakehouse per PCI-DSS controls. Format: XXXX1234.
attributes.references: PCI-DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: account_purpose
attributes.description: Specific operational purpose of the bank account within the real estate business. Provides finer-grained classification beyond account_type for cash management and reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rent_collection|vendor_disbursement|payroll|tax_escrow|insurance_escrow|capital_reserve|tenant_security_deposit|loan_proceeds|construction_draw|intercompany — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Cash Management; FASB ASC 230 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bank account. Active accounts are available for transactions; frozen accounts are temporarily restricted by the bank or internal controls; closed accounts are permanently decommissioned; pending_approval accounts are awaiting authorization before activation.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Account Status; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bank account by its designated business purpose. Operating accounts handle day-to-day receipts and disbursements; escrow accounts hold funds pending transaction close; security deposit accounts hold tenant security deposits per statutory requirements; reserve accounts hold capital reserve funds; payroll accounts fund employee compensation; construction accounts fund development draws.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Account Type; ASC 842; FASB ASC 230 Cash Flow Statement

attributes.name: ach_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Automated Clearing House (ACH) electronic payments are enabled for this bank account. Supports automated rent collection and vendor disbursement workflows.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; Yardi Voyager — ACH Setup

attributes.name: balance_as_of_date
attributes.description: The effective date of the current_balance figure. Indicates the point in time to which the reported balance applies, enabling accurate cash position reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Cash Management; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: bank_branch_address
attributes.description: Street address of the bank branch where the account is held. Used for official correspondence and audit documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: bank_branch_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific bank branch where the account is domiciled. Used for correspondence and relationship management with the banking institution.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Setup

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the financial institution where the account is held (e.g., 'JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.'). Used for bank reconciliation reporting and counterparty risk management.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Setup; SAP S/4HANA House Bank

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit American Bankers Association (ABA) routing transit number identifying the financial institution for ACH and wire transfer transactions. Classified confidential as it enables payment initiation.
attributes.references: ABA Routing Number Standard; NACHA ACH Operating Rules; PCI-DSS v4.0

attributes.name: bank_statement_delivery
attributes.description: Method by which bank statements are delivered for this account. Electronic statements are imported directly into Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA for automated reconciliation; paper statements require manual processing.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Reconciliation; SAP S/4HANA Bank Statement Processing (FF_5)

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bank account was closed or decommissioned. Null for active accounts. Required for account lifecycle management and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Account Setup; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank account record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: Most recently confirmed ledger balance of the bank account as of the last reconciliation or bank statement date. Used for cash position monitoring and liquidity management. Not a calculated aggregate — represents the point-in-time balance from the source system.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Cash Management; SAP S/4HANA Cash and Liquidity Management; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: dual_signature_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions on this account require dual authorization (two signatories). True for accounts with high transaction thresholds or escrow accounts per SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; Yardi Voyager Authorization Controls

attributes.name: house_bank_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA House Bank identifier representing the bank-level grouping under which this account is configured. Used for payment program configuration and bank statement processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — House Bank Configuration (FI12); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) for accounts held at international financial institutions. Required for cross-border wire transfers and EU/UK regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 13616 IBAN Standard; EU Payment Services Directive (PSD2)

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applicable to the bank account balance, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.045000 for 4.5%). Applicable for interest-bearing accounts such as money market or reserve accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Treasury and Risk Management; Yardi Voyager Bank Setup

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank account is used for intercompany transactions between related legal entities within the portfolio. Supports intercompany elimination in financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Reconciliation; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_reconciled_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent completed bank reconciliation for this account. Critical for SOX-compliant financial controls and cash position accuracy monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404; Yardi Voyager Bank Reconciliation Module; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: lockbox_number
attributes.description: Bank-assigned lockbox number for accounts configured to receive tenant rent payments via lockbox processing. Enables automated AR cash application in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Lockbox Processing; NACHA ACH Operating Rules

attributes.name: minimum_balance
attributes.description: Minimum balance required to be maintained in the account per bank agreement or internal policy (e.g., compensating balance requirements for credit facilities). Triggers alerts when balance falls below threshold.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Cash Management; SAP S/4HANA House Bank Agreement

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bank account was officially opened with the financial institution. Used for account lifecycle tracking and audit trail.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Account Setup; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: overdraft_limit
attributes.description: Maximum overdraft facility approved by the bank for this account. Zero or null if no overdraft facility exists. Used in cash management and liquidity risk monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cash and Liquidity Management; Yardi Voyager Bank Setup

attributes.name: positive_pay_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is enrolled in the bank's Positive Pay fraud prevention service, which validates issued checks against a transmitted file before clearing. Critical for AP disbursement fraud controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Fraud Controls; Yardi Voyager — Positive Pay

attributes.name: reconciliation_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency at which this bank account must be reconciled per internal controls policy. Drives automated reconciliation scheduling in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; Yardi Voyager Bank Reconciliation

attributes.name: ref
attributes.description: Internal reference code or short identifier assigned to this bank account within Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA for use in GL postings, bank reconciliation, and reporting. Distinct from the masked account number.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Account Code; SAP S/4HANA House Bank Account ID

attributes.name: swift_code
attributes.description: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Business Identifier Code (BIC) for the bank. Required for international wire transfers. Applicable for accounts at institutions with international operations.
attributes.references: ISO 9362 — BIC Standard; SWIFT Network Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this bank account record. Used for change data capture, audit trail, and SOX-compliant record management.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: wire_transfer_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether outgoing wire transfers are enabled for this bank account. Controls payment method availability in AP disbursement workflows.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Payment Processing; SAP S/4HANA Payment Methods

attributes.name: yardi_bank_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this bank account record in Yardi Voyager. Used for data lineage, reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system, and audit traceability.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager — Bank Account Setup; Data Governance Lineage Standard

products.name: debt_instrument
products.description: Master registry of all property-level and portfolio-level debt instruments — mortgages, construction loans, mezzanine debt, CMBS, and credit facilities — with embedded debt service payment history. Supports LTV monitoring, DSCR covenant tracking, amortization schedules, and lender reporting. Attributes include loan number, lender, loan type, original principal, outstanding balance, interest rate, rate type (fixed/variable), maturity date, LTV ratio, DSCR covenant threshold, collateral property reference, and per-payment: scheduled/actual principal and interest amounts, payment date, payment status, outstanding balance after payment, escrow amount, and late fees.
products.reference: Loan / Debt Instrument — Yardi Voyager Debt Management / SAP S/4HANA TRM

attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger (GL) account used to record the debt liability on the balance sheet. Ensures proper financial consolidation in SAP S/4HANA and SOX-compliant financial controls.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA GL standards

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for this debt instrument for financial reporting and budget allocation purposes within SAP S/4HANA and Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: currency_code_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Debt instruments (mortgages, construction loans, credit facilities) are obligations of a specific legal entity in the real estate enterprise. The debt_instrument product currently has no FK to legal_e
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lender_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: amortization_period_months
attributes.description: Total number of months over which the loan principal is amortized for payment calculation purposes. May differ from the loan term for balloon loans (e.g., 30-year amortization with 10-year balloon).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: amortization_type
attributes.description: Describes the principal repayment structure of the debt instrument. Fully amortizing loans retire principal over the term; interest-only loans defer principal to maturity; balloon loans have a large final payment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; CMBS industry standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this debt instrument record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX Section 302/404 and data governance lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 5 data integrity

attributes.name: cross_collateralized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this debt instrument is cross-collateralized with other properties or loans, meaning multiple properties secure the same debt obligation. Impacts disposition and refinancing strategies.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; CMBS industry standards

attributes.name: debt_issuance_costs
attributes.description: Total capitalized costs incurred to obtain the debt financing including legal fees, title insurance, appraisal fees, and origination fees. Presented as a direct deduction from the carrying amount of the debt per FASB ASC 835-30.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 835-30 Debt Issuance Costs; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: dscr_covenant_threshold
attributes.business_glossary_term: Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) Covenant Threshold
attributes.description: Minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) required under the loan agreement. DSCR is Net Operating Income (NOI) divided by total debt service. Breach triggers lender notification and potential cash trap provisions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X for REITs

attributes.name: escrow_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender requires the borrower to maintain escrow accounts for taxes, insurance, and/or capital reserves as a condition of the loan.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; HUD escrow requirements

attributes.name: extended_maturity_date
attributes.description: Revised maturity date if the borrower has exercised an extension option under the loan agreement. Null if no extension has been exercised.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: guarantor_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity or individual providing a personal or corporate guarantee on the debt instrument. Applicable for recourse and partial-recourse loans. Required for credit risk and exposure reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 460 Guarantees; FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: instrument_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the debt instrument. Drives covenant monitoring workflows, lender reporting, and portfolio risk dashboards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|paid_off|in_default|in_foreclosure|refinanced|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; SEC Regulation S-X for REIT disclosures

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Classification of the debt instrument by its structural form. Determines applicable accounting treatment, covenant structures, and reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mortgage|construction_loan|mezzanine_debt|cmbs|credit_facility|bridge_loan — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; CMBS industry standards; IVSC Valuation Standards

attributes.name: interest_only_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the interest-only period expires and principal amortization payments commence. Applicable for hybrid and partial-amortization instruments. Null for fully amortizing loans.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applicable to the debt instrument expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.065000 for 6.5%). For variable-rate instruments, reflects the current all-in rate including spread over the index.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: loan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by the lender to this debt instrument. Used for lender correspondence, covenant reporting, and CMBS/RMBS pool identification. Maps to the loan reference number in Yardi Voyager Debt Management and SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement standards

attributes.name: loan_term_months
attributes.description: Contractual duration of the debt instrument in months from origination to scheduled maturity. Used for debt maturity ladder analysis and refinancing pipeline planning.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: ltv_covenant_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio permitted under the loan agreement before a covenant breach is triggered. Drives automated covenant monitoring alerts and lender notification workflows.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; SOX Section 302/404 financial controls

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio calculated as outstanding principal balance divided by the appraised or market value of the collateral property. Key covenant metric monitored against lender thresholds for compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IVSC Valuation Standards; SEC Regulation S-X for REITs

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Contractual date on which the outstanding principal balance is due in full. Critical for refinancing planning, balloon payment scheduling, and WALT/WALE analysis in portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: next_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next scheduled debt service payment is due. Used for cash management, AP payment scheduling in Yardi Voyager, and covenant compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: original_principal
attributes.description: Total principal amount of the debt instrument at origination. Serves as the baseline for LTV calculations, amortization schedules, and historical debt capacity analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: origination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the debt instrument was originated and funds were first disbursed. Marks the effective start of the debt obligation and is used for amortization schedule calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: origination_fee
attributes.description: Upfront fee paid to the lender at loan origination, typically expressed as points (percentage of loan amount). Capitalized as debt issuance cost and amortized over the loan term per FASB ASC 835.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 835 Interest; FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Current unpaid principal balance of the debt instrument as of the most recent payment date. Used for LTV ratio monitoring, balance sheet reporting, and DSCR covenant compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; FASB ASC 842; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which scheduled debt service payments (principal and interest) are due under the loan agreement. Drives payment schedule generation and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt

attributes.name: prepayment_lockout_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which the borrower is permitted to prepay the loan without triggering a lockout penalty. Null if no lockout period applies. Critical for disposition and refinancing timing decisions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; CMBS industry standards

attributes.name: prepayment_penalty_type
attributes.description: Type of prepayment restriction or penalty applicable to early loan payoff. Yield maintenance and defeasance are common in CMBS structures. Drives refinancing cost analysis and disposition planning.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement standards

attributes.name: rate_index
attributes.description: Benchmark interest rate index to which a variable-rate instrument is tied (e.g., SOFR, Prime Rate, Treasury). Null for fixed-rate instruments. Required for interest rate risk management and hedging analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; ARRC SOFR transition guidelines

attributes.name: rate_spread
attributes.description: Contractual spread in basis points expressed as a decimal added to the benchmark index to determine the all-in interest rate for variable-rate instruments (e.g., 0.020000 for 200 bps over SOFR). Null for fixed-rate instruments.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interest rate structure. Fixed Rate Mortgage (FRM) maintains a constant rate; variable/Adjustable Rate Mortgage (ARM) floats against a benchmark index; hybrid combines both periods.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; ARM/FRM industry standards

attributes.name: recourse_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender has recourse to the borrower's other assets beyond the collateral property in the event of default. Non-recourse is standard for CMBS; full recourse is common for construction loans.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; SNDA Agreement standards

attributes.name: scheduled_payment_amount
attributes.description: Total scheduled periodic debt service payment amount including both principal and interest components. Used for cash flow forecasting, NOI impact analysis, and DSCR calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470 Debt; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: servicer_name
attributes.description: Name of the loan servicer responsible for collecting payments and managing escrow accounts, particularly relevant for CMBS instruments where the servicer differs from the originating lender.
attributes.references: CMBS Pooling and Servicing Agreement standards; FASB ASC 470

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this debt instrument record was sourced (e.g., Yardi Voyager, SAP S/4HANA). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across systems.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 data lineage requirements

attributes.name: source_system_loan_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this debt instrument in the originating source system (Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA). Enables bi-directional reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and operational systems.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 data lineage requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this debt instrument record was most recently modified in the data platform. Required for incremental data pipeline processing and SOX audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GDPR Article 5 data integrity

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for this debt service obligation. Supports GL allocation and financial consolidation under SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or user identifier of the individual who authorized this debt service payment in the internal approval workflow. Required for SOX-compliant audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the debt service payment was approved by the authorized approver. Part of the SOX-compliant audit trail for financial disbursements.

attributes.name: covenant_breach_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the type of lender covenant breach triggered by this payment event. Null or 'none' when no breach occurred. Used for lender reporting and risk management escalation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Lender Covenant Agreement; SEC REIT Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this debt service payment record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX-compliant record-keeping.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Enterprise Data Governance; Databricks Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: The number of calendar days by which the actual payment date exceeded the scheduled payment date. Zero for on-time payments. Used for lender covenant monitoring, late fee calculation, and credit risk reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Lender Covenant Agreement; Yardi Voyager Loan Module

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting fiscal period (YYYY-MM) to which this debt service payment is attributed. Used for period-level P&L reporting, DSCR calculations, and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; SAP S/4HANA Period-End Close; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days after the scheduled payment date within which payment may be made without triggering a late fee or covenant breach, as defined in the loan agreement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Loan Agreement Grace Period Provisions

attributes.name: interest_rate_applied
attributes.description: The effective annual interest rate (as a decimal, e.g., 0.065 for 6.5%) applied to calculate the interest component of this payment. Captures the rate in effect for the period, which may vary for adjustable-rate mortgages (ARM).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; IFRS 9; ARM/FRM Loan Agreement Terms

attributes.name: is_covenant_breach
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this payment event triggered a lender covenant breach (e.g., missed payment, DSCR threshold violation, LTV breach). Drives escalation workflows and lender notification requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Lender Covenant Agreement; SEC Reporting for REITs

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: The penalty fee charged by the lender for a payment received after the scheduled due date or grace period. Tracked separately for covenant compliance reporting and expense analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Loan Agreement Terms; Yardi Voyager Loan Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context or commentary on this debt service payment, such as reasons for partial payment, lender waiver details, or manual adjustment explanations.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Loan Module; SAP S/4HANA Payment Notes

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_after
attributes.description: The remaining outstanding principal balance of the debt instrument immediately after this payment is applied. Critical for Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio monitoring, DSCR calculations, and lender covenant compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; LTV Covenant Monitoring; Argus Enterprise; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_before
attributes.description: The outstanding principal balance of the debt instrument immediately before this payment is applied. Used to verify interest calculations and track amortization progress.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Argus Enterprise Debt Schedule; Yardi Voyager Loan Module

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The mechanism used to remit the debt service payment to the lender (e.g., wire transfer, ACH, check). Used for cash management, bank reconciliation, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Payment Module; SAP S/4HANA Payment Run

attributes.name: payment_period_number
attributes.description: The sequential payment period number within the loan amortization schedule (e.g., payment 1 of 360 for a 30-year mortgage). Used to track amortization progress and validate payment schedules.
attributes.references: Loan Amortization Schedule; Argus Enterprise Debt Modeling; Yardi Voyager

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for this debt service payment, as assigned by the source system (Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA) or the lender's payment portal. Used for reconciliation and lender confirmation matching.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Loan Payment Module; SAP S/4HANA AP Payment Run

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the debt service payment. Drives DSCR monitoring, lender covenant alerts, and cash flow forecasting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|pending|paid|partial|late|missed|reversed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Yardi Voyager Loan Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the debt service payment was posted to the General Ledger. May differ from actual_payment_date due to period-end cut-off rules. Critical for SOX-compliant financial period reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; SAP S/4HANA GL Posting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: prepayment_penalty_amount
attributes.description: The penalty amount charged by the lender for early repayment of principal beyond the scheduled amortization. Relevant for disposition planning and refinancing analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Loan Agreement Prepayment Provisions; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interest rate for this payment period is fixed (FRM), variable/adjustable (ARM), or hybrid. Relevant for interest rate risk analysis and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; IFRS 9; ARM/FRM Loan Agreement Terms

attributes.name: scheduled_escrow_amount
attributes.description: The contractually scheduled escrow deposit amount due for this payment period, covering property taxes, insurance, and reserves as required by the lender. Included in total debt service obligation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; HUD Escrow Requirements; Yardi Voyager Escrow Module

attributes.name: scheduled_interest_amount
attributes.description: The contractually scheduled interest payment amount due for this payment period, calculated based on the outstanding loan balance and the applicable interest rate. Core component of total debt service for DSCR calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; IFRS 9; Argus Enterprise Cash Flow Modeling

attributes.name: scheduled_payment_date
attributes.description: The contractually agreed date on which the debt service payment is due to the lender, as defined in the loan agreement or amortization schedule. Used for cash flow modeling and covenant compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Argus Enterprise Cash Flow Modeling; Loan Amortization Schedule

attributes.name: scheduled_principal_amount
attributes.description: The contractually scheduled principal repayment amount due for this payment period, as defined in the loan amortization schedule. Used as the baseline for DSCR numerator calculations and variance analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Argus Enterprise DCF Modeling; Loan Amortization Schedule

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this debt service payment record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: source_system_payment_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this payment record in the originating source system (Yardi Voyager or SAP S/4HANA). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: total_payment_amount
attributes.description: The total amount actually remitted to the lender for this payment, representing the sum of actual principal, interest, escrow, and any late fees paid. Used for cash management reconciliation and lender statement matching.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470; Yardi Voyager Loan Payment Module; SAP S/4HANA AP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this debt service payment record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks changes for audit trail and SOX-compliant financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Enterprise Data Governance; Databricks Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: wire_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The bank-issued confirmation or transaction reference number for wire transfer or ACH payments. Used for payment reconciliation against lender statements and bank records.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager AP Module; SAP S/4HANA Bank Communication Management

'Pursuing' indicates the property is in the application or assessment process; 'Certified' indicates active certification; 'Expired' indicates the certification period has lapsed; 'Withdrawn' indicates the application was voluntarily withdrawn; 'Suspended' indicates certification has been placed on hold by the certifying body.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Certification; BRE — BREEAM; ESG Reporting Frameworks

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the green building certification standard being applied. Identifies the framework under which the property is assessed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LEED|BREEAM|ENERGY_STAR|WELL|Fitwel|Living_Building_Challenge — promote to reference product if additional standards are adopted]
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED; BRE — BREEAM; U.S. EPA ENERGY STAR; International WELL Building Institute (IWBI); Fitwel

attributes.name: certification_version
attributes.description: The specific version or edition of the certification standard under which the property was assessed (e.g., LEED v4.1, LEED v4, LEED 2009, BREEAM 2018, BREEAM In-Use v6). Critical for interpreting scoring criteria and prerequisites.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Rating System Versions; BRE — BREEAM Technical Standards Versions

attributes.name: certified_area_sqft
attributes.description: The gross floor area (GFA) in square feet (SQF) covered by this certification. Used for ESG intensity metrics (e.g., energy use per SQF), green lease obligations, and portfolio-level certified area reporting.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); GRESB (Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark); ESG Reporting Frameworks

attributes.name: certifying_body
attributes.description: The organization responsible for issuing and administering the certification (e.g., USGBC for LEED, BRE for BREEAM, EPA for ENERGY STAR, IWBI for WELL Building Standard, Fitwel for Fitwel). Used for ESG reporting and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC); Building Research Establishment (BRE); U.S. EPA; International WELL Building Institute (IWBI)

attributes.name: certifying_body_project_ref
attributes.description: The project registration or tracking identifier assigned by the certifying body's online platform (e.g., USGBC LEED Online project ID, BREEAM Projects portal reference). Used for direct cross-referencing with the certifying body's registry and audit purposes.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Online; BRE — BREEAM Projects Portal

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this green certification record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: energy_star_score
attributes.description: The EPA ENERGY STAR portfolio manager score (1–100) reflecting the property's energy performance relative to similar buildings nationally. A score of 75 or above qualifies for ENERGY STAR certification. Applicable when certification_type is ENERGY_STAR or as a supplementary metric for LEED/BREEAM energy credits.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager; U.S. EPA ENERGY STAR Certification Requirements

attributes.name: esg_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: ESG (Environmental Social and Governance) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification record is included in the organization's ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) disclosures and sustainability reporting (e.g., GRESB submission, annual sustainability report, SEC ESG disclosures for REITs). True if reportable; False if excluded.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K — ESG Disclosures; GRESB (Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark); GRI Standards; TCFD Recommendations

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current certification expires and renewal is required to maintain certified status. Null if the certification does not have a defined expiry (e.g., some LEED versions). Critical for compliance monitoring and renewal workflow triggers.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Recertification; BRE — BREEAM In-Use; ESG Reporting Frameworks

attributes.name: green_lease_linked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is referenced in or required by one or more green lease agreements for the property. True if the certification underpins green lease obligations (e.g., tenant energy reporting, sustainability covenants); False otherwise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 — Lease Accounting; IASB IFRS 16 — Leases; ESG Reporting Frameworks; Urban Land Institute (ULI) Green Lease Guidelines

attributes.name: gresb_submission_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark (GRESB) Submission Year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which this certification data was included in the organization's GRESB (Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark) submission. Used to track ESG reporting cycles and benchmark performance year-over-year.
attributes.references: GRESB (Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark); SEC Regulation S-K — ESG Disclosures

attributes.name: incentive_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific financial incentives, tax credits, or grants for which the property is eligible as a result of this certification (e.g., IRS Section 179D deduction, state property tax abatement, utility rebate program). Populated when incentive_eligible is True.
attributes.references: IRS Section 179D; U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) — Green Building Incentives

attributes.name: incentive_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property qualifies for financial incentives (tax credits, grants, reduced permit fees, expedited permitting) as a result of achieving this green certification. Supports CAPEX planning and investment advisory analysis.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) — Green Building Incentives; IRS Section 179D Energy Efficiency Deduction; State and Local Green Building Incentive Programs

attributes.name: leed_category_breakdown
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Category Breakdown
attributes.description: Structured summary of points earned across LEED credit categories (e.g., Sustainable Sites, Water Efficiency, Energy & Atmosphere, Materials & Resources, Indoor Environmental Quality, Innovation). Stored as a delimited string for LEED-type certifications; null for non-LEED certifications.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Credit Categories

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, conditions, exceptions, or observations related to the certification record (e.g., conditional certification notes, outstanding credit appeals, assessor observations, special circumstances affecting the certification outcome).
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: points_available
attributes.description: The maximum number of credits or points available under the applicable certification version and building type. Used to calculate the percentage score and determine the achievable certification level.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Rating System; BRE — BREEAM Technical Standards

attributes.name: points_scored
attributes.description: The total number of credits or points awarded to the property under the certification framework's scoring system (e.g., LEED points out of 110, BREEAM percentage score). Represents the principal quantitative outcome of the certification assessment.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Credit Categories; BRE — BREEAM Technical Standards

attributes.name: prerequisites_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether all mandatory prerequisites required by the certification framework have been satisfied. A value of True confirms all prerequisites are fulfilled; False indicates outstanding prerequisites that must be resolved before certification can be awarded.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Prerequisites; BRE — BREEAM Mandatory Credits

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the renewal application must be submitted to the certifying body to avoid lapse of certification. May differ from expiry_date if the certifying body requires advance submission. Supports compliance calendar and deadline management.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Recertification; BRE — BREEAM In-Use Renewal

attributes.name: renewal_in_progress
attributes.description: Indicates whether a renewal application for this certification is currently in progress with the certifying body. True if the renewal process has been initiated but not yet completed; False otherwise. Supports compliance monitoring and workflow management.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Recertification; BRE — BREEAM In-Use Renewal

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the physical scope of the certification — specifying which building, floor, wing, or portion of the property is covered by this certification record. Relevant for multi-building campuses or partial certifications.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) — LEED Project Boundary; BRE — BREEAM Assessment Scope

attributes.name: score_percentage
attributes.description: The certification score expressed as a percentage of total available points (points_scored / points_available × 100). Used for cross-framework ESG benchmarking and portfolio-level green performance reporting.
attributes.references: BRE — BREEAM Technical Standards; ESG Reporting Frameworks; GRESB (Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark)

attributes.name: supporting_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the certification documentation package stored in the document management system (e.g., DocuSign CLM, Procore document repository). Includes the official certificate, assessment report, and supporting evidence submitted to the certifying body.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Contract Lifecycle Management; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Document Retention

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this green certification record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

products.name: violation
products.description: Records confirmed regulatory violations, non-compliance events, enforcement actions, and OSHA-reportable workplace safety incidents across all compliance programs. Covers EPA notices of violation, OSHA citations and recordable incidents (injuries, illnesses, near-misses, fatalities with 300/300A log classification), HUD enforcement actions, SEC comment letters, building code violations, and zoning violations. Captures violation/incident type, regulatory body, citation reference, date, severity (willful, serious, other-than-serious, de minimis), OSHA recordability classification, days away from work, root cause analysis, penalty amount assessed, contest status, and resolution outcome. Drives remediation workflows, regulatory response management, and mandatory incident reporting.

products.name: property_type
products.description: Enterprise-wide property classification taxonomy organized as a self-referencing multi-level hierarchy. Level 1: asset class (commercial, residential, mixed-use, land, special-purpose). Level 2: sub-category (office, retail, industrial, hospitality, single-family, multifamily, condo). Level 3: quality tier / building class (Class A/B/C, trophy, institutional-grade, luxury, affordable). Level 4: space use type (office, retail, restaurant, medical, fitness, storage, parking). Level 5: construction method (wood frame, steel, concrete, masonry, modular). Level 6: amenity classification (building-level, unit-level, community). Each node carries applicable attributes: GLA applicability flags, zoning compatibility codes, fire resistance ratings (IBC Type I–V), ESG/LEED relevance indicators, CAM inclusion rules, TI allowance benchmarks, and measurement methodology (GLA/NLA/GFA). Aligned with RESO, CoStar, BOMA, and NAIOP standards. Referenced by property, lease, valuation, brokerage, development, and maintenance domains as the single source of truth for all property classification.
