attributes.references: NAIOP Property Classification Standards; CoStar Property Type Taxonomy; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: bim_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether BIM (Building Information Modeling) digital asset documentation is applicable and required for development and construction projects of this property type. True for complex commercial, mixed-use, and large-scale residential development types managed in Procore. Drives BIM data collection and document control workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 19650 BIM Standards; Procore Construction Management; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: cam_inclusion_rule
attributes.description: Standard CAM (Common Area Maintenance) expense inclusion rule applicable to this property type, defining which operating expenses are passed through to tenants. NNN (Triple Net) passes taxes, insurance, and maintenance; NN (Double Net) passes taxes and insurance; Full-Service Gross includes all expenses in base rent. Drives lease structuring defaults in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Full-Service Gross|Modified Gross|NNN|NN|N|Absolute Net|N/A — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: BOMA Standards; NAIOP Property Classification Standards; FASB ASC 842 Lease Accounting

attributes.name: cap_rate_benchmark_pct
attributes.description: Market benchmark CAP Rate (Capitalization Rate) percentage for this property type, representing the expected ratio of Net Operating Income (NOI) to property value. Used as a default underwriting assumption in Argus Enterprise DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) models and investment advisory valuations. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.50 = 5.50%).
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; IVSC (International Valuation Standards Council); Argus Enterprise Valuation Standards

attributes.name: costar_property_type_code
attributes.description: CoStar Suite's standardized property type code for this classification node. Enables direct mapping and data reconciliation between the enterprise taxonomy and CoStar market research data, comparable sales, and lease analytics. Critical for market benchmarking and CMA (Comparative Market Analysis) workflows.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite Property Type Taxonomy; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this property type taxonomy node was first created in the enterprise reference data repository. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) compliance for reference data governance.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this property type classification node became effective and available for use in the enterprise taxonomy. Supports temporal validity tracking and ensures historical data integrity when taxonomy nodes are introduced or revised.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; FASB ASC 842; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which this property type classification node is no longer valid for new assignments. NULL indicates the node is currently active with no planned expiry. Supports taxonomy versioning and ensures deprecated nodes are not applied to new properties or leases after their retirement date.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; FASB ASC 842; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: far_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Floor Area Ratio (FAR) regulations are applicable to development projects of this property type. True for commercial and mixed-use development types subject to FAR zoning restrictions. Used in development feasibility analysis and Procore project planning.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); Local Municipal Zoning Ordinances; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Integer indicating the depth of this node within the six-level property classification hierarchy. Level 1 = Asset Class (commercial, residential, mixed-use, land, special-purpose); Level 2 = Sub-Category (office, retail, industrial, hospitality, single-family, multifamily, condo); Level 3 = Quality Tier / Building Class (Class A/B/C, trophy, institutional-grade, luxury, affordable); Level 4 = Space Use Type (office, retail, restaurant, medical, fitness, storage, parking); Level 5 = Construction Method (wood frame, steel, concrete, masonry, modular); Level 6 = Amenity Classification (building-level, unit-level, community).
attributes.references: BOMA Standards; NAIOP Property Classification Standards; CoStar Property Type Taxonomy

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialized full ancestry path from root to this node expressed as a delimited string (e.g., 'Commercial / Office / Class A / Office Space Use / Steel Frame / Building-Level Amenity'). Enables efficient subtree queries and breadcrumb navigation in reporting tools without recursive CTE traversal.
attributes.references: BOMA Standards; CoStar Property Type Taxonomy

attributes.name: hoa_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether properties of this type are subject to HOA (Homeowners Association) governance, fees, and covenants. Applicable to condominium, single-family community, and certain mixed-use residential property types. Drives HOA fee tracking in property management and tenant disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); HUD Condominium Project Approval Guidelines; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: ibc_fire_resistance_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Building Code (IBC) Fire Resistance Type
attributes.description: International Building Code (IBC) construction type classification indicating the fire resistance rating of the structural system. Types I and II are non-combustible; Types III, IV, and V include combustible elements. Drives insurance underwriting, OSHA compliance, and maintenance safety protocols. Aligned with IBC Chapter 6 construction type definitions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Type I-A|Type I-B|Type II-A|Type II-B|Type III-A|Type III-B|Type IV|Type V-A|Type V-B|N/A — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: International Building Code (IBC); OSHA Building Safety Standards; NFPA (National Fire Protection Association)

attributes.name: is_cam_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges are applicable to leases for properties of this type. True for commercial property types (office, retail, industrial) where CAM reconciliation is standard. False for residential or gross lease property types where operating expenses are not passed through to tenants.
attributes.references: BOMA Standards; FASB ASC 842 Lease Accounting; IASB IFRS 16 Leases

attributes.name: is_commercial
attributes.description: Indicates whether this property type is classified as CRE (Commercial Real Estate) for regulatory, tax, and accounting purposes. Drives applicability of CMBS (Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities) financing, DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio) underwriting, and commercial lease accounting under FASB ASC 842.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 Lease Accounting; CMBS Standards; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX); SEC REIT Regulations

attributes.name: is_esg_relevant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Relevance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) reporting metrics and sustainability certifications are applicable and tracked for properties of this type. True for property types subject to LEED, BREEAM, or ENERGY STAR certification programs. Drives ESG data collection requirements and SEC sustainability disclosure obligations for publicly traded REITs.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) LEED; BREEAM; SEC ESG Disclosure Requirements; EPA Energy Star

attributes.name: is_gla_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Gross Leasable Area (GLA) measurement methodology is applicable to properties of this type. True for retail and commercial property types where GLA is the standard measurement basis per BOMA and ICSC standards. False for property types measured by other methodologies (e.g., residential measured by GFA or NLA).
attributes.references: BOMA Standards; ICSC (International Council of Shopping Centers); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: is_investment_grade
attributes.description: Indicates whether properties of this type qualify as institutional investment-grade assets suitable for REIT (Real Estate Investment Trust) portfolios, pension fund investment, and institutional capital allocation. Drives portfolio screening in Argus Enterprise and investment advisory workflows. Typically True for Class A and Trophy commercial assets.
attributes.references: SEC REIT Regulations; Appraisal Institute; Urban Land Institute (ULI); IVSC (International Valuation Standards Council)

attributes.name: is_leaf_node
attributes.description: Indicates whether this taxonomy node is a terminal leaf node (True) with no child nodes, or an intermediate branch node (False). Leaf nodes represent the most granular assignable property type classifications. Used to enforce that only leaf-level types are assigned to individual properties and leases.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; CoStar Property Type Taxonomy

attributes.name: is_reit_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether properties of this type qualify as REIT-eligible assets under IRS REIT qualification rules (IRC Section 856). Drives asset classification in financial consolidation (SAP S/4HANA) and SEC regulatory reporting for publicly traded REITs. Distinct from investment_grade as it reflects specific tax and regulatory eligibility.
attributes.references: SEC REIT Regulations; IRS IRC Section 856; FASB ASC 842; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX)

attributes.name: is_residential
attributes.description: Indicates whether this property type is classified as residential for regulatory, tax, and accounting purposes. Drives applicability of HUD regulations, residential mortgage underwriting standards (PMI, ARM, FRM, DTI), and RMBS (Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities) eligibility. Distinct from asset_class for use in compliance filtering.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); FASB ASC 842; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: leed_certification_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certification is applicable and pursued for properties of this type. Drives green building data collection, energy benchmarking, and ESG reporting workflows. Relevant for institutional-grade commercial and multifamily property types.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) LEED Certification Standards; EPA Energy Star

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: Standard area measurement methodology applicable to this property type. GLA (Gross Leasable Area) for retail; NLA (Net Leasable Area) for commercial office; GFA (Gross Floor Area) for development and planning; IPMS (International Property Measurement Standards) for cross-border portfolios. Drives how PSF (Per Square Foot) rent and valuation metrics are calculated.
attributes.references: BOMA Standards; IPMS (International Property Measurement Standards); RESO Data Dictionary; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: naiop_type_code
attributes.description: NAIOP (National Association for Industrial and Office Properties) standardized property type code for commercial real estate classification. Used for industry benchmarking, market research alignment, and CRE (Commercial Real Estate) portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: NAIOP Property Classification Standards; CoStar Suite Market Data

attributes.name: property_type_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this property type taxonomy node. 'active' nodes are available for assignment to properties, leases, and valuations. 'deprecated' nodes are retained for historical data integrity but no longer assignable. 'draft' nodes are under review prior to enterprise publication.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: reso_property_type_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Property Type Code
attributes.description: RESO (Real Estate Standards Organization) standardized property type code for MLS (Multiple Listing Service) data exchange and industry interoperability. Enables syndication of property listings via MLS platforms and ensures compliance with RESO Data Dictionary standards.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO) Data Dictionary; National Association of Realtors (NAR) MLS Standards

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Integer defining the preferred display sequence of this property type node within its sibling group at the same hierarchy level. Used to control the ordering of property type options in dropdown menus, reports, and dashboards across Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, and Salesforce CRM integrations.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: sub_category
attributes.description: Level 2 sub-category classification denormalized from the taxonomy hierarchy for analytical convenience. Examples: Office, Retail, Industrial, Hospitality, Single-Family, Multifamily, Condo, Mixed-Use Retail/Office. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Office|Retail|Industrial|Hospitality|Single-Family|Multifamily|Condo|Mixed-Use|Self-Storage|Data Center|Life Science|Senior Housing — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIOP Property Classification Standards; CoStar Property Type Taxonomy; RESO Data Dictionary

attributes.name: ti_allowance_benchmark_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tenant Improvement (TI) Allowance Benchmark Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Market benchmark for Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance expressed in dollars Per Square Foot (PSF) for this property type. Used as a default starting point in lease negotiations and deal underwriting. Sourced from CoStar market data and internal brokerage transaction history. Supports deal pipeline analysis in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: NAIOP Property Classification Standards; CoStar Suite Market Data; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this property type node within the enterprise taxonomy. Used as the stable business key for cross-system integration with Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, CoStar, and Argus Enterprise. Examples: COMM_OFF_A, RES_MF_LUX, IND_WRHSE.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; CoStar Property Type Taxonomy; BOMA Standards

attributes.name: type_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the property classification node, including defining characteristics, typical use cases, and distinguishing criteria from adjacent nodes. Supports business user understanding and onboarding.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; Urban Land Institute (ULI) Property Classification Guidelines

attributes.name: type_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name for this property classification node as used in reports, dashboards, and user interfaces across all operational systems. Examples: 'Class A Office', 'Luxury Multifamily', 'Triple Net Retail'.
attributes.references: RESO Data Dictionary; NAIOP Property Classification Standards; CoStar Property Type Taxonomy

attributes.name: typical_lease_term_months
attributes.description: Market-standard typical lease term in months for this property type. Used as a default assumption in lease underwriting, WALT (Weighted Average Lease Term) calculations, and cash flow modeling in Argus Enterprise. Examples: 12 months for residential, 60-120 months for commercial office, 36-60 months for retail.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842 Lease Accounting; IASB IFRS 16 Leases; NAIOP Property Classification Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this property type taxonomy node was last modified in the enterprise reference data repository. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and reference data governance workflows.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: zoning_compatibility_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of standard zoning designation codes compatible with this property type (e.g., 'C-1|C-2|M-1' for light commercial/industrial). Supports regulatory compliance checks, development feasibility analysis, and GIS (Geographic Information System) integration. Aligned with local municipal zoning ordinances and FAR (Floor Area Ratio) regulations.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); Local Municipal Zoning Ordinances; GIS Standards

products.name: lease_type
products.description: Standardized classification of lease structures used across commercial and residential leasing — NNN (Triple Net), gross lease, modified gross, percentage lease, ground lease, sublease, and short-term/month-to-month. Defines rent calculation methodology, CAM/OpEx responsibility allocation, and applicable accounting treatment under ASC 842 / IFRS 16. Includes escalation method indicators (CPI, fixed-step, market reset) and renewal option classification. Serves as the authoritative lookup for lease administration across Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, and all operational domains requiring lease structure classification.

attributes.name: lease_type_id
attributes.description: Primary key for lease_type

attributes.name: area_uom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.uom. Business justification: lease_type.area_measure_standard is a STRING describing the area measurement standard applicable to this lease type (e.g., BOMA 2017, IPMS, RICS). The uom table is the enterprise UOM registry that inc
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.market_segment. Business justification: Lease types are associated with specific market segments (e.g., NNN leases are typical in Core commercial segments, gross leases in Value-Add residential segments). Linking to the market_segment regis
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Industry-standard abbreviation for the lease type used in market communications, CoStar listings, and brokerage reports (e.g., NNN, MG, FS, PCT, GL). Aligns with CoStar Suite and MLS syndication field conventions.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: argus_lease_type_code
attributes.description: The corresponding lease type identifier as used in Argus Enterprise cash flow and valuation models. Enables mapping between this reference record and Argus Enterprise lease structure assumptions for DCF modeling, CAP rate analysis, and portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise Valuation and Cash Flow Modeling Module

attributes.name: asc842_lease_classification
attributes.description: Specifies the default lease classification under FASB ASC 842 for this lease type: 'operating' (lessee recognizes right-of-use asset and operating lease liability), 'finance' (lessee recognizes finance lease asset and liability with front-loaded expense), 'short_term_exemption' (leases ≤12 months exempt from balance sheet recognition), or 'not_applicable' (lessor-side or non-applicable structures). Drives accounting treatment in SAP S/4HANA and Yardi Voyager GL.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB); Yardi Voyager General Ledger

attributes.name: cam_reconciliation_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Reconciliation Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether annual CAM reconciliation is required for this lease type (True). CAM reconciliation compares estimated CAM charges billed to tenants against actual CAM expenses incurred. Required for NNN and modified gross leases; not applicable for full gross leases. Activates CAM reconciliation workflows in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; FASB ASC 842; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: cam_responsibility
attributes.description: Indicates which party bears responsibility for Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges under this lease type. 'landlord' means the landlord absorbs all CAM costs; 'tenant' means the tenant pays CAM directly (as in NNN); 'shared' means costs are pro-rated; 'not_applicable' for lease types where CAM is not a relevant concept (e.g., ground lease). Governs CAM reconciliation workflows in Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager CAM Administration; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this lease type reference record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements under SOX financial controls, and reference data governance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FASB ASC 842; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this lease type classification became or becomes effective for use in new lease agreements. Supports temporal validity tracking for reference data governance and ensures that historical lease records retain the correct classification at the time of execution.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: escalation_method
attributes.description: Indicates the standard rent escalation methodology associated with this lease type: fixed_step (predetermined dollar or percentage increases), cpi_indexed (Consumer Price Index-linked adjustments), market_reset (rent reset to prevailing market rate at intervals), none (flat rent for term), or hybrid (combination of methods). Governs rent schedule escalation logic in Yardi Voyager and Argus Enterprise DCF models.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: esg_reporting_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Reporting Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) reporting obligations — such as green lease clauses, LEED/BREEAM compliance requirements, or energy consumption data sharing — are applicable to this lease type (True). Relevant for institutional and REIT portfolios subject to SEC ESG disclosure requirements and USGBC LEED certification programs.
attributes.references: U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) LEED; Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC); EPA Environmental Compliance; BREEAM

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this lease type classification ceases to be valid for use in new lease agreements (nullable for open-ended classifications). Supports reference data lifecycle management and ensures deprecated lease types are not applied to new leases after their retirement date.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: Industry-standard or regulatory body reference code for this lease type, such as RESO standard codes, NCREIF property type codes, or CoStar lease type identifiers. Enables cross-system interoperability and alignment with industry data exchange standards.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite; National Council of Real Estate Investment Fiduciaries (NCREIF)

attributes.name: ifrs16_lease_classification
attributes.description: Specifies the default lease classification under IASB IFRS 16 for this lease type: 'single_model' (all leases recognized on balance sheet as right-of-use asset and lease liability), 'short_term_exemption' (leases ≤12 months), 'low_value_exemption' (underlying asset of low value), or 'not_applicable'. Supports international financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA for entities reporting under IFRS.
attributes.references: IASB IFRS 16; International Accounting Standards Board (IASB); SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

attributes.name: insurance_responsibility
attributes.description: Defines which party is responsible for property insurance premiums under this lease type. Relevant for NNN and modified gross lease structures where insurance cost allocation varies. Used in lease administration billing and CAM reconciliation processes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: is_ground_lease
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lease type is a ground lease (True), where the tenant leases land only and typically constructs improvements. Ground leases have distinct legal, accounting, and investment characteristics including long terms (50–99 years), land-only rent, and reversion of improvements to the landlord. Relevant for REIT portfolio classification and Argus Enterprise valuation modeling.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC); Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: is_short_term
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lease type is classified as short-term (True), typically defined as a lease term of 12 months or less at commencement. Short-term leases qualify for the practical expedient exemption from balance sheet recognition under both FASB ASC 842 and IASB IFRS 16. Drives accounting treatment selection in SAP S/4HANA and Yardi Voyager.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB)

attributes.name: is_sublease
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lease type represents a sublease arrangement (True), where the original lessee (sublandlord) leases all or part of the demised space to a subtenant. Subleases require distinct accounting treatment under FASB ASC 842 (intermediate lessor classification) and separate tracking in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration

attributes.name: lease_category
attributes.description: Broad property-use category to which this lease type applies — commercial, residential, industrial, mixed_use, or land. Determines which operational workflows in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software are applicable and which regulatory frameworks (ASC 842, IFRS 16) govern accounting treatment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: lease_type_code
attributes.description: Short, system-facing alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the lease type (e.g., NNN, GROSS, MOD_GROSS, PCT, GROUND, SUBLEASE, MTM). Used as the canonical lookup key in Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, and downstream analytical systems to join lease records to their classification.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; MRI Software Lease Management

attributes.name: lease_type_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the lease type, including its defining characteristics, typical use cases, cost responsibility allocation, and distinguishing features from similar lease structures. Used in training materials, lease administration documentation, and business glossary entries.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Urban Land Institute (ULI); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: lease_type_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the lease structure classification (e.g., 'Triple Net Lease', 'Gross Lease', 'Modified Gross Lease', 'Percentage Lease', 'Ground Lease', 'Sublease', 'Month-to-Month'). Displayed in reporting, lease administration screens, and tenant-facing documents.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: lease_type_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this lease type reference record: 'active' (available for use in new lease agreements), 'inactive' (temporarily disabled but retained for historical reference), or 'deprecated' (superseded by a newer classification; retained for legacy lease records only). Controls availability in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software lease type selection lists.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; MRI Software Lease Management; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: loi_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Letter of Intent (LOI) is a standard prerequisite in the deal process for this lease type (True). LOIs are standard for commercial leases but typically not required for residential or month-to-month arrangements. Governs deal pipeline workflow in Salesforce CRM and DocuSign CLM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Deal Pipeline; DocuSign CLM; National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: mri_lease_type_code
attributes.description: The corresponding lease type code as configured in MRI Software Lease Management module. Enables direct mapping between this enterprise reference record and the MRI source system code for data integration and reconciliation, particularly for residential and investment management portfolios.
attributes.references: MRI Software Lease Management Module

attributes.name: noi_impact_classification
attributes.description: Classifies how this lease type impacts Net Operating Income (NOI) calculation: 'gross_revenue' (all income flows through gross revenue line before expense deductions), 'net_revenue' (tenant pays expenses directly, reducing gross revenue line), or 'not_applicable'. Used in Argus Enterprise NOI modeling and MRI Software investment reporting.
attributes.references: Argus Enterprise; MRI Software Investment Management; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: opex_responsibility
attributes.description: Defines which party is responsible for property operating expenditures (OpEx) beyond CAM — including insurance, management fees, and administrative costs — under this lease type. Critical for NOI calculation accuracy in Argus Enterprise and financial reporting under FASB ASC 842.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: percentage_rent_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether percentage rent (a portion of tenant gross sales revenue above a breakpoint) is a feature of this lease type (True). Applicable primarily to retail percentage leases. Activates percentage rent calculation and reporting workflows in Yardi Voyager and MRI Software.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; Yardi Voyager Percentage Rent Module; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: renewal_option_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether renewal options are a standard feature of this lease type (True) or not applicable (False). For example, ground leases and long-term commercial leases typically include renewal options, while month-to-month leases do not. Informs lease renewal option tracking in Yardi Voyager and WALT/WALE calculations in Argus Enterprise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: rent_basis
attributes.description: Defines the standard unit of measure for rent quotation under this lease type: PSF (Per Square Foot) annual, PSF monthly, flat monthly amount, flat annual amount, or percentage of sales. Aligns with industry PSF/SQF conventions and drives rent schedule generation in Yardi Voyager and Argus Enterprise underwriting models.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite; Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: rent_structure
attributes.description: Defines the fundamental rent calculation methodology for this lease type: fixed (flat base rent), variable (indexed or market-reset), percentage (percentage of tenant sales revenue), hybrid (base + percentage), or ground_rent (land-only lease payment). Drives rent schedule generation logic in Yardi Voyager and Argus Enterprise cash flow models.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Argus Enterprise Valuation Module

attributes.name: security_deposit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a security deposit is a standard requirement for this lease type (True). Security deposits are common in residential and commercial leases but may not apply to ground leases or certain institutional arrangements. Drives security deposit tracking and accounting in Yardi Voyager AR and MRI Software.
attributes.references: Yardi Voyager Accounts Receivable; MRI Software Residential Management; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: snda_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Subordination Non-Disturbance and Attornment (SNDA) Agreement Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Subordination Non-Disturbance and Attornment (SNDA) agreement is a standard requirement for this lease type (True). SNDAs are typically required for commercial leases where the property is encumbered by a mortgage. Tracked in DocuSign CLM and Yardi Voyager lease document management.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Yardi Voyager Lease Administration; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display sequence of lease type options in user interface dropdowns, reports, and lease administration screens. Lower values appear first. Enables business-defined ordering independent of alphabetical or ID-based sorting.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: sublease_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether subleasing is a standard permitted feature under this lease type (True). Relevant for distinguishing primary lease structures from sublease structures and for compliance with FASB ASC 842 sublease accounting requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IASB IFRS 16; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: tax_responsibility

attributes.name: is_hard_currency

attributes.name: leads_generated

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: placement_name

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: start_date

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.description: Weighted or simple average of the quoted/advertised asking rent across all surveyed properties, expressed on a per-square-foot (PSF) annual basis. Represents the gross market asking rate before concessions or negotiation.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: avg_concession_value_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Concession Value Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Average total value of landlord concessions offered per square foot across the surveyed competitive set, including free rent periods (converted to PSF equivalent) and tenant improvement (TI) allowances. Measures the gap between asking and effective rents.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: avg_effective_rent_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Effective Rent Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Average net rent actually achievable after accounting for concessions such as free rent periods, tenant improvement (TI) allowances, and other landlord incentives. Reflects true market pricing and is used in Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) and Net Operating Income (NOI) modeling.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Argus Enterprise; Appraisal Institute; FASB ASC 842

attributes.name: avg_free_rent_months
attributes.description: Average number of months of rent abatement (free rent) offered by landlords as a concession across the surveyed competitive set. A key component of the concession package used in effective rent calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: avg_lease_term_months
attributes.description: Average lease duration in months for new leases executed in the surveyed competitive set during the survey period. Informs Weighted Average Lease Term (WALT) benchmarking and portfolio duration risk analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: avg_ti_allowance_psf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Tenant Improvement (TI) Allowance Per Square Foot (PSF)
attributes.description: Average Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance offered by landlords per square foot across the surveyed competitive set. TI allowances fund tenant fit-out costs and are a primary negotiating lever in commercial leasing.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: cap_rate
attributes.description: Prevailing market Capitalization Rate (CAP Rate) observed in the surveyed submarket for the applicable property type, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0550 = 5.50%). Used for property valuation benchmarking and investment return analysis.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC); Argus Enterprise

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the reliability and completeness of the survey data, based on sample size, data source quality, and surveyor judgment. High confidence indicates robust sample and verified data; low confidence indicates limited sample or unverified sources.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; International Valuation Standards Council (IVSC)

attributes.name: costar_market_code
attributes.description: CoStar Suite's proprietary market or submarket identifier corresponding to the geographic area surveyed. Enables direct cross-referencing with CoStar market analytics, comparable data, and benchmarking reports.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite Market Research Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this market survey record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Primary source from which the market survey data was obtained. Indicates data provenance and reliability tier. CoStar and MLS (Multiple Listing Service) represent third-party verified data; internal represents proprietary field research.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: gross_absorption_sqft
attributes.description: Total square footage of all new leases and lease renewals executed in the surveyed competitive set during the survey period, without netting out vacated space. Measures total leasing activity volume.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite

attributes.name: metro_area
attributes.description: The Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA) or major market in which the surveyed submarket is located (e.g., 'New York-Newark-Jersey City', 'Chicago-Naperville-Elgin'). Used for macro-level market aggregation and portfolio benchmarking.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); CoStar Suite

attributes.name: net_absorption_sqft
attributes.description: Net change in occupied square footage across the surveyed competitive set during the survey period. Positive values indicate demand exceeding supply (space being absorbed); negative values indicate tenants vacating more space than is being leased.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: new_supply_sqft
attributes.description: Total square footage of new construction delivered to the surveyed submarket during the survey period. Tracks supply-side additions that affect vacancy and rent levels.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite Market Research Module; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: properties_surveyed_count
attributes.description: Total count of individual properties included in the competitive set for this survey period. Indicates the statistical sample size and reliability of the survey findings.
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; CoStar Suite Market Research Module

attributes.name: published_date
attributes.description: Date on which the market survey was formally published and made available to internal stakeholders, investors, or external parties. Marks the transition from internal research to actionable market intelligence.
attributes.references: SEC (Securities and Exchange Commission); Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: rent_basis
attributes.description: The lease structure basis on which the surveyed rents are quoted. NNN (Triple Net) means tenant pays operating expenses; Gross means landlord covers expenses; Full Service Gross (FSG) includes all services. Critical for accurate rent comparisons across the competitive set.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 842; IFRS 16; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); National Association of Realtors (NAR)

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the market survey was reviewed and approved by the designated reviewer. Used for quality assurance workflow tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the senior analyst, asset manager (AM), or research director who reviewed and approved the survey findings before publication. Supports quality control and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state abbreviation (or equivalent jurisdiction code) for the geographic area covered by the survey. Used for regulatory compliance reporting and geographic segmentation.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); ISO 3166-2

attributes.name: survey_date
attributes.description: The point-in-time date on which the market survey data was collected or observed. This is the principal business event date used for trend analysis and time-series comparisons.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite Market Research Module

attributes.name: survey_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the surveyor to record qualitative observations, market commentary, anomalies, methodology notes, or contextual factors affecting the survey results (e.g., seasonal effects, major tenant move-outs, new development announcements).
attributes.references: Appraisal Institute; Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: survey_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the observation period covered by this market survey. Defines the closing boundary of the measurement window for activity-based metrics such as absorption and new supply.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite

attributes.name: survey_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the observation period covered by this market survey. Together with survey_period_end_date, defines the window during which market activity (absorption, new leases, deliveries) was measured.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite

attributes.name: survey_period_type
attributes.description: Frequency classification of the survey cycle, indicating whether this is a monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, or ad-hoc point-in-time survey. Determines how the record is used in trend analysis and time-series reporting.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite

attributes.name: survey_ref
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the market survey, used in reports, correspondence, and cross-system references. Format: MS-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite Market Research Module

attributes.name: survey_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the market survey record, tracking progression from initial data collection through review, publication, and archival. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_progress|completed|reviewed|published|archived — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO)

attributes.name: survey_type
attributes.description: Classification of the survey by the type of market data being captured. Rent surveys track asking and effective rents; vacancy surveys track occupancy; absorption surveys track net space take-up; concession surveys track landlord incentives; sales comp surveys track transaction comparables.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite Market Research Module; Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: surveyor_company
attributes.description: Name of the firm or organization that conducted the market survey, relevant when surveys are sourced from third-party research providers such as CoStar, CBRE, or JLL.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); CoStar Suite

attributes.name: surveyor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the analyst, researcher, or broker who conducted and recorded the market survey. Used for accountability, quality review, and attribution of market intelligence.
attributes.references: National Association of Realtors (NAR); Appraisal Institute

attributes.name: total_inventory_sqft
attributes.description: Aggregate rentable square footage (SQF) of all properties included in the surveyed competitive set. Provides the denominator for vacancy rate and absorption rate calculations at the submarket level.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite; BOMA International

attributes.name: under_construction_sqft
attributes.description: Total square footage of properties currently under construction in the surveyed submarket as of the survey date. Represents the forward supply pipeline and is used in market forecasting and investment analysis.
attributes.references: CoStar Suite Market Research Module; Urban Land Institute (ULI)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this market survey record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: vacancy_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of total rentable square footage in the surveyed competitive set that is currently unoccupied and available for lease. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1250 = 12.50%). Key indicator of market supply-demand balance.
attributes.references: Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO); CoStar Suite; National Association of Realtors (NAR)
